chapters.title: Introduction to the book
paragraphs: [Introduction to the book]

In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, there is no god but God and Muhammad is the Messenger of God, {Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds - Most Gracious, Most Merciful - Master of the Day of Judgment} [Al-Fatihah: 2 4].
{Praise be to God who created the heavens and the earth and made darkness and light; then those who disbelieve in their Lord will do justice} [Al-An’am: 1].
{Praise be to God, who has not taken a son, and has no partner in dominion, and who has no guardian of subjugation} [Al-Isra: 111].
God is great, God is great, there is no god but God, God is great, God is great, praise be to God, God is great, praise be to God A lot, and Glory be to God tomorrow and the evening.

{Praise be to God who sent down to His servant the Book and made no deviation in it - straight, that He might warn of severe punishment from Himself and give good tidings to the believers. Those who do righteous deeds know that they will have a good reward - they will remain therein forever - and those who say, “God has taken a son” are warned that they have no knowledge of it or To their fathers, a word that comes out of their mouths is difficult. They speak nothing but a lie.} [Al-Kahf: 1-5].

{Praise be to God, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and to Him belongs all praise in the Hereafter, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Aware - He knows what enters the earth and what From it comes forth and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends therein. And He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.} [Saba: 1-2].

{Praise be to God, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, who makes the angels messengers, endowed with wings, two or three or four. He adds to creation what He wills. Indeed, God is All things are capable - whatever mercy God opens to people, no one can withhold it, and whatever He withholds, no one can send it after him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.} [Fatir: 1 - 2].

And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, Alone, with no partner, the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting, whom neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him: {To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever On earth who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not comprehend any of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them will not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Great.” [Al-Baqarah: 255].

The One, the Eternal, the One who did not beget, nor was born, and to Him there was no one equal, the First, the Last, the Manifest, the Hidden, the King, the Holy, the Peaceful, the Faithful, The Dominant, the Mighty,
The Mighty, the Arrogant, the Creator, the Creator, the Modeler. To Him belongs the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. He sent him with guidance and the religion of truth. To make him prevail over all religions, and God is sufficient as a witness. He sent him with the truth before the Hour as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and a caller to God by His permission and as a lamp. Illuminating, He sent it to all the heavy creatures, jinn and mankind, Arabs and non-Arabs, illiterate and writers, and sent down to them: {The best of hadiths, a book. It resembles two times, from which the skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it, then their skins and hearts soften to the remembrance of God. That is God’s guidance. He guides thereby whomsoever He wills, and whoever Allah sends astray - he has no guide.} [Az-Zumar: 23].

A Book which He sent down to bring people out of darkness into light, by the permission of their Lord, and to guide them: {To the path of the Mighty, the Praiseworthy - Allah, to whom is The heavens and all that is on the earth} [Ibrahim: 1-2].

He guided them thereby to a straight path, the path of Him to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and it is the path of those to whom God has bestowed blessings among the prophets. And the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and it is the religion of God with which He was sent messengers before him, as God Almighty said: {He has legislated for you of the religion what He enjoined upon Noah. And what We have revealed to you and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus is: “Uphold the religion and do not become divided in it” [Al-Shura: 13].

And the Almighty said: {O you messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness. Indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do - and this is your nation, a single nation, and I Your Lord, so beware of your duty.} [Al-Mu’minun: 51-52].
And he said in the other verse: {And I am your Lord, so beware - so they divided their affairs into divisions among themselves, every party rejoicing in what they have} [Al-Mu’minun: 52-53].
And God Almighty said: {And We did not send before you any messenger except to him that We revealed, “There is no god but Me, so worship Me” [Al-Anbiya’: 25].

And God Almighty said: {And We have certainly sent into every nation a messenger, saying, “Worship God and avoid the tyrant.” And among them are those whom God has guided, and among them are those upon whom the law has been imposed. misguidance. So travel through the land and see what was the end of the deniers.} [An-Nahl: 36].

He sent down to him the Book with truth, confirming what was before him of the Book and dominating it, so His Book confirmed what was before him of the Books of Heaven, and he commanded By faith in all the prophets, as God Almighty said: {Say, “We believe in God and in what was sent down to us and what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac.” And Jacob and the tribes, and what was given to Moses and Jesus, and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we submit - so if they believe. In the same way as you have believed in, then they are rightly guided. And if they turn away, then they are only in discord. God will suffice you for them, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.} [Al-Baqarah:
He ruled over the book that was before him, and that covers all the books, as a witness, a judge, and a trustworthy person. He testifies to information such as what is in it. The truthful one.

He established the foundations of the religion and its comprehensive laws that the messengers agreed upon, such as the commandments mentioned in the last of the An’am, in the first book. The beginning of Al-A'raf, Surah Glory be to Him, and similar Meccan surahs.
God Almighty said:

{Say: Come, let your witnesses bear witness that God has forbidden this. But if they bear witness, do not bear witness with them, and do not follow the inclinations of those who deny Our signs. And those who do not believe in the Hereafter, but they are just with their Lord - Say, “Come, recite what your Lord has forbidden to you, that you do not associate with Him anything And be good to parents, and do not kill your children out of poverty. We will provide for you and for them. And do not approach immoral acts, whether apparent or otherwise. And do not kill the soul which God has made sacred, except in a manner of truth. This He has commanded you that you may understand - And do not approach the property of an orphan except in a manner that is It is better until it reaches its full maturity, and give full measure and balance with justice. We do not burden a soul beyond what it can bear. And when you say, “Be just,” even if it were Relatives, and by the covenant of God, fulfill this which He has commanded you, that you may remember - and that this is My straight path, so follow it and do not follow other paths. So He turned you away from His path, and enjoined upon you that you might become righteous.} [Al-An'am:

And God Almighty said: {Say: My Lord has commanded justice, and establish your faces at every place of worship and call upon Him, sincere to Him in religion, just as He began with you to return - a group. Guidance and a party upon whom misguidance is due. Indeed, they have taken the devils as guardians instead of God, and they think that they are being guided - O sons of Adam, take Your adornment is at every mosque. Eat and drink, but do not be extravagant. Indeed, He does not like the extravagant. Say, “Whoever deprives the adornment of God which He has provided for His servants.” And the good things of provision. Say, “They are for those who believe in the life of this world, pure on the Day of Resurrection. Thus do We explain the signs in detail for a people who know.” [Al-A’raf:
And the Almighty said:

{And your Lord has decreed that you should worship none but Him and that you be good to parents. Whether one or both of them attain old age with you, do not say to them, “Father.” And do not rebuke them, and speak to them a noble word - and lower for them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, “My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was little” - your Lord. I know what is in your souls. If you are righteous, then indeed He is Forgiving of those who return. And give the relative his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and do not be wasteful. Wasteful - Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of Satan, and Satan is ungrateful to his Lord - or you turn away from them, seeking mercy from your Lord. When you hope for them, say to them an easy-going word - and do not let your hand be shackled to your neck, nor extend it out completely, lest you sit blaming and distressed - indeed Your Lord extends sustenance to whom He wills, and He is destined. Indeed, He is All-Aware and All-Seeing of His servants - And do not kill your children for fear of our poverty. We will provide for them and for you. Indeed, killing them was a great mistake - and do not approach adultery, for it is an immorality and an evil path - and do not kill the soul that has been forbidden. God, except with justice, and whoever is killed unjustly, We have given his heir authority, so let him not be extravagant in killing. Indeed, he will be victorious - and do not approach wealth. the orphan except with that which is best until he reaches his maturity, and fulfill the covenant. Indeed, the covenant will be held accountable - and give full measure when you are swayed. Weigh with a straight balance; that is better and has a better interpretation - and do not rely on that of which you have no knowledge, for the hearing, the sight, and the heart are all of those. He was asked about him - And do not walk in the land rejoicing, for you will not penetrate the land, nor will you reach the height of the mountains - all of that was bad at the time. Your Lord is an abomination - that is from what your Lord has revealed to you of wisdom. And do not establish with God another god, lest you be thrown into Hell blameworthy and rejected.} [Al-Isra:

The religion of the prophets and messengers is one religion, even though the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an each have a law and a method, and for this reason he, peace and blessings of God be upon him, said Peace and blessings of God be upon him, in the hadith whose authenticity is agreed upon on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “We, the Prophets, have one religion. And the people most worthy of the son of Maryam are ours, for there is no prophet between me and him.”
The religion of the messengers differs from the religion of the polytheists, the innovators who divided their religion and became sects.

God Almighty said: {So set your face upright toward the religion, upright. It is the nature of God which He created mankind. There is no altering of God’s creation. That is the upright religion, but more People do not know - turn to Him and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of the polytheists - of those who divided their religion and became sects, each party with its own They will rejoice.” [Al-Rum: 30-32].

And God Almighty said: {And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them in a mountainous place with a resting place and a helper. - O you messengers, eat of the good things. And do righteousness. Indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do - and indeed, this nation of yours is one nation, and I am your Lord, so beware of it - so divide their affairs among them in a sect, every A party rejoicing in what they have} [Al-Mu’minun: 50-53].

And God Almighty said: {He has legislated for you of the religion that which He enjoined upon Noah, and which We have revealed to you, and that which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus, that you should establish the religion and not You will be dispersed therein. Hard for the polytheists is that to which you call them. Allah selects to Him whom He wills and guides to Him whomever turns. [Al-Shura: 13].

God, Blessed and Most High, has singled out Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, with characteristics that distinguished him over all the prophets and messengers, and made for him A law and a curriculum, the best law and the most complete curriculum.

Just as He made his nation the best nation ever brought forth for mankind, they will fulfill seventy nations who are the best and most honorable to God of all races. God guided them. By His Book and His Messenger, when they differed therein concerning the truth, He accepted them and made them a middle path, just and good, so they are middle in the oneness of God and His names. His attributes, and in belief in His messengers, His books, and the laws of His religion of commands, prohibitions, what is permissible, and what is forbidden.

So He commanded them to do what is right, and forbade them from doing wrong, and made lawful for them the good things, and forbade for them the evil ones. He did not forbid to them any of the good things. He also forbade the Jews, and did not make lawful for them any of the impurities as the Christians made them lawful, and did not restrict for them the door to purity and impurity as He made it difficult for the Jews, and did not remove from them the purity of impurity and impurity as the Christians did, so they do not require purity from impurity or impurity. Ablution for prayer, and not avoiding impurity during prayer. Rather, many of their servants consider direct contact with impurities of types of closeness and acts of obedience to the point of It is said about the virtues of the monk:
“He was forty years old and never touched water,” and for this reason they abandoned circumcision.
Although it was the law of Ibrahim Al-Khalil, peace be upon him, and his followers.

If the Jews have a woman’s menstruation with her, they do not eat with her, they do not drink with her, and they do not stay with her in the same house. The Christians do not They forbid intercourse with a menstruating woman.

The Jews did not consider removing impurity, but if someone got it on their clothes, they would cut it with a scissor, and the Christians had nothing. Impure, it is forbidden to eat it or it is forbidden to pray with it.

Therefore, Muslims are in the middle in Sharia law. They did not deny his abrogated law for the sake of his abrogated law, as the Jews did, nor did they change any of his precise law, nor did they invent a law that was not May God permit it as the Christians did, and do not go to exaggeration regarding the prophets and the righteous like the exaggeration of the Christians, nor do they underestimate their rights like the Jews did. Nor did they make the Creator, Glory be to Him, characterized by the characteristics of the creation, its contradictions, and its defects such as poverty, miserliness, and inability, as the Jews did. Nor is the creation characterized by the characteristics of the Creator, Glory be to Him, in which there is nothing like Him, like the actions of the Christians, and they were not too arrogant to worship Him. Like the Jews did, and they did not associate anyone in worshiping Him like the Christians did.

Ahl al-Sunnah and the group in Islam are like the Ahl al-Islam among the people of that sect. They are in the middle, in the matter of the attributes of God Almighty, between the people of Denial and distortion, and among the people of simile and representation, they describe God with what He described Himself, and with what His messengers described Him, without any distortion. There is no representation as proof of the attributes of perfection, and to remove Him from having equals and examples in them. Proof without representation and isolation. Without disruption. As God Almighty said: {There is nothing like Him} [Al-Shura: 11] in response to the metaphor, {And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing} [Al-Shura: 11]
In response to the disruptor.
And the Almighty said: {Say: He is God, one - God, the Eternal, He begot, nor was He begotten - and there is no one equal to Him.} [Al-Ikhlas: 1-4].

Al-Samad: the master who is required to have perfect qualities, and Al-Ahad: the one who has no equal or example, and they are the middle in the chapter on the actions of God Almighty between The Mu'tazilites who deny destiny, and the Jabriites who deny God's wisdom, mercy, and justice, and those who oppose God's commands and prohibitions by destiny, And its reward, and its punishment.

In the chapter on promise and threat, between the Wahidiyyah who say that disobedient Muslims will remain eternally in Hell, and the Murji’ah who deny some of them. The threat, and what God has given in preference to the righteous over the ungodly.

They are moderate among the Companions of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, between the extremists among some of them who claim divinity, or prophecy, or infallibility, The unjust among them is the one who declares some of them to be infidels, or makes them corrupt, and they are the best of this nation.
And God Almighty sent Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, as mercy to the people and bestowed upon him a blessing. What a blessing.
God Almighty said: “And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds” [Al-Anbiya’: 107].
And the Almighty said: “Have you not looked at those who exchanged the blessings of God for disbelief?” [Ibrahim: 28].

They are the ones who did not believe in Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. His sending is the greatest blessing that God has bestowed upon His servants. God unites his nation with the seal of the messengers, the imam of the pious, and the master of the children of Adam. All of them, He did not differentiate Him from other virtues, and He added to them various types of virtues from His grace. Rather, He gave them two guarantors of His mercy, as He said. Almighty:

{O you who have believed, fear God and believe in His Messenger. He will give you two measures of His mercy and make for you a light by which you walk, and He will forgive you. And God is Forgiving and Merciful - lest the People of the Book know that they are not able to do anything of God’s grace, and that grace is in the hand of God. He gives it to whom He wills. And God is the Possessor of great bounty} [Al-Hadid: 28-29].

And in the two Sahih books on the authority of Ibn Umar and Abu Musa, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “Your term is only for the term of those who are free from among the nations. between the afternoon prayer until sunset, but the example of you and the Jews and Christians is like a man who employed workers and said: Who will work for me for half? The day is equal to a qirat qirat? So the Jews worked until midday, then he said: Who will work for me from midday until the afternoon prayer for a Qirat?

So the Christians worked from midday until the afternoon prayer at a rate of one qirat. Then he said: Whoever works from the afternoon prayer until the setting of the sun will receive Two carats? Indeed, you are the ones who work from the afternoon prayer until the setting of the sun. Do you not have the reward twice? The Jews and Christians became angry and said, “We work more and give less.”
Then God Almighty said: Have I wronged you in any way that is due to you? They said: No, God Almighty said, for it is my bounty, I give it to whomever I wish.
As for next:

God, Blessed and Most High, made Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, the seal of the prophets, and perfected the religion for him and his nation, and sent him for a period of time from The Messengers, the emergence of disbelief, and the obliteration of paths, so he revived with it the signs of faith he had taught, and with it he suppressed the idol-worshippers of polytheism. And fires, and crosses, and with it He humiliated the infidels of the People of the Book, the people of doubt and suspicion, and established with it the beacon of His religion with which He was pleased, and praised Him with it. He mentioned those whom He chose from among His servants and chose, and revealed through them what was hidden from the People of the Book, and made clear through them what they had turned away from. The path of truth, and with it he established the truthfulness of the Torah, the Psalms, and the Gospel, and with it he removed from them the falsehood of distortion and alteration that did not belong to them.

It was part of the Sunnah of God, Blessed and Most High, to provide frequent messengers, and spread the message among people, such that He would send a messenger to every nation. So that His guidance and proof may be established, as God Almighty said: {And We have certainly sent into every nation a Messenger, saying, “Worship God and shun the tyrant”} [An-Nahl: 36].
And the Almighty said: {Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there is not a nation but a warner has passed among it.} [Fatir: 24].
And the Almighty said: {Then We sent Our messengers, you will see} [Al-Mu’minun: 44].

And God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him, and We revealed to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac. And Jacob, and the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Jonah, and Aaron, and Solomon, and We gave David the Psalms - and messengers whom We have narrated to you before, and messengers who have not We related them to you, and God spoke to Moses specifically - messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people might not have any argument against God after the messengers. And God is mighty. Wise} [An-Nisa: 163-165].

And when Adam was sent down to the earth, God Almighty said: {He said, “Go down from it, all of you enemies to one another. Then if there comes to you guidance from Me, then who Follow My guidance and he will not go astray or be miserable - And whoever turns away from My remembrance will have a straitened life, and We will raise him blind on the Day of Resurrection - My Lord said: Why? You have made me blind while I used to see - He said: Thus did Our signs come to you and you forgot them, and thus today they will be forgotten - and thus will We reward he who transgresses and does not He believes in the signs of his Lord, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and lasting.} [Taha: 123-127].

And God Almighty said about the people of Hell: “Every time a crowd is thrown into it, its keepers will ask of them: Has there not come to you a warner?” They will say, “Yes, a warner has come to us.” So we lied and said, “Allah has not sent down anything. You are only in great error.” And they said, “If we had only heard or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of the Blazing Fire.” [Al-Mulk: 8-10]
And God Almighty said: {And We will not punish until We send a Messenger} [Al-Isra: 15].

And God Almighty said: {O assembly of jinn and mankind, did not come to you messengers from among you who related to you My revelations and warned you of the meeting of your day? This is what they said. We testified against ourselves, and they were deceived by the life of this world, and they bore witness against themselves that they were disbelievers - that is, unless your Lord destroys. The towns are unjust and their people are heedless} [Al-An’am: 130-131].

chapters.title: The only religion of the prophets is Islam
paragraphs: [Chapter: The religion of the prophets is one, which is Islam] [The religion that God has chosen for Himself is the religion of Islam]

His religion, which God had chosen for himself, was the religion of Islam: with which God sent the first and last of the messengers, and it will not be accepted from No one has a religion other than himself, neither from the first nor from the last.
It is the religion of the prophets and their followers, as God Almighty told that about Noah and those after him to the disciples.

God Almighty said: {And recite to them the story of Noah when he said to his people, “O my people, if my position and my reminder of the signs of God are too difficult for you, then in God I put my trust.” So gather your affairs and your partners together, and then let your affair not be a burden to you, and then render judgment to me and do not look back. If you turn back, then I will not ask of you. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of those who submit.” [Yunus: 71-72].

And God Almighty said about Abraham: {And who would turn away from the religion of Abraham except he who fools himself? And We have chosen him in this world, and indeed he will be in the Hereafter. Of the righteous - when his Lord said to him, “Submit.” He said, “I submit to the Lord of the Worlds.” And he enjoined it on Abraham, his sons, and Jacob, “O my son.” Indeed, God has chosen The religion is yours, so do not die unless you have submitted.} [Al-Baqarah: 130-132].

chapters.title: The religion that God has chosen for Himself is the religion of Islam
paragraphs: And God Almighty said about Joseph Al-Siddiq: {My Lord, You have given me the power and taught me the interpretation of hadiths, Creator of the heavens and the earth. You are my guardian in this world. And in the Hereafter, make me die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.} [Yusuf: 101].
And God Almighty said about Moses: {O my people, if you believe in God, then put your trust in Him if you are Muslims} [Yunus: 84].

And God Almighty told us about the magicians, that they said to Pharaoh: “And you did not take revenge on us unless we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. We have patience, and we died submissive.} [Al-A'raf: 126].
And God Almighty said about Bilqis, Queen of Yemen: {My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submitted with Solomon to God, Lord of the worlds} [An-Naml: 44].

And God Almighty said about the prophets of the Children of Israel: {Indeed, We have sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light; by it the prophets judge; those who submitted to those who They were guided} [Al-Maeda: 44].

And God Almighty said about Christ: {When Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who is my helper to God?” The disciples said, “We are God’s helpers. We believe in God.” And bear witness that we are Muslims} [Al Imran: 52].
And God Almighty said: {And when I inspired to the disciples, “Believe in Me and in My Messenger.” They said, “We believe.” And I bear witness that we are Muslims.) [Al-Ma’idah: 111].

This religion of the ancients and the last of the prophets and their followers is the religion of Islam, and it is the worship of God alone without any partner. And worshiping Him Almighty at all times and places, by obeying His Messengers, peace be upon them.
So no one who worships Him will be a worshiper of Him contrary to what His Messengers brought: like those about whom he said:

chapters.title: Ruling on the difference between the messengers
paragraphs: {Or do they have partners who have legislated for them part of the religion that God has not permitted?} [Al-Shura: 21].

There is no believer in Him except the one who worships Him by obeying His Messengers, and there is no believer in Him or a worshiper of Him except the one who believes in all His Messengers and obeys Him. Whoever it was sent to, then every messenger will be obeyed until the next comes, so obedience will be to the second messenger.
God Almighty said: {And We did not send any messenger except that he should be obeyed by God’s permission} [An-Nisa: 64].
[The ruling on one who separates the messengers]

And whoever separates between His Messengers and believes in some and disbelieves in others is a disbeliever, as God Almighty said: “Indeed, those who disbelieve in Allah and His Messengers and want to They differentiate between God and His Messengers and say, “We believe in some and disbelieve in part,” and they want to take a path in between - those are the disbelievers in truth. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment - and those who believe in God and His messengers and make no distinction between any of them - these will be given their reward. God is Forgiving, Merciful} [An-Nisa: 150-152].
When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was the Seal of the Prophets, and there was no messenger after him, nor anyone who would renew the religion, God Almighty continued

chapters.title: One of the reasons for the emergence of faith
paragraphs: To renew the religion, He establishes the means necessary for its emergence, as He promised in the Book, and thus He reveals the virtues and praises of faith. Through it, he identifies the evils and consequences of disbelief.
[One of the reasons for the emergence of faith]
[The emergence of those who oppose the truth]

One of the greatest reasons for the emergence of faith and religion, and the clarification of the truth of the messages of the messengers, is the appearance of those who oppose them among the people of infidelity. The clear one.

As God Almighty said: {And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy, the devils of mankind and the jinn, some of whom inspire one another. Your Lord, whatever they have done, leave them and what they invent - and that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may listen to it and that they may be pleased with Him and that they may become close to what they are. Sufferers - Is it other than God that I seek a judge when it is He who has sent down to you the Book in detail, and those to whom We have given the Book know that it is sent down from your Lord. With the truth, so do not be of those who doubt - and the word of your Lord has been completed in truth and justice. There is no altering His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing} [Al-An’am:

And God Almighty said: {And on the day when the oppressor bites his hands, he will say, “I wish I had taken a way with the Messenger - Oh, I wish I had not taken so-and-so as a friend.” He led me astray from the Reminder after it had come to me, and Satan has always abandoned man - and the Messenger said, O Lord, my people have considered this Qur’an abandoned - And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals, and your Lord is sufficient as a Guide and Helper” [Al-Furqan: 27-31].

This is because if the truth is denied and is challenged by doubts, God Almighty establishes for him something by which he establishes the truth and nullifies the falsehood by him from the verses. Evidence

chapters.title: The emergence of opponents of the truth
paragraphs: Because of the evidence of the truth and clear proofs it shows, and the corruption of the controverting arguments that oppose it.

The Qur’an, when the polytheists denied it and strove to invalidate it in every way, even though it challenged them to bring something like it, then By reciting ten surahs, then by reciting one surah, this was what indicated to people of understanding their inability to oppose, with The intensity of the ijtihad and the strength of the reasons, even if they followed it without opposition and insisting on invalidation, their inability to oppose it would not appear. With which the evidence is complete.

And likewise the magicians when they opposed Moses, peace be upon him, and God nullified what they brought. This was from what God, Blessed and Most High, made clear of the truth of what they brought. Moses, peace be upon him, brought it, and this is one of the differences between the signs and proofs of the prophets, which are called miracles, and what may be suspected of them. The supernatural powers of witches, and the actions of Satan. There are many differences between these two, including what God Almighty mentioned in His saying: {Does I inform you upon whom the devils descend - upon whom do they descend upon every sinful predator?} [Al-Shu’ara’: 221-222].

Among them is what he explained in the verses of challenge, that the verses of the prophets, peace be upon them, cannot be contradicted with a similar one, let alone a stronger one, nor No one can nullify it other than the supernatural powers of witches and demons. It can be opposed with something similar and stronger than it, and it can be nullified.

chapters.title: Opposing the enemies of truth with their false claims
paragraphs: [Opposing the enemies of the truth with their false claims]

The same applies to all the enemies of the prophets, including the criminals, the devils of mankind and the jinn, some of whom suggest to one another the trappings of speech out of arrogance. They show from their arguments what they use as evidence against their religion that is contrary to the religion of the Messenger, and they camouflage that with what they fabricate of what is transmitted and reasonable - This was one of the reasons for the emergence of faith, which promised to appear over all religion with explanation, argument, and proof, then with the sword and the hand. And the teeth.

God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and We have sent down with them the Book and the Balance, that the people may adhere to justice, and We have sent down Iron contains great strength and benefits for people, and that God may know who will support Him and His messengers in the unseen. Indeed, God is Powerful, Mighty.” [Al-Hadid: 25].

This is due to what God, Blessed and Most High, establishes from the verses and evidence by which truth is made clear from falsehood, free from falsehood, and guidance from Misguidance, honesty is from the impossible, error is from righteousness, righteousness is from corruption, error is from righteousness, and this is like the ordeal for men that distinguishes between The bad and the good. The Almighty said: {Allah would not leave the believers in what you are upon until He distinguishes the evil from the good} [Al Imran: 179].

And God Almighty said: {Have the people thought that they will be left saying, “We believe,” while they will not be tried? - And We have already tried those before them, so that God may know those who Have they told the truth, and surely He will know who they are liars? - Or is it sufficient for those who do evil that they should precede us? How evil is that which they judge.} [Al-Ankabut: 1-4].
And temptation is a test and a test, as Moses, peace be upon him, said: {It is nothing but your temptation, by which you lead astray whomever you wish and guide whomever you wish} [Al-A'raf: 155].
That is, Your test and test, by which you lead astray those who disobey the Messengers, and thereby guide those who follow them.

The temptation for a person is like the temptation of gold when it is put to the test, for it distinguishes the good from the bad, for truth is like pure gold. The more it is tested, the better it becomes, and falsehood is like fraudulent and illuminating, if it is tested its corruption becomes apparent.

The true religion is the more the observer looks at it and the observers look at it, the more proof becomes apparent to it, the more certainty is strengthened by it, and the more faith increases in it. The believers, and His light shone in the hearts of the worlds.

And the false religion, when the disputer disputes about it and seeks to establish its leaning stick, God, Blessed and Most High, will raise up those who slander the truth against falsehood. He stings him, and behold, he is bored, and it becomes clear that his foolish owner is a detestable liar, and ugliness, corruption, and permissible things appear in him. Unity, contradiction, atheism, disbelief, misguidance, ignorance and impossibility are what make it appear to all men that their people are among the most misguided. Misguidance, until corruption appears in it that most of the servants did not know about, and those who do not distinguish He who is dead in heart does not know the good of those whom God has bestowed among the prophets. And the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and do not deny the denier of the one against whom anger is incurred and the lost, for that is what God has condemned the Jews and Christians in His Book. Such as denying the truth that is contrary to desire, being arrogant in accepting it, envying its people, being unfair to them, and following the path of wrong, And miserliness, Cowardice, hardness of hearts, and describing God Almighty with the faults and shortcomings of other creatures, and denying what He described Himself with. Of the attributes

The perfection that is specific to Him, in which no created being can equal Him, and likewise the exaggeration of the prophets and the righteous, and participation in the worship of the Lord. of the two worlds, and the belief in the solutions and the union that makes the created servant the Lord of servants, and departing from the laws of religion in actions Prophets and messengers, and acting according to the desires of the heart, its taste and what it finds in religion without following the knowledge that God has revealed in His clear Book, and taking the greatest scholars and servants as lords to be followed in whatever religion they innovate that is contrary to the prophets, peace be upon them. As God Almighty said:

{They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, son of Mary, and they were not commanded except to worship one God; there is no god but He is Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him.} [At-Tawbah: 31].

Violating what is clear and reasonable and true of what is reported, with what is thought to be divine revelations and sacred conquests, despite it being one of the And the cursed whisperer, until its owner is among those about whom God said: {And they say, “If we had only heard or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of the Blazing Fire” [Al-Mulk: 10].

And God Almighty said: {And We have created for Hell many jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, and they have eyes with which they do not see. And they have ears with which they do not hear. They are like cattle, but they are more astray. [Al-A'raf: 179].

chapters.title: Warning against following the heresies of the Jews and Christians
paragraphs: In addition to other types of heresies and misguidance, with which God condemned the People of the Book, they are what God warned this nation against. The good people, and make what happened to them an example for those with insight.
[Warning against following the heresies of the Jews and Christians]

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, informed that it would inevitably occur in some part of this nation, although he had informed, may God bless him and grant him peace. That his nation will continue to be a nation based on the truth, who will not be harmed by those who oppose them, nor by those who abandon them until the Hour comes, and that his nation will not It will unite in error, and no other nation will defeat it. Rather, it will continue to be victorious, following its Prophet, the victorious Mahdi.

But there must be someone in it who follows the traditions of the Jews, Christians, Romans, and Magians, as in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Hurairah, may God be pleased with them. On the authority of him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “You will surely follow the traditions of those before you, following the example of a speck with a speck, even if they go into a hole.” You would have entered a lizard. They said: O Messenger of God, the Jews and Christians. He said: Then who? .

And in the two Sahihs also, on the authority of Abu Saeed, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, that he said: “Let my nation take the path of other nations.” Before it, span by span, and cubit by cubit, they said: O Messenger of God, Persia and the Romans. He said: Who are the people except those?

And among those who declare Islam there are hypocrites, and the hypocrites are in the lowest level of Hell, under the Jews and Christians. For this reason, what God condemned the Jews and Christians for may be found in the hypocrites affiliated with Islam who show belief in everything. The Messenger brought it, but they conceal otherwise as esoteric atheists, not to mention those of them who demonstrate atheism.

Some of this is found among the heretics, among those who acknowledge the generality of the message of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, inwardly and outwardly, but they are suspected of it. Some of these people became suspicious, so they followed the similar ones, and abandoned the decisive, like the Kharijites and other people of whims and desires.

The Christians have misguidance in the attributes of God, Glory be to Him, and His union with creatures, in which many of these people shared, and even the atheists who He is greater in error than the Christians.
Solutions and union are of two types: general and specific.
The general: like those who say that God Himself is present in every place, or that His existence is identical to the existence of creatures.

And the specific: such as those who say that there is solution and unity in some of the Ahl al-Bayt, such as Ali, and others, such as the Nusayris, and their likes, or some Whoever is affiliated with the Ahl al-Bayt, such as the ruler, and others, such as the Druze and their like,
Or some of those who are believed to be sheikhs, such as Al-Hallajiyah and their like.

So whoever says: God Almighty has joined, or united with one of the companions, relatives, or sheikhs, then he is from this view. More infidel than the Christians who believed in unity and solutions in Christ, for Christ, peace be upon him, is better than all of them.

chapters.title: The reason for writing the book
paragraphs: And whoever believes in solutions and general unity, his misguidance is more general than the misguidance of the Christians. Likewise, he who says that the souls of the children of Adam, or their deeds, are immortal. Or their words, or their voices, or the ink of their Qur’an, or the like, so in his saying there is a branch of the saying of the Christians.
By knowing the truth of the Christian religion and its invalidity, the invalidity of what is similar to their statements from the sayings of the people of atheism and heresies is known.

So when the light of faith and the Qur’an comes, God will annihilate through it whatever contradicts it, as God Almighty says: {And say, “The truth has come and falsehood has perished. Indeed, falsehood was Wasted.} [Al-Isra: 81].
And God Almighty revealed the virtues and beauties of the truth that were true in it.
[The reason for writing the book]

One of the reasons for the victory of religion and its emergence was that a book came from Cyprus in which the religion of the Christians was used as evidence, based on what their religious scholars used as evidence. And the virtuous people of their religion, ancient and modern, from auditory and rational arguments, this necessitates that we mention from the answer what is obtained by it in a chapter. Discourse, and showing right from wrong; So that those of understanding may benefit from this, and what God has sent His Messengers with of the Balance and the Book will be made clear.
I will mention what they mentioned in their specific words, chapter by chapter, and I will follow each chapter with the answer appropriate to it, branch and root. And a contract and a solution.

What they mentioned in this book is their basis on which their scholars rely in this time, and before this time, even if it was Some of them may be more than others, depending on the circumstances. We found them relying on this message before that, and their scholars passing it on among themselves, and copies of it exist. It is old, and it is an addition to Paul the Monk, Bishop of Sidon of Antioch, which he wrote to some of his friends, and he has works on the victory of Christianity, It was mentioned that when he traveled to the Roman lands, Constantinople, the lands of the Romans, and some Frankish affairs,

chapters.title: All of the claims mentioned in Paul’s letter
paragraphs: And Romans, and he met with the esteemed people of that region, and negotiated with their distinguished and learned men, and he glorified this message, and called it (The Book The logician of the state has betrayed the one who demonstrates correct belief and upright opinion.)
[The summary of the claims mentioned in Paul’s letter]

The content of that is six chapters: Chapter One: Their claim that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was not sent to them but to the people of The pre-Islamic people were among the Arabs, and their claim was that there was evidence in the Qur’an that indicated that, and that reason indicated that.

Chapter Two: Their claim is that Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, praised in the Qur’an their religion that they follow, and praised it with what He made obligatory for them. To remain steadfast in it.

Chapter Three: Their claim that the prophecies of the previous prophets, such as the Torah, the Psalms, the Gospel, and other prophecies bear witness For their religion, which they follow among the hypostases,

And the trinity, the union, and other things, because it is true and correct, so it is necessary to adhere to it, and it is not permissible to abandon it if no law opposes it. He exalts it, but no mind can repel it.
And the fourth chapter: This is confirmed by reason, and that what they are upon of the Trinity is proven by reasonable view and transmitted law. In accordance with the principles.

Chapter Five: Their claim that they are monotheists, and the apology for the words they say that reveal the multiplicity of gods, such as the words The hypostases; This is of the type of texts among Muslims from which similes and anthropomorphism appear.

chapters.title: The author's approach to refuting their false claims
paragraphs: Chapter Six: Christ, peace be upon him, came after Moses, peace be upon him, with the utmost perfection, so after the end there is no need for a law more than The goal, but beyond that is an unacceptable law.
[The author’s approach to refuting their false claims]

We, praise be to God, point out that all the evidence they used as evidence was heard from the Qur’an, or from books that preceded the Qur’an. Or rational, so they have no proof for any of it, rather all the books along with the Qur’an and reason are proof against them, not for them, but in general. They use it as evidence from the texts of the prophets, and it is reasonable that it itself is an argument against them, and the corruption of their statement appears from it, despite the corruption it contains. All other prophetic texts, and scales that are mental standards.

Thus, in general, there is what the people of innovation use as evidence from the books of God Almighty, but in those texts it becomes clear that they have no proof. In fact, it itself is a proof against them, as similar matters were mentioned in the refutation of the people of innovations and desires, and other people of The qibla.

In general, the people’s words are similar words. They stuck to what they thought they meant, and shied away from precise and clear words. The clarification, along with the desires associated with that.

And this is the condition of the people of the interior, as God Almighty said: {They follow nothing but suspicion, and what the souls desire. Indeed, guidance has come to them from their Lord} [Al-Najm: 23].

So they are in ignorance and injustice, as God Almighty said: {And man carried it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant - that God might punish the hypocrites, male and female. And the polytheists, male and female, and God forgives the believing men and believing women. And God is Forgiving, Merciful.} [Al-Ahzab: 72-73].

The believers, upon whom God has accepted repentance from ignorance and injustice, are the followers of the Prophets, peace be upon them, for the Prophets were sent With knowledge and justice, as God Almighty said: {And when a star inclines - your companion has never gone astray or gone astray - and he does not speak out of inclination - it is only A revelation revealed} [An-Najm: 1-4].

So, Glory be to Him, the Most High, has made it clear that he is not misguided and ignorant, nor a deceiver, following his own desires, nor does he speak from his own desires. Rather, his utterance was a revelation revealed by God. Glory be to Him.
And God Almighty said: {It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions; and God is sufficient as a witness} [Al-Fath: 28].

Guidance includes useful knowledge, and the religion of truth includes righteous deeds, and is based on justice, as God Almighty said: {And We sent down with them the Book. And the balance is for the people to be just.} [Al-Hadid: 25].

The origin of justice is justice towards God Almighty, which is worshiping Him alone, without any partner. For polytheism is a great injustice, as Luqman said to his son: {My son, do not associate partners with Allah. Indeed, polytheism is a great injustice} [Luqman: 13].

And in the two Sahih books: On the authority of Abdullah bin Masoud, may God be pleased with him, when the verse “Those who believe and do not mix up their faith with wrongdoing” was revealed [Al-An’am: 82] The verse, this was difficult for the Companions of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they said: Which of us has not wronged himself? Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: It is not what you think, but rather it is polytheism. Have you not listened to the saying of the righteous servant that polytheism For great injustice? .

Since the followers of the prophets were the people of knowledge and justice, the people of Islam and the Sunnah spoke with the infidels and the people of heresy. With knowledge and justice, not with suspicion, and what souls desire; For this reason, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Judges are three: two judges in Hell, one judge in Paradise, a man who knows the truth and decides according to it, so he is in Paradise, and a man who taught the truth and decided contrary to it will be in Hell, and a man who ruled for people out of ignorance will be in Hell.” Narrated by Abu Dawood and others.

If the one who judges between people regarding their property, blood, and honour, if he is not a just scholar, he will be in Hell. So what about the one who judges in religious sects? And religions, and the foundations of faith, and divine knowledge, and universal landmarks without knowledge or justice? Such is the case with the people of innovations and desires, who cling to what is similar and doubtful, and call upon the clear and decisive text from the texts.

chapters.title: What the Christians disbelieved in
paragraphs: Prophets, and they adhere to the common destiny that is similar in standards and opinions, and they ignore the differences between them that prevent them from Joining and equivalence, as is the case with the disbelievers, and all the people of heresy and desires who represent the creation with the Creator, and the Creator with the created being, And they give God an example with mocking words.
[What the Christians disbelieved in]

This is because the false religion of the Christians is an invented religion, which they invented after Christ, peace be upon him, and changed the religion of Christ with it. Whoever turns away from the law of Christ to what they invented.

Then when God sent Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, they disbelieved in him, and their disbelief and misguidance occurred from these two aspects: changing the religion of the Messenger. The first, and the second denial of the Messenger.
Just as the Jews were disbelievers when they changed the provisions of the Torah before the Messiah was sent, and then they denied the Messiah, peace be upon him.

We will show, God willing, that nothing of the Books of God indicates what the Christians hold of the Trinity and the Oneness, neither the Bible nor anything else. Rather, they indicate The opposite of that, and no reason indicates that. Rather, clear reason and the texts of the prophets indicate the opposite of that, and so do the general laws of Their religion is a new and heretical religion, which Christ, peace be upon him, did not legislate.
Then denying Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is their disbelief known to every Muslim, like the Jews’ disbelief in Christ, peace be upon him. And I inform.

They go to extremes in excommunicating the Jews, even greater than the atonement the Jews deserve, since the Jews claimed that Christ was a magician. A liar. Rather, they say: He is the birth of sin, as God told about them when He said: {And they uttered against Mary a great slander} [An-Nisa: 156].

The Christians claim that it is God who created the firsts and the last, and that He is the Judge of the Day of Judgment. The two nations were in extreme contradiction and hostility. And the correspondence; This is why every nation disparages the other more than it deserves, as God Almighty said: {And the Jews say, “The Christians are not upon anything.” And the Christians say, The Jews are not based on anything, and they recite the Book. Thus those who do not know say something similar to what they say. God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. “Wherein they differed” [Al-Baqarah: 113].
Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned, on the authority of Muhammad bin Abi Muhammad, the client of Zaid bin Thabit, on the authority of Ikrimah, or Sa`id bin Jubayr, on the authority of Ibn Abbas,

May God be pleased with them both, he said: When the Najran delegation of Christians came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Jewish rabbis came to them. So they disputed with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and Rafi’ bin Huraymila said: You are not upon anything, and he disbelieved in Jesus and the Gospel altogether, so he said A Christian man from the people of Najran said to the Jews: You are not upon anything. He denied the prophecy of Moses and disbelieved in the Torah. So God revealed that in Their statement: “And the Jews said, ‘The Christians are not based on anything,’ and the Christians said, ‘The Jews are not based on anything,’ while they recite the Scripture.” [Al-Baqarah: 113].

He said: Everyone recites in his book the confirmation of what he disbelieved: that is, the Jews disbelieved in Jesus, and they have the Torah in which is what God took for them according to the tongue of Moses. By believing in Jesus, peace be upon him, and in the Gospel, by Jesus’ response by believing in Moses, and in what he brought of the Torah from God, and everyone disbelieves in what In the hands of its owner.
Qatada said: “And the Jews say, ‘The Christians are not upon anything.’” [Al-Baqarah: 113] He said: Indeed, the early Christians were upon something, but they innovated and dispersed.

chapters.title: Both groups accuse each other of disbelief
paragraphs: {And the Christians said, “The Jews are not based on anything.” [Al-Baqarah: 113] He said: Indeed, the early Jews were upon anything, but they innovated and dispersed.
[Each of the two groups declares the other to be an apostate]

The Jews denied the religion of the Christians, and said they were not based on anything, and the Christians denied everything that distinguished the Jews from them, even in their religious laws. The Torah, which Christ did not abrogate, but rather commanded them to act upon it, and they denied many of those who distinguished themselves from them, until they denied what Jesus, peace be upon him, brought it from the truth.

But the Christians - even if they exaggerated in declaring the Jews to be infidels and hostile to them to the extent due to what they invented of extremism and misguidance - there is no doubt that When the Jews denied Christ, they became infidels, as God Almighty said to Christ: {Indeed, I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will Those who follow you are above those who disbelieve} [Al Imran: 55].

And God Almighty said: {Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples, “Who are my helpers to God?” The disciples said, “We are helpers of God.” So a group from the children of God believed. Israel and a group disbelieved, so We supported those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious” [As-Saff: 14].

The disbelief of the Christians by denying Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and by opposing the Muslims is greater than the disbelief of the Jews by simply denying Christ. For Christ did not abrogate the law of the Torah except a little, and the rest of his law was a reference to the Torah, but in general the religion of the Christians introduced it after Messiah. The mere fact that the Jews denied him was not a matter of violating the law of God, which came in an independent book from God, which did not make any of the matters permissible. His law is based on the law of others.
God Almighty said: {Is it not sufficient for them that We have sent down to you the Book, to be recited to them? Indeed, in that is mercy and a reminder for a people who believe.} [Al-Ankabut: 51].

The Qur’an is as basic as the Torah, even if it is greater than it. For this reason, Christian scholars associate Moses with Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, as Al-Najashi, the king of the Christians, said when he heard the Qur’an: This is And what Moses brought to come out of a single niche.

Likewise, “Warqa bin Nawfal, one of the Arab Christian rabbis, said when he heard the words of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he said to him: The law that Moses brought will come to you. Oh, I wish there was pain in it, when your people expel you. Then the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Or are my evictees? He said: Yes, no one has brought anything like what you have brought except come back to me, and if your day overtakes me, I will support you with a strong victory.

That is why God, Glory be to Him, connects the Torah and the Qur’an, such as His saying: “And when the truth came to them from Us, they said, ‘Why had I not been given the like of what has been given? Moses: Did they not disbelieve in what was given to Moses before? They said, “Two magics pretending to be.” [Al-Qasas: 48] meaning the Torah and the Qur’an, and in the other reading (they said Two magicians) i.e. Muhammad and Moses.
“And they say, ‘Indeed, we are disbelievers in everything.’” Say, “Then bring a book from Allah that is better guided than them. I will follow it, if you are truthful.” [Al-Qasas: 48-49].
No book has been sent down from God better guided than the Torah and the Qur’an.

Then God Almighty said: {But if they do not respond to you, then know that they only follow their own desires. And who is more astray than he who follows his own desires without guidance from God? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people} [Al-Qasas: 50].
And these Christians, the writer of their book mentioned in his book:

When a questioner asked him to examine for him clearly what the different Christians believed, their tongues divided into four The corners of the world, from the east to the west, and from the south to the north, and those who live in the isles of the sea, and those who reside on the land that connects to The sun had set, and Bishop Damian, the Roman king, met with those with whom he had met, among their nobles and their leaders, and he negotiated with whomever he negotiated with. Their most virtuous and learned men, regarding what he learned of the opinion of the people whom he saw on the islands of the sea before he entered Cyprus, and he addressed them in Their religion and what they believe in and use as evidence for themselves. The writer said through the bishop:

They say, “We heard that a man from the Arabs, whose name was Muhammad, appeared, saying that he was the Messenger of God, and he brought a book and mentioned that it had been revealed.” upon him from God, and we did not stop until the book reached us. He said, “Then I said to them, ‘If you have heard of this book and this man, And you worked hard to obtain this book that he brought to you, but in any case you did not follow it, especially since in the book it says:
{And whoever desires other than Islam as a religion, it will not be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers} [Al Imran: 85].

They answered, saying: For various circumstances. He said: So I said: What is it? They said: Among them is that the Book is Arabic, and it is not in our tongue according to what was stated in it. It says: {Indeed, We sent it down as an Arabic Qur’an} [Yusuf: 2].

And he said: {In a clear Arabic language} [Al-Shu’ara’: 195]. And he said in Surah Ash-Shu’ara’: “And if We had sent it down to some of the foreigners - and he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it” [Al-Shu’ara’: 198-199].

And he said in Surat Al-Baqarah: {Just as We sent among you a messenger from among you, who recites to you Our verses and purifies you and teaches you the Book and wisdom. And He will teach you what you did not know” [Al-Baqarah: 151]. And he said in Surah Al Imran: “Indeed, God has bestowed favor on the believers when He sent among them a messenger from among themselves reciting to them His verses” [Al Imran: 164]. And God Almighty said in Surat Al-Qasas: {That you may warn a people. No warner has come to them before you, that perhaps they will remember} [Al-Qasas: 46].
And he said in Surah Al-Sajdah: {That you may warn a people. No warner has come to them before you, so that they may be guided} [Al-Sajdah: 3].
And he said in Surah Yasin: {That you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, for they are heedless} [Yasin: 6].

They said: When we saw this, we knew that he had not come to us, but to the pre-Islamic Arabs, who said that no messenger or warner had come to them from He accepted it, and we are not obligated to follow it. Because messengers had come to us before him, they spoke to us in our tongues, and they warned us of our religion, which we adhere to today. This, and they delivered to us the Torah and the Gospel in our languages, as this book that this man brought testifies to them, where it says in Surat Ibrahim: {And We did not send a messenger except in the language of his people, that he might make it clear to them} [Ibrahim: 4].
And he said in Surah An-Nahl: {And indeed We have sent into every nation a messenger} [An-Nahl: 36].
And he said in Surah Al-Rum: {And We sent before you messengers to their people, and they came to them with clear proofs} [Al-Rum: 47].

It is authenticated in this book that it did not come except in the pre-Islamic era from the Arabs, and as for his saying: {And whoever desires other than Islam as a religion, he will not It will be accepted from him, and in the Hereafter he will be among the losers.” [Al Imran: 85].
According to the requirement of justice, he means his people to whom he came in their language, not others to whom he did not bring what was stated in it.

We know that God is just, and it is not from His justice that on the Day of Resurrection, He will demand that a nation follow a person who did not come to them, nor did they support him in a book. By their tongue, nor by any caller on his part.

These are their exact words in the first chapter, and in this chapter they did not address either believing it or disbelieving it, but rather they claimed that In this same book, he did not say that it was sent to them, but rather to the pre-Islamic Arabs, and reason also prevents it from being sent to them.

So we begin by answering this, and we explain that he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, informed that it was sent to them, and to all mankind. And the jinn, and he never said that he was not sent to them, nor is there anything in his book that indicates that.

And the verses they used as evidence, they made a mistake in knowing their meaning, so they left out the many clear texts in his book, which show that he was sent. To them, like what they did in the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the words of the Prophets, where they abandoned many clear texts, and adhered to a few. From the similarity that they did not understand its meaning.

It is known that speech about the truthfulness of the person claiming the message and his lying takes precedence over speech about the generality and specificity of his message, even if one of them may be known. Before the last, but these people claimed the specificity of his message, and stated that the Qur’an indicates this. So we answer what they mentioned according to their order, chapter by chapter, and we say, with God, success:

Speaking about one who addressed creation as the Messenger of God to them, as Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and others who said that he was the Messenger of God did. Like Abraham, Moses, and other like them of the truthful messengers, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them all, and the family of all the righteous, and like Musaylimah the liar.

Al-Aswad Al-Ansi, and similar false prophets, build on two principles: One of them: that we know what he says in his news. And his matter, we know what he tells and commands. Did he say that he is the Messenger of God to all people, or did he say that he was not sent except to a group? One specific thing and not another?
The second: to know whether he is telling the truth or lying?
With these two principles, detailed faith is completed, which is knowing the truthfulness of the Messenger and knowing what he brought.

As for general faith, it is achieved through the first thing, which is knowing the truthfulness of what he brought, like our faith in the previous messengers, and we may know Whether it is true or false, and these people began their book with what the Messenger mentioned, which they claimed was an argument for them that it is not obligatory Following him, and praising their religion, which they follow today after abrogation and alteration, then they mentioned independent arguments for the validity of their religion, then They mentioned what is defamatory about him and his religion. For this reason, we have presented the answer to what they argued from the Qur’an, as they presented it in their book.

chapters.title: Separating the evidence of the sincerity of the truthful Prophet
paragraphs: [Chapter: Evidence of the truthfulness of the truthful Prophet]

The evidence of the truthfulness of the true prophet, and the lies of the lying prophet, are very many. Whoever claims prophethood and is truthful is among the best of God’s creation. And the most perfect of them in knowledge and religion. For there is no one better than the Messengers of God and His Prophets, may God’s prayers and peace be upon them, even if some of them are better than others, as he said. God Almighty: {Those are the messengers, some of whom We favored over others} [Al-Baqarah: 253].
And God Almighty said: {And We have favored some of the prophets over others} [Al-Isra: 55].

And if the one who claims prophecy is a liar, then he is one of the most disbelieving of God’s creation, and the most evil of them, as God Almighty said: {And who is more wrong than he who invents a lie against God? Or he said, “It was revealed to me,” but nothing was revealed to him. And whoever says, “I will send down the like of what Allah has sent down” [Al-An’am: 93].

And God Almighty said: {Who is more unjust than he who lies against God and denies the truth when it comes to him? Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers? - And he who brings the truth And those who believe in it are the righteous - they have whatever they wish with their Lord. This is the reward of the doers of good.} [Az-Zumar: 32-34].
And the Almighty said: {And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah, their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a resting place for the arrogant?} [Az-Zumar: 60].
Lying is the root of evil, the greatest of which is lying to God Almighty, and honesty is the root of good, the greatest of which is lying to God Almighty.

And in the two Sahih books: On the authority of Abdullah bin Masoud, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “You must be honest; For truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise, and a man continues to tell the truth and seeks truthfulness, until he is recorded as truthful in the sight of God. And beware of lying; For lying leads to immorality, and immorality leads to Hell, and the man will continue to lie and seek to lie until it is recorded in the sight of God. A liar.

Since this was one of the highest levels, and this was one of the lowest levels, there were differences, indications, and proofs between them that indicated the truth. One of them and the other is a lie, which is apparent to everyone who knew their situation. For this reason, the evidence of the prophets and their signs indicating their truthfulness were many and varied, just as the evidence of the prophets lying was many. Various, as has been explained elsewhere.

chapters.title: Chapter explaining the case and responding to it
paragraphs: [Chapter: Clarifying the claim and responding to it] [Their claim that the Messenger was not sent except to the Arabs of the pre-Islamic era]

If this was known, then these people in this situation claimed that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was not sent to them, but to the people of Pre-Islamic Arabs, this claim has two sides: Either they say: He himself did not claim that it was sent to them, but his nation claimed He has that.
Or they say: He claimed that he was sent to them and he is lying in this claim, and their words at the beginning of this book require الْوَجْهَ الْأَوَّلَ.
At the end of it, it may be said: They pointed to the second aspect, but in reality they did not deny his message to the Arabs, rather they denied His message to them.

As for his message to the Arabs, they did not explicitly confirm their belief in it nor deny it, even though the apparent meaning of their wording required acknowledgment of his message. To the Arabs, but they believed what they said and denied what they said.

We show that it is not valid for them to use anything that was brought by the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and then we talk about both sides together. We point out that it is not valid for them to use anything from the Qur’an as evidence of the validity of their religion, in any way.

chapters.title: Their claim is that the Messenger was sent only to the Arabs of pre-Islamic times
paragraphs: faces, and we show that the Qur’an has no proof for them, and there is no contradiction in it.

And likewise the books of the prophets of old, which they use as evidence against them, none of which are any evidence for them, even if Muhammad had not been sent. May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, so how when the book that Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, brought, agrees with all the words of the prophets, peace be upon them, in nullifying Their religion, and what they say about the Trinity, the union, and other things, with clear reason. In this book of theirs, they used the Qur’an and what the prophets before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought as evidence, along with reason.

We clarify that they have no proof for what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought, nor for what the prophets brought before him, nor for Reason, rather, what Muhammad brought, and what the prophets brought before him with clear reason, are all conclusive proof of the corruption of their religion, but We mention before that that their evidence of what came from the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, is not valid in any way, and that it is not permissible. To use as evidence the mere narration from Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, whoever disbelieves him in a single word of what he brought.

The same goes for the rest of the prophets, peace be upon them, other than using the words of other than the prophets as evidence, for that can be agreed with some of it without Some, and as for what was told by the prophets, peace be upon them, or whoever said that he is a prophet,
It is not possible to use some of them as evidence without others, whether they are believed to be true or false.

So it will be said to them according to all circumstances, whether they acknowledged his prophecy to the Arabs, or others, or they denied him in his saying that he was the Messenger of God, or They were silent about this and that, or they believed it in some but not in others.

Your protest against the validity of what you disagree with the Muslims about, from what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought, is not valid in any way; Your argument that it was not sent to you, or on the validity of your religion with any part of the Qur’an, is a refuting argument in every sense.
However, we will show - God Almighty willing - that the divine books are all based on reason, and you have no proof for any of them. Rather, they are all proof. On you.

This is in contrast to the Muslims, for their protest against the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, is valid because of what the prophets brought before them. Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, and the People of the Book are not valid as evidence for what Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, brought. This is because the Muslims Acknowledging the prophecy of Moses, Jesus, David, Solomon, and other prophets, peace be upon them, and according to them it is necessary to believe in every book. God sent it down, and in every prophet God sent, and this is the foundation of the religion of the Muslims, so whoever disbelieves in a single prophet, or a single book, it is with them. An infidel. Rather, whoever insults one of the prophets is an infidel in their eyes.

It is permissible to shed blood, as God Almighty said: {Say, “We believe in God and in what was sent down to us and what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes.” And what was given to Moses and Jesus, and what was given to the prophets from their Lord, We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him We submit. So if they believe in the same as you have believed. Indeed, they are rightly guided, and if they turn away, they are only in dissension, so Allah will suffice you for them, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing” [Al-Baqarah: 136].

And God Almighty said: {The Messenger believed in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and the believers are each who believe in God and His angels and His books and His messengers. We make no distinction between anyone. Of His messengers, and they said, “We have heard and obeyed. Your forgiveness is our Lord, and to You is the return.” [Al-Baqarah: 285].

And God Almighty said: {It is not righteousness that you turn your faces towards the east and the west, but righteousness is he who believes in God and the Last Day and the angels. And the Scripture and the Prophets} [Al-Baqarah: 177].

The Book is a generic name for every book that God has sent down, dealing with the Torah and the Gospel, just as it deals with the Qur’an, as God Almighty says: {And say, “I believe in what God has sent down a Book, and I have been commanded to do justice between you” [Al-Shura: 15].

And the Almighty says: {The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and the believers each believe in God and His angels and His books and His messengers. We do not differentiate between... One of His Messengers} [Al-Baqarah: 285].
And in the other reading (and its book), as the Almighty says: {And say, “I believe in what God has sent down of the Book, and I have been commanded to do justice between you” [Al-Shura: 15].

And the Almighty said: {This is the Book in which there is no doubt, a guidance for the righteous - those who believe in the unseen and establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided them - And those who believe in what was revealed to you and what was sent down before you and are certain of the Hereafter - those are upon guidance from their Lord, and those are they. The successful ones} [Al-Baqarah: 1-5].

So he mentioned that this is the Book which was sent down to him as guidance for the righteous, who believe in the unseen, perform prayer, and pay zakat, and who They believe in what was revealed to him, and in what was sent down before him, and they are certain of the Hereafter. Then he informed that these are the successful ones, so he limited Success is among these people, so only one of these people can be successful.

And God Almighty says: “And those who believe in what was revealed to you and what was sent down before you” [Al-Baqarah: 4]. It is an attribute of those mentioned, these are not another category, so the attachment of one thing to another may be due to a diversity of attributes, even if the essence is one. This is correct here, even though it has been said that the second category is the believers of the People of the Book.

And the first ones are the Muslims. This is weak, and even more corrupt is the statement of these Christians: The book by which what is meant is the Gospel, as will come. Talk about that, God willing.

And sympathy for the difference in attributes, such as the Almighty’s saying: {Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High - He who created and He adjusted - and He who ordained and guided - and He who brought forth pasture - Then He made it bitter scum” [Al-A’la: 1-5].
And it is He, Glory be to Him, who created and leveled, and who destined and guided, and who brought out the pasture and made it hoarse dung.

And the Almighty said: {Indeed, the believers have succeeded - those who are humble in their prayers - those who turn away from idle talk - and those who are subject to zakat. So they will do - and those who guard their private parts} [Al-Mu’minun: 1-5]. To the last verses, as well as his saying: {And those who believe in what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you} [Al-Baqarah: 4].

chapters.title: What is proven by it when the protest against Muslims is proven
