paragraphs: They are the ones who believe in the unseen, and perform prayer, and spend out of what We have provided them, and they are the ones who are on guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.

But he explained their faith after summarizing it. So that someone does not think that merely claiming belief in the unseen is beneficial, even if he does not believe in what was revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and what was revealed. To those before him, if one of the people said: I believe in the unseen, and he did not believe in some of what was revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him, He is not a believer until he believes in all that was revealed to him and what was revealed to those before him. If they were another group, the successful ones would be divided into two categories:

An oath they believe in the unseen, but they do not believe in what was revealed to him, and what was sent down to those before him, and an oath they believe in what was revealed to him, and what was revealed to those before him. It was revealed to those before him, and they do not believe in the unseen, and this is false in the eyes of all believing nations, Jews and Christians, for belief in what It was revealed to him and to those before him. It includes faith in the unseen, and faith in the unseen is only achieved by believing in everything that God has revealed. Blessed and Most High.
[What is proven by it when the argument against Muslims is proven]

And the Muslims do not permit any of them to deny anything that was revealed to those before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, but the argument For them to do so requires three introductions: One of them: This is proven to be true of the prophets, peace be upon them.
The second: the correctness of the translation into the Arabic language, or the language in which it is.

He is addressed like the Romans and the Syriacs, because the language of Moses, David, Christ, and other prophets of the children of Israel was Hebrew. Whoever says that Christ’s language was Syriac or Roman is mistaken.
The third: interpreting that speech and knowing its meaning.

For this reason, the Muslims did not reject any of the arguments by disbelieving any of the prophets in anything he said, but they might disbelieve the one who transmitted them. Or they interpret what is transmitted from them in the way they intended, or in another sense, incorrectly.

And if some Muslims may make a mistake in denying some of the transmission, or interpreting some of what is transmitted from them, then it is just as someone who makes a mistake makes a mistake. From among them, and from all the people of the sect, in mistakenly disbelieving some of what is transmitted from someone who acknowledges his prophethood, or in interpreting what is transmitted. About him.

This is in contrast to the denial of the Prophet himself, for it is clear disbelief, in contrast to the People of the Book, for their purpose is not achieved except by their denial. With some of what God has revealed, and when he denies a single word of what he told someone who said he was the Messenger of God, his argument for all of his words is invalid. So the argument they used was a refutation, and that is that the one who says that he is the Messenger of God is either truthful in saying: I am the Messenger of God. God, and in everything he tells about God, or he is a liar, even in one word about God.

If he is truthful in that, he will refrain from lying to God about anything that is conveyed to him about God, for whoever lies about God, even in a word, One: He was one of those who invent a lie against God, and he was not one of the messengers of God, and whoever invents a lie against God will become clear that he is one of the prophets. Liars.

It is not permissible for someone like this to use his information about God as evidence, for he already knew that God did not send him, and if he said something, and it was He was truthful. It was accepted as what others said, not because he conveyed it to him on the authority of God, nor because he was a messenger on the authority of God, but rather as it was accepted by the polytheists and all others. What the unbelievers say is true, for if the idol worshipers say about God what is true, such as the Arab polytheists admitting that God created the heavens and the earth. We do not deny them about that, even if they are infidels. Likewise, if the disbeliever says, “Indeed, God is Living, Powerful, Creator,” we do not deny him. In this saying.

So whoever lies about God in one word, saying that God sent it down to him, and God did not send it down to him, then he is one of the liars who do not It is permissible to use as evidence some of their sayings that they say they convey about God, Blessed and Most High, and whatever they say other than that, they are in it. Like all people, but like other liars like them, if the truth of that statement is known from someone else’s side before there is evidence for its truth, no Because they said it, even if its authenticity was not known from the perspective of others, there was no proof in their saying of it, despite the fact that it was proven that they lied to God.

Then, if these people acknowledge the message of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and that he is truthful in what was conveyed to him about God of the Book and Wisdom, It is obligatory for them to believe in everything that has been proven from the Book and wisdom, just as it is obligatory for them to believe in everything that the Messengers brought.

And if they disbelieve him in a single word, or doubt his sincerity in it, they will not acknowledge that he is the Messenger of God. That he is the Messenger of God, their argument based on what he said was the same as their argument with everything else said by someone who is not among the prophets, but rather among the liars, or It is doubtful about their sincerity.

It is known that whoever is known to have lied about God when he says that he is informing him about God, or doubts his sincerity, does not know that he is the Messenger of God, nor He is truthful in everything he says, and he conveys it on the authority of God, and if that is not known from him, it will not be known that God has sent down anything to him. Rather, if it is known, His lie was known to be that God had not sent down anything to him nor sent him, as was known to be the lie of Musaylamah al-Kaddhab, al-Aswad al-‘Ansi, and Tulayha al-Asadi. As was known, Mani and others like him lied.

chapters.title: The Messenger was truthful and infallible from lying
paragraphs: And other false prophets.

If there is doubt as to his truthfulness in a single word, and it is possible that he lied intentionally, or by mistake, it is not permissible to believe him in everything else. He informs him about God; Because his belief in what he tells about God is only if he is a truthful messenger who does not lie intentionally or by mistake, for everyone whom he sent God must be truthful in everything he communicates about God, not lying about it intentionally or by mistake.
[The Messenger’s truthfulness and his protection from lying]

This is something that all people, Muslims, Jews, Christians, and others agreed upon. They agreed that the Messenger must be truthful. He is infallible in what he communicates from God. He does not lie about God accidentally or intentionally, for the purpose of the message would not be achieved without that, as Moses said. Peace be upon him, to Pharaoh: {O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds - a decree that I do not say about God except the truth} [Al-A’raf: 104-105].

And in the famous reading: He is told that he is worthy, free, steadfast, and stable, provided that he does not say anything about God except the truth, and according to the reading The other is that he is told that it is his obligation not to say anything about God except the truth.

And God Almighty said: {And if He had uttered some words against Us - We would have taken from Him with the right hand - Then We would have severed from Him the two jaws - but there is no one among you who will turn away from Him. barriers} [Al-Haqqah: 44-47].

And the Almighty said: {Or do they say, “He has invented a lie against God?” Then if God wills, He will seal your heart, and God will erase falsehood and establish the truth with His words.} [Al-Shura: 24]

And God Almighty said: {And when We substitute a verse in place of another, and God knows best what He is sending down, they say, “You are only an inventor.” Nay, most of them do not know - Say The Holy Spirit has sent it down from your Lord in truth, that He may strengthen those who believe, and as a guidance and good news for the Muslims.} [An-Nahl: 101-102].

And God Almighty said: {And when Our clear verses are recited to them, those who do not hope for the meeting with Us say, “Bring a Qur’an other than this, or alter it.” Say, “It is not for me.” That I should change it of my own accord, that I should follow only what is revealed to me” [Yunus: 15].
There is another place for this to be expanded.

Rather, what is meant here is that their argument with a single word of what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought, is not valid in any way. aspects, for if he is a truthful messenger in everything he tells about God Almighty, then everyone knows that he has brought something that contradicts the religion of God. Christians, so if he is a truthful messenger, it is necessary that the religion of the Christians be false, even if they say in a single word of what he brought that it is false. It is necessary that they do not have a truthful messenger conveying information about God, and in that case they will say:

He is a just king, or he is a scholar among the scholars, or he is a righteous man among the righteous, or they made him a great saint among the greatest saints. No matter how much they venerated him and praised him because of what they saw of his dazzling virtues, his apparent virtues, and his pure law, when did they deny him in a word? One of what he brought, or they doubted it, they were disbelieving him in his saying: He is the Messenger of God, and that he conveyed this Qur’an on the authority of God, and who He was lying when he said:
He is the Messenger of God. He was not one of the prophets or messengers, and whoever is not among them, his statement is no proof at all, but he has an example. People like him.

If the truth of what he says is known through separate evidence, then the statement is accepted; Because it is known to be true on his part, not because he said it, and if the validity of the statement is not known, it will not be accepted. It is clear that if the one who declared it did not acknowledge it, For someone who states that he is the Messenger of God, that he is truthful in everything he conveys about God, is infallible from lying, whether mistakenly or intentionally, it is not valid. Their argument is what he said.

This principle invalidates the words of the wise people of the People of the Book, and it is even greater invalidation according to the words of their ignorant people, for many of the wise people of the People of the Book, Most of them venerate Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, because of what he called for in the monotheism of God Almighty, and what he forbade from worshiping idols. And when he confirmed the Torah and the Gospel, and the messengers before him, and because of the greatness of the Qur’an that he brought, and the virtues of the Sharia that he brought, And the virtues of his nation that believed in him, and the signs, proofs, miracles, and miracles that appeared on his behalf and on their behalf, but they say with That:

He was sent to someone other than us, and he is a just king, with a just policy, and despite that, he acquired knowledge from the knowledge of the People of the Book and others. And He established for them a law with His knowledge and rules, just as their elders established for them laws and the laws that are in their hands.

Whatever they say about this, they do not become believers in it, and it is not justified for them to use anything of what he said as evidence. Because he is known by the frequent transmission that all nations of all sects know, that he said: He is the Messenger of God to all people, and that God has revealed the Qur’an to him, and if he is truthful in that, then whoever denies him in one word has lied to the Messenger of God, and whoever denies the Messenger of God, So he is an unbeliever, and if he was not truthful in that, then he was not a messenger of God, rather he was a liar, and whoever is a liar about God, he says:
God sent me with that, but He did not send him with it. It is not permissible to use any of his sayings as evidence.

chapters.title: Responding to the People of the Book in their statement about cosmic sending
paragraphs: [The response to the People of the Book regarding their statement about the universal sending]
As for those of the ignorant People of the Book who say:

He was a king who ruled over them, and he was an angry messenger, sent by God as a cosmic messenger. To take revenge on them, just as he sent Bukhnazzar and Sennacherib against the Children of Israel, and as he sent Genghis Khan and other infidel kings. And the wrongdoers for what he takes revenge on those who disobeyed him, these are greater in denying him and disbelieving in him than those, for these kings no one said Among them is that God has sent down a book to him, nor that this speech that I convey to you is the word of God, nor that God has commanded you to believe me in what I told you about it, and you obey me in what I commanded you, and whoever does not believe me inwardly and outwardly, God will punish him in this world and the hereafter. Rather, these He sent them as a cosmic mission that He has destined and decreed, just as He sends the wind with torment, and just as He sends the devils. God Almighty said:
{Indeed, We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, causing them to attack others} [Maryam: 83].

And God Almighty said: {And We decreed to the Children of Israel in the Book that you will certainly spread corruption in the land twice and that you will declare great exaltation - so when the promise of the first of them came to pass. We sent against you servants of Ours endowed with great might, so they spied through the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.} [Al-Isra: 4-5].
This is in contrast to his saying: {Indeed, We sent Noah to his people} [Noah: 1].
And God Almighty says: {Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger} [Al-Muzzammil: 15].

And God Almighty says: {Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him, and We revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac. And Jacob, and the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Jonah, and Aaron, and Solomon, and We gave David the Psalms, and messengers, whom We have related to you before, and messengers whom we had not We related them to you. And God spoke to Moses as messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people would have no argument against God after the messengers.} [An-Nisa: 163].

This is what is meant by religious mission, which the Almighty loves and is pleased with, by which He guided those who followed them, admitted them into His mercy, and punished them. Whoever disobeys them, and makes him among those deserving of punishment, and it is the sending by which God has made obliging obedience to whomever He sent, as God Almighty said: {And what We have sent a Messenger except that he should be obeyed, by God’s permission” [An-Nisa: 64].
And God Almighty said: {Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed God} [An-Nisa: 80].

And this is the message with which He established the argument against creation, as God Almighty said: {Messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people may have no argument against God after. The Messengers} [An-Nisa: 165].
And the Almighty said: {God selects messengers from the angels and from people} [Al-Hajj: 75].
This is as the Holy Spirit chose Gabriel, peace be upon him, to send down the Qur’an to whomever of mankind he chose, and he is Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. He said hello.

God Almighty said: {Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is he who has sent it down to your heart by God’s leave, confirming what was before him, and guidance and good tidings. For the believers} [Al-Baqarah: 97].

And the Almighty said: {And indeed it is a revelation of the Lord of the worlds - the Faithful Spirit has sent it down - to your heart that you may be among the warners - in a clear Arabic language} [Al-Shu’ara’: 192 - 195].

And God Almighty said: {And when We substitute a verse in place of another, and God knows best what He is sending down, they say, “You are only an inventor.” Nay, most of them do not know - Say The Holy Spirit has sent it down from your Lord in truth, that He may strengthen those who believe, and as a guidance and good news for the Muslims.} [An-Nahl: 101-102].

So he told that it was sent down to him by Gabriel, and he called him the Faithful Spirit, and he called him the Holy Spirit, and he also mentioned it in his saying: {It is the saying of the Messenger Generous - Possessor of power near the One who possesses the throne, secure - obedient, then trustworthy} [Al-Takwir: 19-21].

Then he said: {And your companion is not insane - and indeed he has seen it on the clear horizon - and he is not upon the unseen with worry - nor is it the word of an accursed Satan - So where will you go - it is only a reminder to the worlds - for whomever among you wills to be upright - and you do not will except that Allah, Lord of the worlds, wills.} [Al-Takwir: 22-29]

This is the Messenger Gabriel, peace be upon him, and the Almighty said: {Indeed, it is the speech of a noble Messenger - and it is not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe - nor in the speech of a poet. A soothsayer. Little do you remember - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds - and if he had uttered some statement against us - we would have taken an oath from him - then we would have cut off from him. Al-Haqqah: 19-47.
This is the Messenger Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.

As for the cosmic sending that He has decreed and decreed, such as the sending of winds and the sending of demons, that is another type. The Almighty said: {Indeed, We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, causing them to attack others} [Maryam: 83].
And the Almighty said: {And it is He who sends the winds bringing good news before His mercy} [Al-Furqan: 48].

To God Almighty belongs creation and command, so the word of sending, resurrection, will, command, permission, book, and prohibition, Judgment and speech are divided into: moral, command, universal, and religious, and we mentioned sending.

As for the resurrection, God Almighty said: {It is He who sent among the unlettered people a messenger from among them, reciting to them His verses, and purifying them, and teaching them the Scripture. And wisdom} [Al-Jumu’ah: 2].
And he said in Al-Kuni: {So when the promise of the first of them has come, We will send over you servants of Ours, most worthy of mighty might} [Al-Isra: 5].
And God Almighty said: {Then God sent a crow to search the earth} [Al-Maeda: 31].

As for will, God Almighty said in Al-Kuniyya: {So whomever Allah desires to guide - He opens His breast to Islam, and whomsoever Allah desires to lead astray - He makes His chest was narrow and hard} [Al-An'am: 125].
And Noah, peace be upon him, said: {And my advice will not benefit you if I wanted to advise you if God wanted to mislead you} [Hud: 34].
And God Almighty said regarding religious desire: {Allah desires ease for you and does not desire hardship for you} [Al-Baqarah: 185].

And God Almighty said: {Allah desires to make clear to you and guide you to the ways of those before you and to turn toward you. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise - and Allah desires to He will turn to you in repentance, and those who follow desires desire that you should incline greatly - God desires to lighten the burden for you, and He created man weak} [An-Nisa: 26-28].
And the Almighty said: {Allah does not wish to place upon you any hardship, but He wishes to purify you and to complete His blessings upon you} [Al-Ma’idah: 6].
And the Almighty said: {Allah only desires to remove uncleanness from you, O People of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification} [Al-Ahzab: 33].
And God Almighty said regarding the universal matter: “His command, when He wills a thing, is that He says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.” [Yasin: 82].

Likewise, in the more apparent of the two statements, God Almighty says: {And when We intended to destroy a city, We commanded its leisured ones, but they committed transgression therein, so the word became true against it.} [Al-Isra: 16].
As for the religious matter, such as his saying: “Indeed, God commands you to return trusts to their owners” [An-Nisa: 58].
As for the universal permission, it is like His saying regarding magicians: “And they do not harm anyone therein except by the permission of God” [Al-Baqarah: 102].
The religious is like his saying: {Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good news and a warner - a caller to God by His permission and an illuminating lamp} [Al-Ahzab: 45-46].
The Universal Book is like its saying: {Allah has written, I and My Messengers will surely prevail} [Al-Mujadila: 21].
And he said: {Say: “None will happen to us except what God has ordained for us” [Al-Tawbah: 51].
And the religious is like his saying: {Allah has ordained for them} [Al-Hashr: 3].
And he said: “Fasting is prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you” [Al-Baqarah: 183].
And he said: “Retaliation is decreed upon you” [Al-Baqarah: 178].
The universal decree is as His saying: {So He decreed for them seven heavens} [Fussilat: 12].
And the religious: {And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and to be good to parents} [Al-Isra: 23].
That is: he commanded.
The universal prohibition is like his saying: {And We had forbidden to him wet-feeding places before} [Al-Qasas: 12].
And His saying: {For it is forbidden to them for forty years. They wander in the land} [Al-Ma’idah: 26].
And he said: “And it is forbidden to a city which We destroyed, that they will not return” [Al-Anbiya’: 95].
The religious is like his saying: {Forbidden to you are dead animals, blood, and the flesh of swine} [Al-Ma’idah: 3].
And he said: {Forbidden to you are your mothers, your daughters, and your sisters} [An-Nisa: 23].

And the universal words, such as the saying of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “I seek refuge in the perfect words of God, which neither the righteous nor the immoral can surpass.” . And from it is the Almighty’s saying: “And she believes in the words of her Lord and His Books” [Al-Tahrim: 12].

Religious: such as the saying of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Fear God with regard to women, for you have taken them because of God’s trustworthiness, and you have deemed lawful Encourage them with the word of God. Among them is the Almighty’s saying: {Say, “O People of the Book, come to a common word between us and you: that we worship none but Allah, and do not associate anything with Him, nor associate anything with Him.” Some of us take others as lords besides Allah} [Al Imran: 64].

chapters.title: The People of the Book differed regarding the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: This is explained elsewhere.
[The division of the People of the Book regarding the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace]

What is meant here is that the People of the Book dispersed over the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, each one saying something about him that is similar to the dispersal of the other disbelievers. It is the custom of the disbelievers regarding the prophets for each sect to say something about him that contradicts the statement of the other sect, and likewise their saying about The Book that was revealed to him, and their statements are all different and false statements, and this is the reprehensible difference that God mentioned. God Almighty says: {And they never cease to differ, except on whom your Lord has mercy} [Hud: 118].
And in His saying: {Indeed, you are of a differing speech, from which one who is more eloquent will turn away from it} [Al-Dhariyat: 8].
And God Almighty says: {And indeed those who differ concerning the Book are in far-flung discord} [Al-Baqarah: 176].

And His saying: {And do not be like those who became divided and disagreed after the clear proofs had come to them. For those is a great punishment - the Day when faces will be whitened. And faces prevail} [Al Imran: 105-106].

And God Almighty says: {And among those who said, “We are Christians,” We took their covenant, but they forgot a portion of what they had been reminded of, so We enticed among them enmity. And hatred until the Day of Resurrection} [Al-Ma’idah: 14].
An example of the words of the infidels about the prophets is what God Almighty mentioned in His Almighty saying:

{Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His servant, that he might be a warner to the worlds. He is a partner in the kingdom, and He created everything and determined it with due determination - and they took apart from Him gods who did not create anything, while they were created but did not possess. They will neither harm nor benefit for themselves, and they will have no power over death, life, or resurrection. Other people have come unjustly and falsely - and they say: He wrote down the legends of the ancients, and they will be dictated to him morning and evening - say: He who knows revealed it. The secret in the heavens and the earth is that He was Forgiving and Merciful - and they said, “Why is this Messenger eating food and walking in the markets, if an angel had not been sent down to him?” Then there will be with him a warner - or treasure will be given to him, or he will have a garden from which he may eat. And the wrongdoers say: “You will only follow a man bewitched” - see. How did they give you examples? They went astray and are unable to find a way.} [Al-Furqan:

So, Glory be to Him, made it clear that the disbelievers have given him examples, all of which are false, in which they have gone astray from the truth, so with error they cannot find a way to the truth. Giving him proverbs includes representing him with other people, and placing him in those types of which he is neither one of them, nor similar to their individuals. Such as their saying: {This is nothing but a lie that he invented, and other people helped him in it} [Al-Furqan: 4].

They represented him as a liar who seeks help from someone to help him with what he fabricates, and they represented him as one who writes down the legends of the ancients from others, and they are read to him. At both ends of the day, and he learns from those what to say, and they liken him to one who is bewitched, and likewise the Almighty says:

{And when you read the Qur’an, We will place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a hidden veil - and We will place over their hearts coverings lest they understand it. And in their ears is deafness, and when you mention your Lord in the Qur’an alone, they turn on their backs in aversion - We know best what they are listening to when They listen to you, and while they are debating, the wrongdoers say, “You are only following a man bewitched.” - See how they set up parables for you, but they went astray. They can find a way} [Al-Furqan: 45-9].

And God Almighty said: {And We have given you seven of the repeated verses and the Great Qur’an - do not incline your eyes to what We have entertained pairs of them with, and do not grieve. upon them, and lower your wing to the believers - and say, “Indeed, I am the clear warner” - as We sent down to those who divided - those who made the Qur’an a compact one - for your Lord We will certainly question them all - about what they used to do - so do what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists - Indeed, We are sufficient for you with the mockers - those who They establish with God another god; they will know.} [Al-Hijr: 87-96].
Many of the predecessors said: Those who made the Qur’an “bitten”: they are the ones who made it “bitten,” so they said magic, poetry, soothsaying, and the like, as he said. Almighty:

{So I swear by what you see - and what you do not see - it is the saying of a noble Messenger - and it is not the saying of a poet. Little do you believe - nor the saying of a soothsayer. Little do you remember - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds - and if he had uttered some statement against us - we would have taken it with an oath - then we would have cut off from it. The two hearts - for there is not one of you who are withholding from it - and indeed it is a reminder for the righteous - and indeed we know that among you are deniers - and indeed it is a regret for The disbelievers - and indeed it is the truth of certainty - so glorify the name of your Lord the Great} [Al-Haqqah: 38-52].

And he said: “Remember, for by the grace of your Lord you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman - or do they say, ‘A poet whom we await with suspicion of destiny?’” Say, “Await, for I am with you.” Who are those lurking - or do their dreams command them to do this, or are they a tyrannical people - or do they say the same thing as you say? Rather, they do not believe - so let them bring a hadith. like it, if they are truthful} [At-Tur: 29-34].
And the Almighty said:

{And it is a revelation of the Lord of the worlds - the Faithful Spirit has sent it down to your heart, that you may be among the warners - in a clear Arabic tongue - and indeed, it is in the Psalms. Of the ancients - had it not been a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel should have known - and if We had sent it down to some of the foreigners - and he had recited it to them, they would not have been in it. Believers - Thus We have caused it to penetrate the hearts of the criminals - they will not believe in it until they see the painful torment - then it will come to them suddenly and they are not aware - Then they will say, “Are we going to be given a reprieve? Are they hastening on our punishment?” “Have you considered that We gave them enjoyment for years?” Then what they were promised will come to them. “How rich.” From them they did not enjoy - and We destroyed not a city except that there were warners of it - a reminder - and We were not wrongdoers.} [Al-Shu’ara’:
Then God Almighty said:

{And what the devils have sent down - and it is not for them, nor are they able - they are cut off from hearing - so do not call upon another god with God, lest you be Of those who are tormented - and warn your closest family - and lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you - but if they disobey you, say, “I am innocent of what you do.” - And put your trust in the Mighty, the Most Merciful - He who sees you when you rise - and your turning among those who prostrate - Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing - Shall I inform you upon whom it was revealed? The devils - descend upon every wicked creature - they slander people, but most of them are liars - and the poets are followed by the deceitful - Have you not seen that they are in every valley? They wander - and they say what they do not do - except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember God much and are victorious after they have been wronged. And those who have wronged will know to what turn they will turn.} [Al-Shu’ara’:
And the Almighty said:

{And do not dispute with the People of the Book except in a way that is best, except with those who are unjust among them. And say, “We believe in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to you, and by our God.” And your God is One, and to Him we submit - and thus We have sent down to you the Book, so those to whom We have given the Book believe in it, and among these are those Believes in it, and none deny Our signs except the disbelievers. - And you had not recited before him any book, nor traced it with your right hand - then the untruths would doubt. - Rather, they are clear signs in the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none denies Our signs except the wrongdoers. And they say, “If only signs had been sent down to him from his Lord.” Say, “It is only The signs are with Allah. Indeed, I am only a clear warner. - Is it not enough for them that We have sent down to you a Scripture that is recited to them? Indeed, in that is a mercy and a reminder. For a people who believe - Say, “Allah is sufficient between me and you as a witness who knows what is in the heavens and the earth.” And those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allah, those are They are the losers - and they urge you to hasten the torment, and had it not been for an appointed term, the torment would have come to them, and it will come to them suddenly, and they do not perceive it - They urge you to hasten the torment, and indeed Hell will surround the disbelievers - on the Day when the torment will cover them from above them and from under their feet, and He will say Taste what you used to do} [Al-Ankabut:
And God Almighty said: {Or do they say the same thing? Nay, they do not believe. So let them produce a hadith like it, if they are truthful.} [At-Tur: 33].

And God Almighty said: “Or do they say, ‘He has fabricated it?’ Say, ‘Then produce ten surahs like it, fabricated, and call upon whomever you can besides Allah, if you are truthful.’” But if they do not respond to you, then know that it was revealed with the knowledge of God, and that there is no god but Him. So are you Muslims?} [Hud: 13-14].

And God Almighty said: {And if you are in doubt concerning what We have sent down to Our servant, then produce a surah like it, and call your witnesses besides Allah, if you are. Truthful - but if you do not do it, and you will not do it, then fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers} [Al-Baqarah: 23-24].

And God Almighty said: {And of everything We have created in pairs that you may remember - so flee to God. Indeed, from Him I am to you a clear warner - and do not be divided with God. Another god. Indeed, from Him I am to you a clear warner.} [Al-Dhariyat: 49-51].

God Almighty has informed us that this is the way of the disbelievers among the prophets before him, as He said: {Thus did not go to those before them any messenger except They said, “A sorcerer or a madman.” Have they reached out to him? Nay, they are a people of tyranny.} [Al-Dhariyat: 52-53].
And God Almighty said: {Nothing will be said to you except what was said to the messengers before you} [Fussilat: 43].

And God Almighty said: {And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy, the devils of mankind and the jinn. Some of them inspire to one another false speech out of deceit. Had your Lord willed, Whatever they do, leave them alone and what they invent.” [Al-An’am: 112].

God Almighty has told us that the infidels said about Moses, peace be upon him, that he is a magician and that he is crazy. Then Pharaoh said: {He said, “Indeed, your Messenger who “A madman has been sent to you” [Al-Shu’ara: 27].
And he said: {And they said, O magician, call upon your Lord for us} [Al-Zukhruf: 49].

chapters.title: Responding to the claim of limiting the message to Arabs
paragraphs: And he said: {Indeed, he is your greatest who taught you magic} [Taha: 71].

And likewise they said about the Messiah, son of Mary, as God Almighty said: {And when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O Son of Israel, indeed I am the Messenger of God to you.” Confirming what was before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad. Then when he came to them with clear proofs, they said, “This is clear magic.” [Al-Saff: 6].

And God Almighty mentioned about the Jews that they uttered a great slander against Mary, so what the Jews say about the Messiah is like the words of the infidels about the Messiah. The Prophets, and likewise the words of the infidels of the People of the Book regarding the Seal of the Prophets, Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.
[The response to the claim of limiting the message to the Arabs]
If this is known, then we say after that to whoever said that he was a messenger sent to the pre-Islamic Arabs and not the People of the Book:

It is necessarily known to everyone who is aware of its circumstances by reliable transmission, which is greater in frequency than what is transmitted from Moses and Jesus. And others, and by the Qur’an that was transmitted from him, and by his Sunnah that was transmitted from him, and by the Sunnah of his Rightly Guided Caliphs after him, that he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him And he mentioned that it was sent to the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, just as he mentioned that it was sent to the illiterate. Rather, he mentioned that it was sent To all the children of Adam, their Arabs, their Romans, and their Persians.
And the Turks, and the Indians, and the Berbers, and the Abyssinians, and all other nations. Indeed, He was sent to attack the two great creatures, the jinn and all of mankind.

All of this is from the apparent and frequently transmitted matters about him, which his companions agreed to narrate from him even though they were many, and their homes were dispersed. And their conditions, and he was accompanied by tens of thousands, whose number cannot be counted in truth except God Almighty, and that was transmitted from them by the followers, and they are The Companions multiplied in number, then this was transmitted century after century to our own time with the increase of Muslims and their spread throughout the east of the earth. And its west, as he told about that before it happened, so he said in the authentic hadith: “The earth was made beautiful for me, and I saw its east and its west. And the kingdom of my nation will reach the two sides of the building, east and west, and his call spread. In the middle of the earth, such as the third, fourth, and fifth region; Because they have the most complete intellects, morals, and fairest temperaments, unlike the two sides of the south and the north, these people have deficient intellects. Their morals and temperaments were deviated.
As for the southern side, due to the intense heat, their humors were burned, their colors turned black, and their hair became wrinkled.

chapters.title: Directing the invitation from the Messenger to the People of the Book and others
paragraphs: As for the people of the northern tip, due to the severity of the cold, their dispositions did not ripen, but rather became coarse, and they were excessive in wearing straight hair and cold whites. Which is not desirable.

For this reason, when Islam appeared, its people prevailed over the center of the globe, and they were the most just and most perfect of the children of Adam, and the Christians who were raised Those under the protection of Muslims are more perfect than other Christians in terms of reason and morals. As for the Christians who fight against Muslims who are outside their protection, Among the people of the South and North, they are weaker in intellect and morals, and because of their lack of intellect and morals, Christianity appeared among them without Islam.
[Directing the invitation from the Messenger to the People of the Book and others]

What is meant is that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, himself called on the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, to believe in him, and in what he brought. With it, as he called those who have no book from among the Arabs and other nations.

It is he who reported on the authority of God, Blessed and Most High, of the disbelief of those from the People of the Book and others who do not believe in him, and that they pray Hell, and it is an evil destination, and He is the one who ordered their struggle, and called them himself and his deputies, and then their word in the Book did not come. To us, but to the pre-Islamic Arabs, whether they wanted that God sent him to the Arabs and did not send him to us, or they wanted that he claimed that he It was sent to the Arabs, not to us. For all sects knew that Muhammad called on the Jews and Christians to believe in him, and stated that God had sent him to them and commanded him to strive Whoever among them does not believe in him, then if it is said with this that he said:

I was not sent except to the Arabs. He was a liar, a lie evident to him whether the person believed him or lied to him. What is meant here is that he himself He called all the people of the earth to believe in him, so he called the People of the Book just as he called the illiterate.
As for the Jews:

Because they were his neighbors in the Hijaz in Medina and its environs, and Khaybar, the Muhajireen and Ansar all believed in him, without a sword. Nor fighting. Rather, because of the proofs of his prophecy and evidence of his sincerity that appeared to them, they believed in him, and some harm in God had come to him who believed in God. He is well known in his biography, and many Jews and Christians believed in him during his lifetime, some in Mecca, some in Medina, and many Some of them were in a place other than Mecca and Medina, so when he came to Medina he made a covenant with those of the Jews who did not believe in him, then they broke the covenant, so he was postponed. Some of them, and some of them killed; Because of their war against God and His Messenger.

He fought them time after time, he fought the Banu al-Nadir, and God Almighty revealed among them Surat al-Hashr, and he fought the Qurayzah in the year of the Ahzab, and he mentioned them. God in Surat Al-Ahzab, and before them he fought the Banu Qaynuqa, and after these he and the people of Bayat Al-Ridwan, who pledged allegiance to him under The tree, and they were one thousand and four hundred, so God conquered Khaybar over them, and the Jews settled there as farmers, and God Almighty revealed Surat Al-Fath, mentioning In it, how can it be said: He did not mention that he was sent except to the Arab polytheists, and this is the situation of the Jews with him?

chapters.title: The arrival of delegations to the Messenger is evidence of the generality of his message
paragraphs: [The arrival of delegations to the Messenger is evidence of the generality of his message]

As for the Christians, the people of Najran, which is in Yemen, were Christians, so their delegation of sixty riders came to him and he watched them in his mosque. And God revealed to them the beginning of Surat Al Imran, and when his proof became clear to them, and it became clear to them that he was the Messenger of God to them, God commanded him, if not They respond to him by inviting them to the Mubahalah, and God Almighty said: {So whoever disputes with you concerning it after the knowledge that has come to you, say, “Come, let us call our sons.” And your sons, and our women, and your women, and ourselves, and your souls. Then we will pray and place the curse of God upon the liars} [Al Imran: 61].

When he called them to the Mubahalah, they asked to give them time until they consulted, so they did consult, and some of them said to one another: You know that he is a prophet. And that no people defame a prophet without torment befalling them.

So they excused themselves from the challenge, so they reconciled with him, and they agreed to pay him the tribute on a monthly basis, while they were young, when they were afraid of his supplication against them, because of their knowledge. He is a prophet, so they entered under his rule, just as the people of the dhimma who are in Muslim lands enter under the rule of God and His Messenger, and they were brought to him. The tribute was paid by hand when they were young, and they were the first Christians to pay the tribute.

He appointed Amr ibn Hazm Al-Ansari over them, and over those among them who converted to Islam, and wrote a famous book for him, in which he mentioned the laws of religion, and they were Under the protection of Muslims under the rule of God, His Messenger, and His deputy, Amr bin Hazm Al-Ansari, may God be pleased with him, and their story Well-known and frequently transmitted by biographers,
And the people of hadith, and the people of jurisprudence, and the origin of their hadith is known in the Sahihs and Sunnahs, as we will mention, God willing.

When the delegation of Najran came, God, Blessed and Most High, revealed the beginning of Surat Al Imran because of what had happened, and God Almighty mentioned the obligation of Hajj by saying: {And for God is the obligation of the people to perform the Hajj to the House, whoever is able to make a way to it} [Al Imran: 97].
This was revealed either in the year nine or in the year ten, as more than one of the scholars mentioned, including: Al-Qadi Abu Ya’la and others.
They said that the obligation of Hajj is proven by His saying: “And for God is the obligation of the people to perform Hajj to the House” [Al Imran: 97].
It was narrated that it was revealed in the year ten, and it was narrated that it was revealed in the year nine, and this is the opinion of the majority of scholars.

They said that the obligation of Hajj was only proven by this verse, and some of them said, “Rather, that is proven by the Almighty’s saying: {And complete the Hajj and the Umrah.” To God} [Al-Baqarah: 196].

This verse was revealed in the year six in the year of Al-Hudaybiyyah, when the polytheists repelled the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, from the House, and he made peace with them. That year, he pledged allegiance to the Muslims under the tree, and God revealed Surat Al-Fath therein. Then he returned to Medina, and God opened Khaybar to them in the year Seven days, during which Ja'far ibn Abi Talib came to him with the Abyssinian delegation, then he sent Ja'far,

And Zaid and Abdullah bin Rawahah for the Christians’ invasion of Mu’tah, then he conquered Mecca in the eighth year of Ramadan, then during the ninth year he invaded Christians to Tabuk, where Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq, may God be pleased with him, performed Hajj, and he ordered that no polytheist should perform Hajj after the year, nor should he circumambulate the House. Naked.

He added Ali bin Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, to abandon covenants, and God sent down the absolute verse of the sword regarding jihad against the polytheists and jihad against People of the Book, so God Almighty said: {Then when the sacred months have passed, then slay the polytheists wherever you find them, and seize them, and besiege them, and remain For them is every place of ambush; but if they repent and establish prayer and pay zakat, then leave their way.” [At-Tawbah: 5].

These months according to the majority of scholars are those mentioned in the Almighty’s saying: {So travel about the land for four months and know that you will not God is a miracle worker, and God is a disgrace to the disbelievers} [Al-Tawbah: 2].
The polytheists were of two types:

A type of covenant for them that is absolute and not temporary, which is a permissible contract that is not binding, and a type of covenant for them that is temporary, so God commanded His Messenger to He rejects the polytheists, the people of the absolute covenant; Because this covenant is permissible and not binding, and He commanded him to lead them in charge for four months, and whoever has a temporary covenant, it is a binding covenant. So God commanded him to make repayment if it was temporary, and some jurists held that a truce is only permissible temporarily, and he went Some of them suggest that it is permissible for the imam to break the truce while they do what is obligatory, and the correct view is the third statement, which is that it It is permissible absolutely and temporarily.
As for the absolute statement, it is permissible and not obligatory, and one has the choice between fulfilling it or canceling it. Temporary is necessary.
God Almighty said:

{A disavowal from God and His Messenger to those with whom you made a covenant of the polytheists - so travel through the land for four months and know that you will not be able to defeat God. And indeed, God disgraces the disbelievers - and a call from God and His Messenger to the people on the day of the Great Pilgrimage, that God is disassociated from the polytheists and His Messenger. If you repent, it is better for you. But if you turn away, know that you are not the one who will not be able to defeat God. And give good tidings to those who disbelieve with a painful punishment - except those with whom you have made a covenant. The polytheists, then they did not fail you in anything, nor did they support anyone against you, so they fulfilled their covenant with them until their term. Indeed, God loves the righteous - so then The sacred months have passed, so kill the polytheists wherever you find them, and capture them, and besiege them, and lie in wait for them at every place of ambush; if they repent and remain prayer, and give the zakat, and clear their way. Indeed, God is Forgiving, Merciful - and if one of the polytheists seeks protection from you, reward him until he hears the word of God, and then Inform him of his safety. That is because they are a people who do not know - how can the polytheists have a covenant with God and with His Messenger, except those with whom you have made a covenant? At the Sacred Mosque, so as long as they are steadfast toward you, be steadfast towards them. Indeed, God loves the righteous - how, even if they prevail over you, they will not watch you except and not. They satisfy you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse, and most of them are transgressors - they bought the verses of God for a small price, and turned away from His way. Indeed, what they used to do was evil. They do not regard any believer as being free of any obligation, and it is they who are the transgressors. So if they repent and establish prayer and give zakat. So, we are your brothers in religion, and We explain the verses in detail for a people who know - but if they break their oaths after their covenant and challenge your religion, then fight. The imams of disbelief, they have no oaths, perhaps they will desist - will you not fight a people who broke their oaths and intended to expel the Messenger while they were When they started with you the first time, do you fear them? For God is more worthy that you should fear Him, if you are believers.} [Repentance:
What is meant here is to mention the arrival of the Najran Christian delegation: Al-Sayyid, Al-Aqib, and those with them.

Abu Bakr bin Hazm, and on the authority of other scholars, some more than others, said: And so-and-so and so-and-so delegated with men from Khath’am to The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, after he demolished Jarir bin Abdullah, may God be pleased with him, Dhul-Khalasah, and killed those who killed Khath’am, so they said: We believe in God and His Messenger, so write a letter for us. This is because of your uniform, so they left that day, then they went to him in the garb of monks, and they greeted him, and he responded to them and invited them to Islam, but they refused, and the talk increased, and the pilgrims were among them, and the Qur’an was recited to them, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said, If you deny What I say, come, I will explain to you. So he made a settlement with them for two thousand suits in Rajab, and a thousand in Safar, or the value of each suit of uqi, and for a bare burden of thirty shields and thirty spears. And thirty camels, and thirty horses, if there is a plot in Yemen. Abu Sufyan bin Harb, Al-Aqra' bin Habis, and Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah returned to their country, and Al-Sayyid and Al-Aqib did not stay for long. A short walk until they returned to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they both converted to Islam and he took them down to the house of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, and the people of Najran remained as they were. Then Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq was appointed guardian, may God be pleased with him, and he wrote a will to appoint them upon his death. Then they struck a lord, so Omar bin expelled them. Al-Khattab from their land, and wrote for them this is what Omar, the Commander of the Faithful, wrote for Najran, that whoever among them walked said that he believed in the security of God, no One of the Muslims harmed them, and he fulfilled for them what the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and Abu Bakr wrote for them:

As for what follows, whoever they encounter, from the princes of the Levant and the princes of Iraq, let him give them enough of the land’s barren land. Whatever they do of that is charity for them. And an obstacle to them, and it was their land wherein there was no way for anyone or anyone who owed money.

As for what follows, whoever is a Muslim man present with them should support them against those who wronged them. For they are a people subject to the obligation, and their tribute on their behalf is left off for twenty-four months after they come, and they are not accountable except to those who Their affliction, which they maintained, without being oppressed or being subjected to any treatment. Othman bin Affan, may God be pleased with him, and Muaqib bin Abi Fatima witnessed, and some of them fell to Iraq, so they camped in Al-Najraniya, which is near Kufa.

And what Ibn Saad mentioned, on the authority of Ali bin Muhammad al-Mada’ani, on the authority of his sheikhs, in the hadith of the Najran delegation, is in agreement with what Ibn Ishaq, for his saying “fourteen of their nobles” agrees with the statement of Ibn Ishaq, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said:

A delegation from Najran came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sixty horsemen, including fourteen of their nobles, in the fourteen-thirteenth century. A group, to whom will their affairs be entrusted, the ruler of the people, the one who has their opinion, the one who takes their advice, and the one who does not issue anything except from his opinion. His name is Abdul Masih and Al-Sayyid, their companions, and the owner of their saddlebags and their sheep, and his name is Al-Ayham, and Abu Haritha bin Alqamah, the brother of Banu Bakr ibn Wa'il was their bishop, their rabbi, their imam, and the owner of their schools. Abu Haritha had been honored among them and had studied their books until His knowledge of their religion was good, so the Roman kings who were Christians honored him, financed him, served him, built churches for him, and expanded To him are honors due to what he conveyed to them of his knowledge and diligence in their religion. When they were directed to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, from Najran He sat down

Abu Haritha was riding his mule, facing him, and at his side was a brother of his called Kurz ibn Alqamah. Then Abu Haritha’s mule stumbled, so he said Karaz: “You are miserable far away,” meaning the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. Abu Haritha said to him: “Rather, you are miserable.” He said, “Why, my brother?” He said, “By God, it belongs to the Prophet whom we were waiting for.” Karz said to him: What prevented you from it, when you know this? He said:

What have these people done to us? They honored us, financed us, and honored us. They refused to do anything other than that. If I did, they would take away from us everything you see. His brother Kurz ibn Alqamah was on it from him until he converted to Islam after that, and he used to narrate this hadith about him as far as I heard.

Ibn Hisham said: I was informed that the chiefs of Najran used to inherit a book from them, so whenever a chief among them died, the leadership was dissolved. May God bless him and grant him peace. He was walking and stumbled, and his son said: “You are miserable far away.” He wants the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. When he died, his son had no choice but to pull and break the rings, and he found in them what was mentioned by the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, so he converted to Islam and became good. He converted to Islam and performed Hajj while saying: To you will she become anxious and burdened... while her fetus was in her womb, in violation of the religion of the Christians, her religion. Ibn Ishaq: Muhammad ibn Ja`far ibn al-Zubayr narrated to me, saying: They came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Medina, and they entered his mosque when he He prayed the afternoon prayer on them, dressed in robes and robes like the camels of the men of Banu al-Harith ibn Ka’b. Some of the Companions of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, who saw them on that day said: We have never seen a delegation like them after them, and the time has come. They use their saying as evidence: He is the son of God, for they say that He had no father who knew, and He spoke in the cradle, and this is something that was not It is made by one of the descendants of Adam.

They use as evidence their saying: the third of three, by God’s saying: So We knew, and commanded, and created, and decreed. So they say: If it were one, he would not have said anything but So I did, and I decreed, and I commanded, and I created, but he is Jesus and Mary. In all of that, according to their saying, the Qur’an was revealed. When the two priests spoke to him, he said The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to them: “We have submitted.” They said: “We have submitted.” He said: You did not convert to Islam, so they converted to Islam. They said: Yes, we converted to Islam before you. He said: You have lied. Your calling to God for a son, your worship of the cross, and your eating of pig prevent you from Islam. They said:

Who is his father, O Muhammad? So the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, remained silent before them and did not answer them, so God revealed about that what they said and their disagreement in their entire matter. Excerpted from Surat Al Imran into eighty-few verses.

More than one person mentioned the revelation of the verses because of them, as was mentioned by Muhammad bin Jarir al-Tabari in his interpretation. He said: Al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abu Ubaid said: Al-Waqa, the Crown Prince, in the language of Bal Harith bin Ka’b, says: If this bishop dies, another rises in his place.

Abu Ubaid said: Uthman bin Saleh told us, on the authority of Abdullah bin Lahi’ah, on the authority of Abu Al-Aswad, on the authority of Urwa bin Al-Zubayr, that the Messenger God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, wrote to the people of Najran: From Muhammad, the Prophet, the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. Jews and Christians.

What should be known is that the people of Najran included Christians, people of good faith, and among them were Muslims - and they were the majority - and the Prophet May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, he sent Abu Ubaidah to these and that, and appointed Amr ibn Hazm over these and that, as they reported in The two Sahih books on the authority of Anas bin Malik said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Indeed, every nation has a trustee, and indeed, trustworthy, O nation, is Abu Ubaida bin Al-Jarrah.

Also on the authority of Anas: The people of Yemen came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said, “Send with us an honest man who will teach us the Sunnah.” And Islam, so he took the hand of Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah and said: This is the trustee of this nation.

And in the two Sahihs: On the authority of Hudhayfah bin Al-Yaman, he said: “The people of Najran came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they said: O Messenger of God “Send to us an honest man.” He said: “I will certainly send to you an honest man, truly trustworthy, truly trustworthy.”
He said: So the people looked forward to her. He said: So he sent Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah.

And according to Al-Bukhari on the authority of Hudhayfah, he said: “Al-Sayyid and Al-Aqib, companions of Najran, came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, wanting to curse him. He said: Then one of them said to his friend: Do not do it, for by God, if he were a prophet, then curse us, neither we nor our descendants after us would succeed. They said: We will give you What did you ask us to send with us an honest man? He said: I will certainly send with you a truly honest and trustworthy man. So the companions of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, looked forward to her. Then he said: Get up, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah. When he got up, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said:
This is the trustee of this nation.”

Likewise, the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, appointed Amr ibn Hazm over them, and wrote for him the famous book containing the religious duties and sunnahs. Al-Nasa’i narrated it in its entirety, and the people narrated some of it in fragments.

With Islam, and this only happened after the arrival of the Christian delegation. For Ibn Saad mentioned that Al-Aqib and Al-Sayyid converted to Islam after that, and the covenant with the jizyah was only with the Christians, and the verse The tribute is what God Almighty says:

{Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day, and do not forbid what God and His Messenger have forbidden, and do not follow the religion of truth from among those who were given the Scripture. Until they pay the tribute out of hand, while they are humble.} [At-Tawbah: 29].

And this is the verse about the sword with the People of the Book, and it was mentioned about fighting them if they do not believe until they pay the tax, and the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him He did not take the jizyah from anyone except after this verse. Rather, they said:

The people of Najran were the first from whom the tribute was taken, as mentioned by the people of knowledge such as Al-Zuhri and others. It is by agreement of the people of Najran. Knowledge: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not strike anyone before the revelation of this verse as a tribute, neither from the illiterate nor from the People of the Book. For this reason, he did not apply it to the Jews of Qaynuqa, An-Nadir, and Qurayza, nor did he apply it to the people of Khaybar. It was opened in the year seven before the revelation of a verse.
He paid tribute, made them farmers, and gave them an absolute truce in which he said: We will make you acknowledge what God has made you acknowledge.

So, the first time he took it from the Najran delegation, he learned that they were coming to him, his debate with them, his argument with them, and his request for the mubahala. With them was after the sign of the sword in which they were fought.

It is known from this that what God Almighty has mentioned about arguing with the People of the Book in a way that is best, except for those who have wronged, is decisive and has not been annulled by anything. Likewise, what God Almighty mentioned about debating with creation in general, saying: {Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and beautiful instruction. And argue with them in a way that is best.} [An-Nahl: 125].
There are some people who say:

The verses of arguing and arguing with the disbelievers are abrogated by the verse of the sword; Because of his belief that ordering lawful combat contradicts lawful debate, and this is wrong, the abrogation only takes place if the ruling that abrogates Contradicting the abrogated ruling, like contradicting the command to face the Sacred Mosque in prayer to the command to face the Holy House in the Levant, And contradicting the command to fast Ramadan for the resident to choose between fasting and feeding a poor person every day, and contradicting his prohibition of transgressing The limits that he imposed on the heirs regarding the order to make bequests to parents and relatives, and contradicting his saying to them: “Restrain your hands from fighting.” Because he said:

Fight them as God Almighty said: {Have you not seen those to whom it was said, “Restrain your hands and establish prayer and pay the poor-rate?” But when fighting was prescribed for them, when A group of them fear people as they fear God, or with greater fear.} [An-Nisa: 77].

So His command to them to fight abrogates His command to them to withhold their hands from them. As for His Almighty saying: {Call to the way of your Lord with wisdom. And beautiful exhortation, and argue with them in a way that is best.} [An-Nahl: 125].
And He said: “And do not dispute with the People of the Book except in a way that is best, except with those who are unjust among them” [Al-Ankabut: 46].

chapters.title: Ways of combining debate with the People of the Book and fighting them
paragraphs: This is not contradicted by the command to jihad against those among them who were commanded to wage jihad, but the command to fight contradicts the prohibition against it and limiting it to الْمُجَادَلَةِ.
[Ways of combining debate with the People of the Book and fighting them]

As for the possibility of combining the commanded argument and the commanded fighting, there is no contradiction between them, and if they are not mutually exclusive, but rather possible Combining is not permissible by ruling on abrogation, and it is known that each of them is useful where the other is not useful, and that using them together is most effective in Promoting guidance and the religion of truth, and among the aspects that explain this: one of them: that whoever is among the people of the protection and the covenant and the trustworthy among them does not He strives by fighting, so he is among those whom God has commanded to call upon and to argue with in a way that is best, but he is not among those whom God has commanded to fight.
Second: He said: {And do not dispute with the People of the Book except in a way that is best, except with those who are wrong} [Al-Ankabut: 46].

The oppressor is not commanded to argue in a way that is better, so whoever is an oppressor who deserves to be fought and is not a seeker of knowledge and religion is one of them. The wrongdoers are those who do not argue in a way that is best, other than the one who seeks knowledge and religion, and no injustice appears from him, regardless of what his intention was. Guidance, or he thinks he is right, intends to support what he thinks is right, and whoever intends stubbornness knows that he is wrong and argues Based on this, we are not commanded to argue with him in a way that is best, but we may argue with him in other ways in which we demonstrate his stubbornness, injustice, and ignorance as a reward. Due to his work.

Third: That God, Glory be to Him, said: {And if one of the polytheists seeks protection from you, grant him protection until he hears the word of God, then inform him of his place of safety} [At-Tawbah: 6] .

This is a person who is being protected and protected, and he is one of the people of war. God has commanded that he should be rented until God’s proof is established against him, then he will reach his place of safety. This is in Surah (Bara'ah), which contains the breaking of covenants, and in it is the verse about the sword, and this verse was mentioned within the command to break covenants. So that God Almighty makes clear that such a person must be kept safe. Until the proof against him is established, it is not permissible to fight him as one would fight someone who does not ask to be conveyed to God’s proof against him.

Abd al-Rahman bin Zayd bin Aslam said: {Then inform him of his place of safety} [At-Tawbah: 6] if what we narrate and inform him of does not agree with him. So he informed him of his safety. He said: This is not abrogated.
Mujahid said: Whoever comes to you and listens to what was revealed to you is safe until he comes to you.
Ata said about a man from the people of polytheism who comes to Muslims without covenant. He said: You give him the choice of either acknowledging him, or conveying to him his place of safety.
And the Almighty says: {So reward him until he hears the word of God} [At-Tawbah: 6].

It has been known that what is meant is that he hears it in such a way that he is able to understand its meaning, since what is meant is not achieved by merely hearing a word without being able to understand it. He has some understanding of the meaning, so if he is not an Arab, something must be translated for him by which he can establish evidence against him - even if he is an Arab - and there are words in the Qur’an It is a strange language that is not his language, and its meaning must be explained to him, even if he hears the word as many people hear it, and does not understand the meaning and asks us to We must explain it to him and explain its meaning to him.

And if he asked us about a question that defamed the Qur’an, we would answer it, just as the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, did when some of the polytheists brought it to him. Or the People of the Book or the Muslims, a question they related to the Qur’an, for it would answer it on its own behalf, just as Ibn al-Za’bari answered when Christ was harsh on The gods of the polytheists, and he thought that the reason for the origin was merely that they were worshipped, and that this necessitated every deity other than God, for he He will be tortured in the afterlife, so he made Christ an example to the polytheist gods, comparing him to the branch by analogy to the root.

God Almighty said: {And when the son of Mary was presented as a parable, behold, your people turned away from it - and they said, “Are our gods better? Or is it that? They did not present it for you except as a dispute.” They are a contentious people} [Al-Zukhruf: 57-58].
So, Glory be to Him, clarified the difference that prevents the appendage by His Almighty saying: {Indeed, those to whom the best of Us preceded - those are far away from it} [The Prophets: 101].

He made it clear that what these measurers measured was nothing but pure controversy that does not necessitate knowledge. Because there is a difference between the branch and the root. If idols are made as gravel for Hell, that is an insult and disgrace to their worshipers. Other than torturing those who do not deserve to be tortured, other than when the righteous servants of God are tortured for the sin of others, for this is not what God does. God Almighty, especially among the masses of Muslims and all the people of that religion, their predecessors and successors, who say that God does not create and command except of wisdom, and he does not wrong anyone by depriving him of any of his good deeds, and he does not blame others for the evils of others, and he does not torture anyone except after sending Messenger to Him, as God Almighty said:
{And whoever does righteous deeds and is a believer, he will not fear injustice or oppression} [Taha: 112].
And God Almighty said: {So whoever believes in his Lord will not fear oppression or oppression} [Al-Jinn: 13].
And the Almighty said: {Will you be rewarded for anything you used to do?} [An-Naml: 90].
And God Almighty said: {And We will not punish until We send a Messenger} [Al-Isra: 15].

And whoever among the Muslims and other people of religion says: It is permissible for God Almighty to do everything, and that injustice is the abstainable thing that is not permitted. He comes under power, for these people say: He only knows what he will do and what he will not do based on the information of the truthful one or by custom, even if he The public uses the news of the truthful and others as evidence for what is withheld from God.

God Almighty has told us that His righteous servants will be in Paradise. He will not punish them in Hell, but rather He will accept from them the best of what they have done, and will forgive them. about their misdeeds among the inhabitants of Paradise, in addition to punishing them for the sin of others while hating their actions, and forbidding them from that, and whoever He claimed that the word “what” was referring to Christ and delayed the general statement, or he answered that the word “what” only refers to what is unreasonable. Both statements are weak, as it was explained in its proper place.
But the polytheists opposed the correct text with a corrupt analogy, so God Almighty explained the corrupt analogy and mentioned the difference between the origin and the branch.

Likewise, when some Christians cited the Almighty’s saying: {O sister of Aaron} [Maryam: 28] thinking that this Aaron was Aaron. The brother of Musa bin Imran, and that this Imran is Imran, the father of Mary, the mother of the Messiah. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was asked about that. He replied That this Aaron is not that one, but they were called the names of the prophets and the righteous.

Some ignorant Christians slander the Qur’an like this, and this person who is extremely ignorant does not know that some people knew that Moses And Jesus for a very long time did not allow Moses and Aaron to be without the Messiah, and this is something that is not hidden from even the least followers of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace, in addition to being hidden from Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.

This question is among what was reported by the people of Najran, as was proven “on the authority of Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent me To the people of Najran, and they said: Do you not recite {O sister of Aaron} [Maryam: 28], and you have known what was between Moses and Jesus, so I did not know what to answer them, So I returned to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and told him, and he said: Did you not tell them that they were called by the names of their prophets? And the righteous before them? .

This question is the question of the one who challenges the Qur’an when the infidel people of Najran mentioned it to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he did not answer them. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, responded to him, and he did not say to them: You have nothing with me except the sword, nor did he say: You have broken the covenant, if they had. They made a covenant with him, and it was known that the people of Najran did not send a messenger to them except that jihad was commanded for him.

The Muslims used to ask him questions, just as Umar asked him in the year of Hudaybiyyah, when he made peace with the polytheists and did not enter Mecca, so he said To him: Didn't you tell us that we would come to the House and circumambulate it? He said: Yes, I told you that you would come to it this year? He said: No. He said: You will come to him and go around him.

Likewise, Abu Bakr answered him, and he had not heard the answer of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to him. It is known that the timing of that is not apparent from the wording. In general, but the questioner thought something that the word does not indicate.

Likewise, when he said: Whoever is to be judged will be punished. “Aisha said to him: Did not God say: {But as for him who is given his book in his oath, he will be brought to account.” An easy reckoning} [Al-Inshiqaq: 7].
He said: That is the accident, and whoever is discussed with the account will be punished.
It is known that the simple account does not deal with the one who discussed it, and he added more explanation to it, so he told that it is the offer, not the interview involved. For discussion.

Likewise, when he said: “No one who has pledged allegiance under a tree will enter Hell.” Hafsa said to him: Did not God say: {And there is not among you but And enter it} [Maryam: 71]. He answered her by saying: “Then We will save those who feared Him and leave the wrongdoers therein crouching” [Maryam: 72] »

So, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, he made it clear that these are the ones who will enter Hell, and this entry is what he denied from the people of Al-Hudaybiyyah. Al-Wurud is the passage of people on the path, as explained in the authentic hadith: the hadith of Jabir bin Abdullah, and this passage is not called entry. With which He rewards the disobedient, and wards off the righteous, and there are many such things.

As for what is in the Qur’an regarding the sayings of the infidels, their arguments, and their answers, this is very large. Sometimes it debates with them regarding monotheism. Sometimes in the prophecies, sometimes in the Day of Resurrection, and sometimes in the laws with the best and most complete arguments, as God Almighty said: {And those who disbelieve say, “If only He had not sent down upon him is the Qur’an, in one sentence. Thus, that We may strengthen your heart therewith, and We recited it in a chant - and they never bring you an example except that We have brought to you the truth and what is best. As an explanation} [Al-Furqan: 32-33].

God, Blessed and Most High, told us about those of the determined Messengers arguing with the infidels, and God Almighty said: {They said, “O Nuh! You have argued with us, and you have increased in number.” Our argument} [Hud: 32].

He said about Al-Khalil: “And his people argued with him, saying, ‘Do you dispute with me about God when He has guided me?’” [Al-An’am: 80]. To his saying: {And this is Our proof which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise in ranks whom We will} [Al-An’am: 83].

And God Almighty commanded Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, to argue in a way that is best, and He, Glory be to Him, condemned those who argue without knowledge or in the truth. After it became clear, and whoever argues with falsehood: {Here you are, you have argued about what you have knowledge of, so why do you argue about what you have no knowledge, by God? He knows while you do not know” [Al Imran: 66].
And God Almighty said: {They dispute with you about the truth after it has become clear} [Al-Anfal: 6].
And God Almighty said: {And they disputed with falsehood to refute therewith the truth. So I seized them. So what was the punishment?} [Ghafir: 5].
This is the argument mentioned in his saying: {No one disputes about the verses of God except those who disbelieve} [Ghafir: 4].

And when the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was arguing with the infidels after the command to fight was sent down, God Almighty commanded him to give protection to the one who seeks help until he listens.
