He left a huge piece of rubbish on the rock, so he ordered the rubbish to be swept up, the mosque to be cleaned, he ordered its construction, and he placed his prayer place in its front. Then he returned to Medina, and his story is famous in the Book of Conquests. Then he came a second time to the land of the Levant when it was conquered, so he stipulated that the tax be levied and imposed Money, and he made a stipulation with the people of the Dhimma on the conditions of the Muslims, so the Muslims after him fulfilled it.
It was mentioned by biographers and others. Sufyan al-Thawri narrated, on the authority of Masruq, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman ibn Ghanam, who said:

I wrote to Omar bin Al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, when he made peace with the Christians of the Levant, and stipulated that they should not establish a monastery in their city or around it. Nor a church, nor a cell, nor a monk’s cell. They do not renovate what was ruined, nor do they prevent their churches from being inhabited by any Muslim for three nights. They feed them, they do not harbor a spy, they do not conceal anything to deceive the Muslims, they do not teach their children the Qur’an, they do not reveal polytheism, and they do not prevent people from Their closeness to Islam if they want it, and that they should respect the Muslims, and stand up for them if they want to sit, and not imitate the Muslims. With any of their clothing, such as a cap, turban, sandals, or hairpiece, and they should not wear Muslim names, nor wear their surnames, nor They shall ride saddles, and shall not girdle themselves with a sword, nor carry any weapon.

They shall not engrave their rings in Arabic, nor sell alcohol, nor shall they cut off the crowns of their heads, nor shall they adhere to their dress wherever they are. And they should tighten the belts, and they should not be near Muslims with their dead, and they should not strike the gong except lightly, and they should not raise their voices when reciting. In their churches in the presence of Muslims, and they do not go out on Palm Sunday, and they do not raise their voices with their dead, and they do not raise fires with them, nor They buy from slaves whatever the arrows of the Muslims have passed on them, but if they violate any of the conditions they have stipulated, then they have no obligation, and whatever of them is permissible for the Muslims. He is free from the people of stubbornness and discord.
Narrated by Abu Dawud in his Sunan.

Abu Ubaid said in the Book of Funds: Al-Nadr bin Ismail told us, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman bin Ishaq, on the authority of Khalifa bin Qays, who said: It was Omar ibn al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, commanded, “I write to the people of the cities regarding the People of the Book: that they should have their forelocks cut off, and that they should tie their forelocks.” The caskets in their midst; So that their dress may be recognized from the dress of the People of the Book.

Abu Al-Mundhir and Mus’ab bin Al-Miqdam both told us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Ubayd Allah bin Omar, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Aslam, he said: He wrote Omar instructed the commanders of the soldiers to seal the necks of the dhimmis.

Abu Ubaid said: Abdul Rahman told us, on the authority of Abdullah bin Omar, on the authority of Nafi’, on the authority of Aslam: Omar ordered the people of the dhimma to be rewarded. Their forelocks, and that they should ride on the palms, and that they should ride casually, not as Muslims ride, and that they should be tied around the belts.
Abu Ubaid said: He means sashes.

Just as Omar ibn al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, wrote these conditions for the people of the dhimma and they adhered to them, he recommended them to his deputies and those who come after him. From the caliphs and others, and this is the justice that God and His Messenger have commanded.

In Sahih Al-Bukhari, on the authority of Omar Ibn Al-Khattab, he said in his sermon upon his death: I recommend to the Caliph after me under the protection and protection of God His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, asked them to fulfill their covenant, and to fight those behind them, and to burden them only with what they could bear.

This is in compliance with the saying of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Except for whoever wrongs a person who has made a contract with him, or deprives him of his right, or burdens him beyond what he can bear, or He took something from him against his will, so I will be his plea on the Day of Resurrection.” Narrated by Abu Dawood.
This was the case with regard to the Christians who paid the jizyah to him.

When Omar ibn al-Khattab conquered the Levant and they paid him tribute by hand while they were young, many of them surrendered, many of them incalculable in number. Except for God, Blessed and Most High, for the common people, farmers, and others were generally Christians, and there was no one among the Muslims who worked as a farmer, nor did he The Muslims in Damascus had a mosque in which they could pray, except one mosque for their minority. Then most of the people of the Levant and others became Muslims voluntarily. Not by force, for forcing the people of the Dhimmah to embrace Islam is not permissible, as God Almighty said:

{There is no compulsion in religion. Rightliness has been clearly distinguished from error. So whoever disbelieves in the tyrant and believes in God has certainly held fast to the most trustworthy handhold. A separation for it, and God is All-Hearing, All-Knowing - God is the Guardian of those who believe, He brings them out of darkness into light, and those who disbelieve, their guardians are the tyrant. They bring them out from the light into the darkness. These are the inmates of the Fire, wherein they will abide.} [Al-Baqarah: 256-257].

Abu Ubaid said in the Book of Money, on the authority of Ibn al-Zubayr, who said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, wrote to the people of Yemen: “He is the one who has embraced Islam.” Whether he is a Jew or a Christian, then he is one of the believers. He will have what they have and upon him what they owe, and whoever is a follower of Judaism or Christianity, then he is not He will be subjected to tribulation on its behalf, and he will have to pay the tribute.”

chapters.title: Chapter on sending books and messengers to the Persian kings
paragraphs: [Chapter: Sending letters and messengers to the Persian kings]

Omar ibn al-Khattab fought the Persian Magians and conquered their land, and it appeared that the news of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was believed, as he said: “If he perished... Chosroes, then there will be no Chosroes after him, and if Caesar dies, there will be no Caesar after him, and by the One in whose hand is my soul, their treasures will be spent in the cause of God Almighty.” He included it in the two Sahih books.

This was after the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent his messenger to the Magians, and wrote a letter to Chosroes, king of Persia, just as he wrote to Christian kings, as previously mentioned about Caesar and Al-Muqawqis, but the Christian kings were polite to him and submitted to him, so their king remained. As for the king of the Persians, he tore up his letter, so he supplicated against them and said: “O God, tear their kingdom to pieces,” so there was no king left for them.

Ibn Abbas said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent Abdullah bin Hudhafa with his letter to Khosrau, and he brought him to the great Bahrain, so the Great of Bahrain gave it to Khosrau, and when he read it, meaning Khosrau, he tore it up, so the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, called upon them to They will be torn apart.”

Ibn Ishaq said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, wrote to Chosroes and Caesar. As for Chosroes, when he read the letter, he tore it up, and as for Caesar When he read the letter, he folded it and placed it with him. This was reported to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he said: “As for these, meaning Khosrau They will be torn asunder, but of these there will be a remnant.”
Ibn Ishaq said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent Abdullah bin Hudhafah bin Qays al-Sahmi to Khosrau bin Hurmuz, king of The Persians, and he wrote:

“In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, from Muhammad, the Messenger of God, to Chosroes the Great of Persia, peace be upon whoever follows guidance and believes in God and His Messenger, I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I invite you with the call of God, for I am the Messenger of God. God to all people; That I may warn whoever is alive and that the word is valid against the disbelievers, so submit and be safe, but if you refuse, then the sin of the Magi is upon you.”
When he read the letter of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, he tore it open and said: Will he write to me with this letter while he is my servant?

I said: The reason for Khosrow’s saying this is his arrogance: The Abyssinians had owned Yemen, and their king rode to Mecca by elephant. To destroy the house, and they were Christians, so God sent against them from the direction of the sea, Ababil birds, which are groups in groups carrying stones of Clay, then she threw it on the Christian Abyssinians and destroyed them, and this was a great sign by which the nations submitted to the House and the neighbors of the House.

The wise people knew that this was not a victory from God for the Arab polytheists. The religion of the Christians is better than their religion, but it was a support for the House and the Muslim nation that venerates it, and for the Prophet sent from the House, and it was That was the year of the birth of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and God revealed about that: “Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? Has He not put their plot in misguiding - and sent upon them flocks of birds - pelting them with stones of clay - so He made them like edible chaff.} [Al-Fil: 1-5].

Then Saif bin Dhi Yazan went to Khosrau and asked him for an army to invade Abyssinia, so he sent with him an army of Persians and Magians. So they expelled the Abyssinians from Yemen, and Yemen became in the hands of the Arabs, and there was Khosrau’s representative, and this Saif bin Dhi Yazan was one of those who preached the good news of the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. May God bless him and grant him peace before his appearance, and he told his grandfather Abdul Muttalib about that when he came to see him.

Since Yemen was obedient to Chosroes, that is why he sent to his representative in Yemen to bring him the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Because the Yemeni military usually defeats the people of Mecca and Medina.
Ibn Ishaq said: I was informed that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “May God tear apart his kingdom” when he was informed that he had torn his book.

Then Khosrau wrote to Badhan - while he was in Yemen - to send two flogged men to this man who is in the Hijaz. Let him be brought to me. He said: So he sent Badhan Qahraman, who was a papal man, and someone else said: Fayrouz al-Dailami, who was an accountant and scribe, and he was sent with him. With a man from the Persians, he wrote with them to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, ordering him to go with them to Chosroes, and he said to his two papists: Woe to you, see what the man is and speak to him and bring me his news.

He said: So they went out until they came to Taif and asked about the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they said: He is in Medina, and they rejoiced, meaning the infidels, and said: Khosrau set up a position for him like a man, so they went out and reached the front of Medina to meet the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he spoke to him through his two doors and said:

The Shahenshah, King of Kings, Khosrau, wrote to King Badhan ordering him to send to you someone who will bring you, and he has sent me to you. So go with me, and if you do, he will write with you to the King of Kings with a letter that will benefit you and he will spare you with it, but if you refuse, then he is the one you have known, and he is He will destroy you and destroy your people and destroy your country.

They had entered upon the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, having shaved their beards and kept their mustaches so that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, looked at them. May God bless him and grant him peace, and he said to them: “Woe to you, who commanded you to do this?” They said: Our Lord commanded us to do this - meaning Chosroes - and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to them, “But my Lord, the Almighty and Majestic, commanded me to spare My beard and trim my moustache.” Then he said to them, “Go back and come to me tomorrow.”

He said: And the news came from heaven: that God Almighty gave power over Chosroes his son Sherawayh, and killed him in such-and-such a month, in such-and-such a night, at such-and-such an hour. Thus, when they came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said to them: “Indeed, my Lord killed your Lord on such-and-such night, in such-and-such month, after some time had passed.” That night, his son Shiroyah attacked him and killed him. They said to him: Do you know what you are saying? We have taken revenge on you. What is easier than this, so we write this on your behalf and tell the king about it? He said:

“Yes, tell him that about me, and tell him that my religion and my authority will reach the extent of the reign of Chosroes, and will end to the utmost level of the hoof and the hoof. And say to him: If you submit, I will give you what is under your control and make you king over your people’s sons. He gave his companion a girdle of gold and silver that some king had given him, so they left him and went to Badhan and told him. The news.

He said: By God, these are not the words of an angel. Indeed, I see the man as a prophet as he says, and let us see what he said. If what he said was true, it would not be true. There was still talk about him that he was a prophet sent, and if not, then we will see our opinion about him. It was not long before Adhaan was presented to him with a letter from Shiroyah: As for what follows, For I killed Khosrau, and I did not kill him except out of anger for Persia, since he had made it permissible to kill their nobles and prepare them for their mission. This letter of mine has come to you, so obey me from those before you, and see the man about whom Chosroes wrote to you, and do not ignore it until my command regarding it comes to you.
When Sherawayh’s letter to Badhan ended, he said: This man is the Messenger of God, and he submitted to God, and the sons of Persia, whoever he was, submitted to God. In Yemen.

Abu Ma’shar said: Al-Maqbari told me, saying: Fayrouz Al-Dailami came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: Chosroes wrote to Badhan: I have heard that in your land there is a man who prophesied, so tie him up and send him to me. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him:

“Indeed, my Lord was angry with your Lord, and He killed him, and his blood became hot at that time.” So he left him and heard the news, so he converted to Islam and his Islam was good. He was a righteous man who had many beautiful deeds in Islam, including killing the liar, the black lion who claimed prophethood during the time of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace be upon him. Al-Aswad was a tyrant. He summoned Abu Muslim Al-Khawlani and said to him: Do you bear witness that I am the Messenger of God? Abu Muslim said: I do not hear. He said to him: Do you bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God? He said: Yes.

He repeated this to him several times, so he ordered a great fire to be kindled, then he ordered Abu Muslim to be thrown into it, but it did not harm him, so God Almighty extinguished it. When he was thrown into it, it was said to him: Get this man out of your land. So that your followers do not corrupt you, take him out.

So Abu Muslim came to Medina, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, had died, and Abu Bakr was appointed as his successor, so he stopped his camel at the gate. The mosque, then he entered the mosque and stood praying to a pole, then Omar saw him, so he got up to him and said: Who is the man? He said: From the people of Yemen. He said: What did the one who was burned by the liar do? He said: That is Abdullah bin Thub. He said: I asked you by God, are you the one? He said: Oh God, yes. So he embraced him, then wept, then took him and made him sit between him and Abu Bakr, and said:

Praise be to God who did not let me die until he showed me in the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, someone who had done to him what he had done to Abraham, the friend of the Most Gracious.

Then Fayrouz Al-Dailami went out against Al-Aswad Al-Ansi and killed him, and the news reached the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he had been killed while he was ill. His death, so he went out and told his friends. He said: “Tonight, Al-Aswad Al-Ansi killed a righteous man from a righteous people.” His story is famous, as is the story of Musaylimah al-Kadzhab and other similar false prophets.

chapters.title: Chapter on how he, may God bless him and grant him peace, imposed the tax on the Magians
paragraphs: [Chapter: His, may God bless him and grant him peace, imposed the tax on the Magians]

When the successors of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, Omar and Uthman, conquered Iraq and Khorasan, they imposed a tribute on the Magians, just as they imposed it on the Christians. After they called them to Islam, as the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, called them, and just as the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, imposed the tax. against the Jews, Christians, and Magians after he called them to God Almighty, for he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, sent Al-Ala’ bin Al-Hadrami to Al-Mundhir bin Sawa Al-Abdi, the owner of Hajar - a village in Bahrain - in his book, may God bless him and grant him peace, inviting him to Islam, he said Al-Ala:

When I entered upon him, I said: O Mundhir, you are of great intellect in this world, so do not belittle the Hereafter. This Magianism is an evil of religion. Therein the Arabs are honored, and the People of the Book do not know. They marry what they are too embarrassed to marry, and they eat what they are too embarrassed to eat, and they worship in This world is a fire that will consume them on the Day of Resurrection, and you are not devoid of reason or opinion. So consider whether it is appropriate for someone who does not lie to believe him, and for whom He does not betray his trust, and to him who does not deceive, you must trust him. If this is so, this is he.

The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, is an illiterate person who - by God - no rational person can say: I wish that what he commanded he had forbidden, or what he forbade. He commanded it, or I wish it had increased his pardon or decreased his punishment. Indeed, that is from him upon the wish of the people of reason and the thinking of the people of insight.

Al-Mundhir said: I looked at this that is in my hand and found that it is for this world and not the hereafter, and I looked at your religion and found that it is for the hereafter. And the world, so what prevents me from accepting a religion that contains the security of life and the comfort of death, and yesterday I was amazed by those who accepted it, and today I am amazed by those who accept it. He returns it, and among the veneration of the one who brings it is that he venerates his Messenger, and I will see. Then Al-Mundhir surrendered and wrote to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. With Islam and charity.

Amr bin Awf said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, sent Abu Ubaidah to Bahrain, and he brought its tribute, and he was the messenger of May God bless him and grant him peace. He reconciled with the people of Bahrain, and he appointed Al-Ala’ bin Al-Hadrami over them, so Abu Ubaidah came with money from Bahrain. Then the Ansar heard of the arrival of Abu Ubaidah, so they performed the morning prayer with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. When he led the dawn prayer with them, he left, so they confronted Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, smiled when he saw them and said:

I think you have heard that Abu Ubaidah had brought something. They said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: Give good tidings and hope for what pleases you. By God, it is not poverty that I fear for you, but rather I fear that the world will be extended to you as it has been extended to me. Whoever was before you, then you will compete with it as they competed with it, and it will destroy you as it destroyed them.” He included it in the two Sahih books.

Al-Bukhari narrated, on the authority of Bajalah bin Abdah, that he said: “A letter came to us from Omar bin Al-Khattab a year before his death: Distinguish between all those who Forbidden by the Magians. It was not until Umar took the tribute from the Magians that Abd al-Rahman bin Awf testified that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, took it from Magi Hajar.”

Ibn Shihab said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, took the tax from the Magians of Hijra, and Omar bin Al-Khattab took the tax from Magi of Persia, and Othman bin Affan took it from the Berbers.

Ibn Shihab said: The first people to pay the jizyah among the People of the Book were the people of Najran, as far as we have been informed, and they were Christians, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, accepted it. May God bless him and grant him peace, the tribute was paid by the people of Bahrain, who were Magians, then the people of Ayla paid it.

The people of Adharh paid tribute to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, in the Battle of Tabuk, and he sent Khaled ibn al-Walid to the people of Duma. Al-Jandal, so they captured their leader, Ukider, and pledged allegiance to him on the basis of tribute.
Abu Ubaid said: The jizyah is taken from the People of the Book by revelation, and from the Magians, Berbers, and others according to the Sunnah.

chapters.title: Separating the evidence of the Qur’an and Sunnah on the generality of his message, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: Evidence from the Qur’an and Sunnah on the generality of his message, may God bless him and grant him peace.]

Muslim narrated on the authority of Anas: “The Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, wrote to Chosroes, Caesar, and the Negus, and to every tyrant, calling them to God.” Almighty - and not by the Negus who mourned for his companions on the day he died, and took them out to the prayer place, then lined up and prayed over him - rather, by the Negus. Another took possession after him.

Muslim narrated on the authority of Abu Hurairah: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “I was preferred over the prophets in six ways: I was given comprehensive speech. And I was victorious through terror, and the spoils were made permissible for me, and the earth was made for me a place of mosque and purification, and I was sent to all people, and the prophets were sealed with me.”
And he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “The Prophet was sent to his people specifically, and I was sent to the people in general.”
And God Almighty said: {Say, O people: Indeed, I am the Messenger of God to you all, to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth} [Al-A’raf: 158].
And God Almighty said: {And We have not sent you except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner to mankind} [Saba: 28].

And in the Qur’an, there is a call to the People of the Book, including the Jews and Christians, and a call to the polytheists, the idol worshipers, and all mankind and the jinn. What cannot be counted except at a cost,

All of this is known by necessity from the religion of Islam, so how can it be said: It was not mentioned that he was sent except to the Arabs in particular, and this His call, his messengers, and his jihad against the Jews, Christians, and Magians after the polytheists, and this is his conduct, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, among them?

Also, in the book that is frequently transmitted from him, which is the Qur’an, his call to the People of the Book to believe in him is mentioned in very many places. On it, God, Blessed and Most High, mentions the disbelief of those who disbelieve among the Jews and Christians, and commands on it that they be fought, as God Almighty says: {Indeed, those who disbelieved They said, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, the son of Mary.” Say, “Who can have anything in relation to God if He wanted to destroy the Messiah, the son of Mary, and his mother, and all that is on earth?” All of them. To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He creates whatever He wills, and God has power over all things.} [Al-Maeda: 17].
And he also said in this Surah:

{Indeed, those who say, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, son of Mary” have disbelieved. And the Messiah said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord. Indeed, it is he who associates others with God.” By God, God has forbidden to him Paradise, and his abode is the Fire, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. - Indeed, those who say that God is the third of three have disbelieved, and there are no There is no god but one God, and if they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will certainly befall those who disbelieve among them - so will they not repent to God? And they seek His forgiveness, and God is Forgiving, Merciful - The Messiah, the son of Mary, is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother is a truthful one. They used to eat Food: See how We make clear to them the signs, then see how they are misled - Say, “Do you worship besides God that which possesses for you no harm or benefit, and God is He The All-Hearing, the All-Knowing - Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the desires of a people who went astray before, and have misled many, and gone astray.” On the straight path} [Al-Maeda:
And God Almighty said in Surah An-Nisa:

{O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about God except the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is the Messenger of God, and His word which He delivered to Mary and a spirit from him. Believe in God and His messengers, and do not say: “Desist is better for you.” Indeed, God is one God. Glory be to Him, to have a son from Him. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and God suffices as a disposer of affairs. The Messiah will not refrain from being a servant of God, nor will the angels who are close to Him and others. If he refrains from worshiping Him and becomes arrogant, then He will gather them all to Himself - but as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full. And He will increase them of His bounty. But as for those who disdain and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves, besides Allah, no guardian or helper.} [Women:

And God Almighty said: {Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day, and do not forbid what God and His Messenger have forbidden, and do not follow the religion of truth from among those They were given the Scripture until they were given the tribute out of hand, but they were submissive.} [At-Tawbah: 29].

And God Almighty said: {And the Jews said, “Uzair is the son of God,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of God.” That is what they said with their mouths, imitating the words of Those who disbelieved before, God killed them. How will they be failed? - They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, the son of Mary, and what They were commanded to worship only one God; there is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him. They want to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God refuses. Unless His light is perfected, even if the disbelievers dislike it} [Al-Tawbah: 30-32].

chapters.title: Chapter on the innovations of the Jews and Christians in their religion
paragraphs: [Chapter: The innovation of the Jews and Christians in their religion]

These and weaker pieces of evidence are from what has become clear that he himself, may God bless him and grant him peace, informed that he was the Messenger of God to the Christians and others. The People of the Book, and that he called them and strove against them and commanded their call and struggle, and this is not an innovation that his nation did after him. They invented it, as the Christians did after Christ, peace be upon him, for Muslims do not permit anyone after Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, to They change something from His law, so that what is forbidden is not permitted, nor is it forbidden what is permissible, nor is it obligatory for what it has decreed, nor is it forbidden for what it has made obligatory. Rather, what is permissible for them is what is permissible for them. God and His Messenger have made it lawful, what is forbidden is what God and His Messenger have forbidden, and religion is what God and His Messenger have made lawful, in contrast to the Christians who were innovated after Christ. Heresies that Christ, peace be upon him, did not legislate, and none of the Gospels or the previous books of the prophets spoke of them. They claimed that what he legislated The greatest of them in religion, Christ will grant it to them. This is a place where the three sects of Muslims, Jews, and Christians disputed, as They disputed about Christ, peace be upon him, and other things.
The Jews do not allow God, Glory be to Him, the Most High, to abrogate anything He has legislated.
And the Christians: They allow their elders to abrogate God’s law with their opinions.

As for Muslims: according to them, God owns the creation and the command, and there is no law except what God has legislated on the tongues of His messengers, and he has the right to abrogate whatever he wishes. Just as Christ abrogated what He had legislated for the prophets before him.

For the Christians, their beliefs and laws were established for them by their elders after Christ, just as the three hundred and eighteen who were In the time of King Constantine, the trust they had agreed upon, and they cursed those of the Arian and others who violated it, and in it were matters that God had not revealed. There is a Book in it, but rather it contradicts what God has revealed of the Book, despite its contradiction with clear reason, so they said about it:

We believe in one God, the Father, Almighty, Creator of the heavens and the earth, of all things visible and unseen, and in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the Son of God. The only begotten begotten of the Father before all ages, Light from Light, true God from true God, begotten, not created, consubstantial with the Father, who is All things were made through him. For us men and for our salvation he came down from heaven, and was incarnated by the Holy Spirit and by the Virgin Mary. And he became man, and was crucified under Pontius Pilate, and suffered and was buried, and rose again on the third day according to the scriptures, and ascended into heaven, and sits at the right hand. Father, and again he will come in his glory to judge the living and the dead, whose kingdom is without end, and with the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceeds from The father is with the father

And the Son is worshiped by Him in the glory of Him who spoke through the prophets, and in one catholic, holy and apostolic Church, and He confessed by one baptism. For the forgiveness of sins, and we hope for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come, Amen.

And they established for themselves laws and laws that were not found in the books of the prophets and did not indicate them. Rather, some of them were found in the books of the prophets, and more. The greatest of them did things of their own that are not found in the books of the prophets, and they changed much of what the prophets prescribed, so the Christians do not have any The laws and regulations that are the laws of their religion, some of which are from the disciples, and much of it is the innovation of their elders, despite their violation of it. According to the law of the prophets, their religion is of the same type as the religion of the Jews. They mixed truth with falsehood.

Christ, peace be upon him, was sent with the religion of God with which He sent the prophets before him, which is the worship of God alone, without any partner. He forbade the worship of everything other than Him, and made lawful for them some of what God had forbidden in the Torah, thus abrogating some of the law of the Torah.

The Romans, Greeks, and others were polytheists who worshiped the high temples and earthly idols, so Christ, peace be upon him, sent his messengers They call them to the religion of God Almighty, and some of them went during their life on earth, and some of them after being raised to heaven, so they called them to the religion God Almighty, so whoever entered into the religion of God, and they remained in that for a period of time, then Satan made an attempt to change the religion of Christ, so they innovated. A combined religion of the religion of God and His Messengers: the religion of Christ, peace be upon him, and the religion of the polytheists.
The polytheists worshiped embodied idols that had a shadow, and this was the religion of the Romans and Greece, and it was the religion of the philosophers. Macedonia and Athens,

Like Aristotle and those like him from the Peripatetic philosophers and others. Aristotle was about three hundred years before Christ, and he was a minister Alexander the son of Philip, the Greek of Macedon, to whom Roman history dates from among the Jews and Christians, and this was a polytheist who worshiped Him. And his people were idols, and he was not called Dhul-Qarnayn, nor was he Dhul-Qarnayn mentioned in the Qur’an, nor did this Macedonian reach the land of The Turks did not build the dam, but rather reached Persia.

Whoever thinks that Aristotle was the minister of Dhu al-Qarnayn mentioned in the Qur’an has been greatly mistaken. It has become clear that he has no knowledge of the religions of these people. The people and their times.

When the religion of Christ, peace be upon him, appeared about three hundred years after Aristotle in the Romans and Greece, they were committed to monotheism until the emergence of Among them are innovations, so they made pictures engraved on the walls, and made these pictures instead of those pictures.

These were prostrating to the sun and the moon and the stars, so they began to prostrate to them towards the east from which the sun appears. And the moon and the planets, and they made prostration to them a substitute for prostration to them. For this reason, the Seal of the Messengers, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, came, with whom God sealed the message and demonstrated the perfection of monotheism that had not been demonstrated by anyone. He accepted that, so he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, ordered that no one should check whether the sun has risen or set during his prayer. Because the polytheists prostrate to it at that hour, so if the monotheists pray to God Almighty at that hour, there will be a kind of similarity in that. To them is used as a pretext to prostrate to them, and one of the greatest reasons for idol worship is to make images and venerate graves.

In Sahih Muslim and elsewhere: On the authority of Abu Al-Hayjaj Al-Asadi: He said: “Ali bin Abi Talib said to me: Shall I not send you on the basis of what the Messenger sent me to do? God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, commanded me not to leave a grave in honor unless I leveled it, and no statue unless I obliterated it.”

And in the two Sahih books: That he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said during his dying illness: “May God curse the Jews and Christians for taking the graves of their prophets as places of worship. He warns of what they did.”
And in the two Sahih books: He said five nights before his death: “Indeed, those before you used to take graves as places of worship. So do not take Graves are mosques, and I forbid you from that.”

And when they mentioned the church in the land of Abyssinia and mentioned its beauty and the images in it, he said: “These are the people who, when a righteous man died among them, They built a mosque over his grave and made those pictures. Those will be the worst of creation in the sight of God on the Day of Resurrection.”

He forbade a man to face the grave during prayer. So that he does not imitate the polytheists who prostrate to graves, it is correct that he said: “Do not sit on graves, nor pray toward them.” And the likes of that, which include the abstraction of monotheism for God, Lord of the worlds, for whom God has sent down His books and sent His messengers with them. So where is this among those? He depicts images of created beings in churches, venerates them, and seeks the intercession of the one in whose image they are depicted? Was the origin of idol worship among the children of Adam from the time of Noah, peace be upon him, other than this?

Praying to the sun, the moon, and the planets and prostrating to them is a pretext for prostrating to them, and none of the prophets was commanded to take images. And seeking intercession from its companions, nor by prostrating to the sun, the moon, and the planets, even though it was reported that some of the prophets depicted an image. For the sake of interest, this is one of the matters in which laws may vary.

Other than prostrating to it and seeking intercession from its companions, this was not prescribed by any of the prophets, nor was any of the prophets ever commanded. The Prophets are not to be called by anyone other than God Almighty, neither at his grave nor in his absence, and no intercession for him in his absence after his death, other than Seeking the intercession of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, during his life and on the Day of Resurrection, and seeking help from him through his supplications, and believing in him, this is part of the law. The prophets, peace be upon them, and for this reason the Almighty said: {And ask of those whom We sent before you of Our messengers: Have We made gods to be worshiped besides the Most Gracious?} [Al-Zukhruf: 45].
And God Almighty said: {And We did not send before you any messenger except to him that We revealed, “There is no god but Me, so worship Me” [Al-Anbiya’: 25].

And God Almighty said: {And We have certainly sent into every nation a messenger, saying, “Worship God and avoid the tyrant.” And among them are those whom God has guided, and among them are those upon whom the law has been imposed. Misguidance} [An-Nahl: 36].

And God Almighty said: {And they worship besides God that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, “These are our intercessors with God.” Say, “Will you inform God?” With what He does not know in the heavens or on the earth. Glory be to Him, Most High above what they associate with Him.” [Yunus: 18].

And the Almighty said: {The revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise - Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book in truth, so worship Allah, making religion sincere to Him - Indeed, to Allah belongs Pure religion and those who have taken guardians besides Him - We worship them only so that they may bring us near to God in close proximity. Indeed, God judges between them as to what they are. Concerning it they differ. Indeed, God does not guide one who is a liar, an infidel. If God had wanted to take a son, He would have chosen from among those who create whatever He wills. Glory be to Him. He is God, the One, the Supreme.} [Az-Zumar: 1-4].

This is because the polytheists of all nations, none of them said that created beings have separate creators who are similar in characteristics, for this It was not said by a well-known group of the sons of Adam, but the dualists of the Magians and the like say: The world emerges from two sources: light. And the darkness, and the light to them, is the good and praiseworthy god, while the darkness is the evil, reprehensible god.
Some of them say: The darkness is Satan, and this is to make the evil in the world come from the darkness.
Among them are those who said: Darkness is ancient and eternal, although it is reprehensible to them, and it is not similar to light.
And among them are those who say: Rather, it is something that happened, and that the light thought an evil thought, and the darkness arose because of that evil thought.

Then the people of monotheism said to them: You, with your claim, hated to attribute to the Lord, Glory be to Him, the Most High, the creation of all the evil in the world, and you made it Creator of the origin of evil, and while these people prove duality and people call them duality, they do not say that evil is identical with good.

Likewise, eternity is the eternity of philosophers and others, among them are those who deny the Creator of the world, like the statement that Pharaoh demonstrated, may God curse him. Among them are those who acknowledge a cause that moves the astronomy to resemble it, such as Aristotle and his followers, and among them are those who say that the cause is in itself necessary. For astronomy, like Ibn Sina.
Al-Suhrawardi, who was killed in Aleppo, and other similar religious philosophers.

As for the Arab polytheists and their like, they acknowledged the Creator and that He created the heavens and the earth, so the belief of the Arab polytheists was good. From the ancient belief of these philosophers, as they acknowledged that these heavens were created by God and occurred after they had not existed. This is the doctrine of the masses of the people of the earth and the people of the three sects:

Muslims, Jews, Christians, Magians, polytheists, and these worldly philosophers and others claim that the heavens An eternity of old that has not ceased, and the Arab polytheists acknowledged that God is able to do according to His will and answer the supplication of the supplicant when he calls upon him, and these The secular philosophers hold that God does not do anything according to His will and does not answer the supplication of the supplicant. Rather, He does not know the particulars and does not know This preacher is from this preacher, and he does not know Abraham from Moses from Muhammad and others by their specific names from his messengers. Rather, among them are those who deny his knowledge. Absolutely, like Aristotle and his followers, and among them are those who say:
He only knows universals, like Ibn Sina and others like him.

It is known that every external entity is a specific part, so if he only knows the universals, he does not know any of the specific existents. The celestial bodies, the properties, or any other of the things that exist in their essence, and supplication according to them: is the Sufism of a strong soul in the days of the world. As mentioned by Ibn Sina and others like him, they claimed that the preserved tablet is the cosmic soul, and that all the events of the earth are merely They talk about the movement of the astronomy, as the response to them has been explained elsewhere.

What is meant here is that the polytheists did not affirm with God another god who was equal to Him in attributes and actions, nor did they say: The planets, the sun, and the moon created the world, nor do idols create any part of the world. And whoever thinks that the people of Abraham the Hebron were They believe that the star, the sun, or the moon is the Lord of the worlds, or that when Al-Khalil, peace be upon him, said, “This is my Lord,” the Lord of the worlds meant it. He made a clear mistake. Rather, Abraham’s people were acknowledging the Maker, and they were associating partners in worshiping Him like their polytheists.
God Almighty said about Hebron:

{And recite to them the story of Abraham - when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?” They said, “We worship idols and remain devoted to them.” He said, “Do you They hear you when you call - or they benefit you or harm you - they said, “Rather, we found our fathers doing just that” - He said, “Have you seen what you used to worship?” - You and your ancient fathers - they are my enemies, except the Lord of the worlds - It is He who created me and it is He who guides me - and it is He who feeds me and gives me drink - And when I am sick, it is he who heals - and it is He who will cause me to die and then bring me back to life - and it is He who I hope will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgment - my Lord, grant me judgment And join me with the righteous - and give me a tongue of truth in others - and make me among the heirs of the Garden of Bliss - and forgive my father for he was among the misguided - and do not You will put me to shame on the Day when they will be resurrected - a day when neither wealth nor children will benefit - except he who comes to God with a sound heart - and Paradise will be brought near to the righteous - and will be brought forth. Hell is for those who go astray - and it will be said to them, “Where are you worshiping - besides God? Will they support you or help you?” - so they are thrown into it. And the deviants - and all of Satan's hosts - said while they were disputing therein - By God, if we are in clear error - when we level you with the Lord of the worlds - And We led astray none but the criminals} [Al-Shu’ara’:

So God Almighty told us about Hebron that he is an enemy to everything they worship except the Lord of the Worlds, and He told us that they will say on the Day of Resurrection: {By God, if we are in clear error - when We make you equal to the Lord of the worlds} [Al-Shu’ara: 97-98].

As God Almighty said in the other place: {And when Abraham said to his father and his people, “Indeed, I am free of what you worship - except Him who created me. They will be guided} [Al-Zukhruf: 26-27].
And he said: {I turn my face towards Him who created the heavens and the earth, as an upright one, and I am not of the polytheists} [Al-An’am: 79].

He did not say: Of the disruptors, for his people were polytheists, and they were not disruptors like the accursed Pharaoh, so they were not ungrateful to the Maker, but rather they were just. Through Him, and they made equals to Him in worship, love, and supplication, and this is as the Almighty said: {Praise be to God who created the heavens and the earth and made Darkness and light, then those who disbelieve will act justly in their Lord} [Al-An’am: 1].
And God Almighty said: {And among the people are those who take equals besides God; they love them as they love God, but those who believe have the strongest love for God} [Al-Baqarah: 165].
And God Almighty said: {And those who call upon not with God any other god} [Al-Furqan: 68].
And God Almighty said: {Do not call upon any other god with God, lest you be among those who are tormented} [Al-Shu’ara’: 213].
And he said: {Do not set up with God another god, lest you sit censured and rejected} [Al-Isra: 22].
And God Almighty said in what He narrated about Noah’s people: {And they said, “Do not leave your gods, nor leave Wad, nor Suwa’, nor Yaghuth, nor Ya’uq, nor Nasr” [Noah: 23].

Ibn Abbas and other scholars said: These were a righteous people among the people of Noah, so when they died they spent time on their graves, then they made pictures. Their images and then they worshiped them.

And so among the Christians, about Christ, peace be upon him, in the Book of the Secret of Peter, who is called Simeon, Simeon, Cephas, Peter, and the four. For one name, they have a book about him about Christ that contains the secrets of the sciences, and this is what they have about Christ in it about Christ, which is what the Christians do. The origin of idol worship, and this is what their great scholar - whom they call Chrysostom and he is one of their greatest scholars - said when he mentioned Major sins are caused by minor sins. He said:
Thus, idolatry was attacked in the past, when people honored people who venerated each other beyond the appropriate amount. The living and the dead.

And God Almighty said: {Say, “Call upon those whom you have claimed besides Him, for they will not have the power to remove harm from you nor to avert it.” - Those whom they call seek to Their Lord is the means, whichever of them is nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is one to beware.} [Al-Isra: 56-57].

A group of scholars said: There were some people who called on angels and prophets, such as Al-Azir, the Messiah, and others, so God, Blessed and Exalted, explained And God Almighty says that these are His servants just as you are His servants. They hope for His mercy as you hope for His mercy, and they fear His punishment as you fear Him. His torment, and they draw near to Him just as you draw near to Him, and God Almighty said:

{It is not for a human being that God should give him the Scripture and judgment and prophecy, and then say to the people, “Be my servants instead of God.” But be lords. Because you taught the Scripture and what you studied - and He does not command you to take the angels and the prophets as lords. Does He command you to disbelieve? After you have submitted.} [Al Imran: 79-80].

So God Almighty made it clear that whoever takes the angels and the prophets as lords is an unbeliever despite his belief that they are created things. He did not say Absolutely no one: that all the angels and prophets participate with God, Glory be to Him, in creating the world, and God Almighty said: {And most of them do not believe in God. Except that they are polytheists} [Yusuf: 106].

Ibn Abbas, Mujahid and others said: You ask them who created the heavens and the earth? They say: God, while they worship other than Him, and God Almighty said: {And if you asked them who created the heavens and the earth, they would certainly say: God} [Luqman: 25].

In more than one place, God Almighty told us about the polytheists, that they used to acknowledge that the Creator of the world is one, even though they took them as gods to worship. Besides Him, Glory be to Him, they take them as intercessors to Him and draw near to Him through them.

chapters.title: The separation of Muslims coming together based on their consensus and the Christians dispersing through their innovation
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Muslims coming together because of their consensus and the Christians dispersing because of their innovation]

Likewise, their veneration of the cross, their declaring permissible the meat of pork, their monastic worship, their abstention from circumcision, and their abandonment of The purity of impurity and impurity, so they do not make it obligatory to perform ritual ritual ablution or ablution, and they do not make it obligatory to avoid any impurity in their prayers, whether as an excuse or Urine or other impurities, etc.

All of them are laws that they introduced and invented after Christ, peace be upon him, and their imams and their majority condemned them, and they cursed those who disagreed with them. Until those among them who adhered to the pure religion of Christ became defeated and oppressed before God sent Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and most of them There are no laws and religions excepted from Christ, peace be upon him.

As for the Muslims: everything upon which they have agreed upon with clear consensus and which is known to both the common people and the particular people is transmitted from their Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon him, no one did that, neither through his own ijtihad nor without his own ijtihad. Rather, we did not agree with the consensus of the nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. It is found to have been taken from their Prophet.

As for what is thought to be their consensus but is not certain: there is some in which that suspicion is wrong, and there is a dispute between them regarding it, and then there may be a text. The Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, is with this saying, and he may be with this saying.

Among them are those on which consensus is thought to be correct, and there is a trace on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, the meaning or knowledge of which is hidden to some. People.

This is because God, Blessed and Most High, perfected the religion through Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, the Seal of the Prophets, and made it clear and gave him the clear message. His nation needs someone after him to change some of his religion, but it only needs knowledge of the religion with which he was sent, and his nation does not They will gather based on misguidance, but there will continue to be a group in his nation that is upholding the truth, until the Hour comes, for God sent him with guidance and the religion of truth. To make it prevail over the entire religion, so he made it apparent with argument and explanation, and made it apparent with the hand and the teeth, and there will still be a nation in his nation that is evident in this. And this is until the Hour comes.

What is meant here is that what the nation has agreed upon with clear consensus is known to both the public and the private, it was transmitted from their Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings of God be upon him, and we do not bear witness to infallibility except for the entire nation, and as for many of the nation’s sects, there are heresies in them that contradict the Messenger. Some of them are similar to the heresies of the Jews and Christians, and they contain immorality and sins, but the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, is innocent of that, as he said. God Almighty said to him: “But if they disobey you, say, ‘Indeed, I am innocent of what you do.’” [Al-Shu’ara’: 216].
And God Almighty said: {Indeed, those who divided their religion and became sects, you have nothing to do with them} [Al-An’am: 159].

And he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: “Whoever turns away from my Sunnah is not of me.” This is like their consensus that Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was sent to All nations, People of the Book and non-People of the Book, for this they received from their Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and it has been transmitted to them. A frequent narration that they necessarily know.

Likewise, their consensus on facing the Kaaba, the Sacred House, in their prayers, as this consensus among them on that is based on narration. Mutawaatir on the authority of their Prophet, and it is mentioned in their book.

Likewise, there is consensus on the obligation of the five daily prayers, fasting during the month of Ramadan, and the pilgrimage to the ancient house that Ibrahim Khalil al-Rahman built, and he called for People went to his Hajj and the prophets performed his Hajj, even Moses bin Imran, Yunus bin Matta and others performed the Hajj, and they agreed on the necessity of washing from Impurity, the prohibition of evil things, and the obligation of purity for prayer, for all of this is what they received from their Prophet, and it was transmitted from him, who prayed May God bless him and grant him peace. It has been repeatedly narrated and is mentioned in the Qur’an.

As for the Christians, the prayers they pray are not copied from Christ, peace be upon him, nor are the fasts they observe copied from Christ. The first of them was to fast for forty days, then they increased it by ten days, and they moved it to spring, and this was not transmitted to them from Christ. Peace.

Likewise, their pilgrimage to the garbage, and to Bethlehem, and to the Church of Sidnaya. None of that was copied from Christ, peace be upon him. Rather, likewise Their general feasts, such as the Feast of the Catalan, Christmas, the Feast of the Epiphany - which is the Mass - the Feast of Thursday, and the Feast of the Cross, which they established in At the time of the appearance of the cross, when Helena of Harrania, the mother of Constantine, demonstrated it two hundred years after Christ, peace be upon him, And the feast of Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, which are at the end of their fast, and other of their feasts that they arranged according to the conditions of Christ and the feasts. Which they invented for their elders, for all of this is among their innovations which they invented without a book that came down from God Almighty. Rather, they build churches. In the name of some of those who venerate him, as in the Sunan on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace:

“When a righteous man among them dies, they build a mosque over his grave and depict these images in it. They will be the worst of creation in the sight of God on the Day of Judgment. Resurrection.” This is in contrast to the mosques that were built for God Almighty, as God Almighty said: “And the mosques are for God, so call upon not anyone with God.” [Al-Jinn: 18] .
And he said: {In houses that God has permitted to be raised} [An-Nour: 36].
And the Almighty said: {Say: My Lord has commanded justice, and establish your faces at every place of worship and call upon Him, sincere in His religion} [Al-A’raf: 29].

And God Almighty said: {The mosques of God are inhabited only by he who believes in God and the Last Day, and establishes prayer, and pays zakat, and fears none but God. Perhaps those will That they be of those who are guided} [At-Tawbah: 18].
Christians, like their polytheists, fear other than God and call on other than God.

chapters.title: The Christians changed the religion of Christ before the sending of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Christians changed the religion of Christ before the sending of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.]
What is meant here is that what Muslims believe is that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is a messenger to the heavy people:

mankind and the jinn, the People of the Book and others, and that whoever does not believe in him is an unbeliever, deserving of the punishment of God, deserving of jihad, and he From what the people of faith in God and His Messenger have agreed upon; Because the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, was the one who brought that, and God mentioned it in His Book, and the Messenger also explained it in the wisdom revealed. upon him other than the Book, for God Almighty sent down the Book and wisdom to him, and the Muslims did not invent any of that on their own. themselves, just as the Christians invented much of their religion, or even much of their religion.

They changed the religion of Christ and changed it. For this reason, the disbelief of the Christians when Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent was like the disbelief of the Jews when Christ, peace be upon him, was sent. They had changed the law of the Torah before the coming of the Messiah, so they disbelieved in that, and when the Messiah was sent to them, they denied him, and they became disbelievers by changing the meanings of The first book and its rulings, and by denying the second book.

Likewise, the Christians had changed the religion of Christ before Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent, so they invented the trinity, the union, and changing The laws of the Gospel are things with which Christ, peace be upon him, was not sent, but rather contradicted what he was sent with, and they divided into several groups regarding that, and he disbelieved And when Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was sent, they denied him, and they became infidels by changing the meanings of the first book and its rulings. And denying the second book, as Muslim scholars say:

Their religion has been changed and abrogated, and even if there were a few Christians, they adhered to the religion of Christ when Muhammad was sent, may God bless him and grant him peace. Those who did not change the religion of Christ were entirely on the truth. This is just as whoever was following the law of the Torah when the Messiah was sent was adhering to In truth, like everyone who followed Moses, when the Messiah was sent, everyone who did not believe in him became an unbeliever, and likewise when Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent. Everyone who did not believe in him became an unbeliever.

What is meant in this regard is to explain what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent with in terms of the generality of his message, and that he himself was the one who informed that God Almighty sent him to the People of the Book and others, and he himself, may God bless him and grant him peace, called the People of the Book, struggled against them, and commanded With their jihad, then whoever from the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, says after this: He was not sent to us, meaning that he did not say that An envoy to us, he was arrogant and denied necessity, slandering the Messenger with a clear lie that was known to both the elite and the public.

His denial of this was as if he denied that he came with the Qur’an, or that he prescribed the five daily prayers, the fast of Ramadan, and the Hajj to the Sacred House; He denied Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, and what has been narrated from him is greater than the denial of Christ, peace be upon him, by the followers of the disciples, and his sending to them. To the nations, and his coming with the Gospel, and he denied the coming of Moses, peace be upon him, with the Torah, and denied that he used to sabbath; The period of transmission from Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is short, and those who transmit from him are many times greater than those who transmitted the religion of Christ from him, and many times more. Many times the number of those who were in contact with the transmission of the religion of Moses, peace be upon him. The nation of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is still numerous and spread out in the east of the world. The land and its western parts, and there are still among them those who profess religion and are victorious over the enemies, unlike the children of Israel, for their kingdom has ceased. During the matter, when the Holy House was destroyed, the first destruction after David, peace be upon him, and the number of those who transmitted their religion decreased to the point that it was said that no There remains anyone who keeps the Torah except one.

Only a small number of people transmitted his religion from Christ, peace be upon him, but the Christians claim that they are infallible messengers of God, like Abraham. And Moses, and the discussion will come about this, God willing, when we reach it, as what is intended here is to explain those who claim that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace He, peace and blessings be upon him, used to say:

He was not sent except to the Arab polytheists, for he is at the utmost level of ignorance and misguidance, or the utmost arrogance and stubbornness, for this is greater. Ignorance and stubbornness are those who deny that he used to enjoin purity and washing from ritual impurity, and forbid wine and pork, and greater ignorance and stubbornness. From those who deny what has been reported about the Messiah and Moses, peace be upon them, and the falsehood of their saying has become apparent through this: We know that he did not come to us. Rather, to the pre-Islamic era of the Arabs.

chapters.title: Separating the Christians’ suspicions about the Prophet’s message and responding to them
paragraphs: [Chapter: Christians’ suspicions about the Prophet’s message and the response to it]

If this was known, then these people would use as evidence the verses that they thought indicated that his prophecy was specific to the Arabs, indicating that they were not among those who It is permissible for them to use someone’s words as evidence for his meaning and purpose, and they are among those about whom it was said: “What is the matter with these people? They can hardly understand.” Recently} [An-Nisa: 78].

They are not worthy to use as evidence the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms, according to the intent of the prophets, and all the words transmitted from the prophets, according to the intent of the prophets. The prophets, peace be upon them - and they do not use the words of doctors, philosophers, grammarians, or the knowledge of the people of reckoning as evidence for their purposes.

All people agree that the Arabic language is one of the most eloquent and clearest human languages, and they agree that the Qur’an is at the highest level. Degrees of eloquence, eloquence, and eloquence, and in the Qur’an there are many indications of the intention of the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, in which he mentions:

That God Almighty sent him to the People of the Book and to others incalculable, except at a cost, and then with that from the frequent narrations about his biography May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, in his supplication for the People of the Book, and his command to them to believe in him, and his struggle against them when they disbelieve in him, something that is not hidden from him. Who has the slightest experience of his life, may God bless him and grant him peace? This is something the world has been filled with, and far and near have heard it. So if people Those who believe in Him and those who do not believe in Him know that He used to say:

He is the Messenger of God to the People of the Book, and to others, and the apparent meaning of his purpose in that is what he knows of special and general circumstances. Then they began to think that he was saying: I was not sent except to the Arabs. And he continued to do so until he died, indicating the corruption of their outlook and mind. Or because of their stubbornness and arrogance, and this was what was necessary since he did not know the meanings of these verses that they specifically used as evidence. His message is for them to believe one of two things:

Either it has meanings that are consistent with what he was saying, or it is abrogated, as both the elite and the public have learned that Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him He was praying after his migration to the Holy House for about a year and a half, then he was ordered to pray towards the Kaaba, the Sacred House, and the Christians They agree that the laws of the prophets contain abrogation and abrogation, even though the verses they mentioned are not abrogated, but what is meant is: What is known about the condition of the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, is necessary, certain and frequent knowledge that cannot be dismissed, for knowledge that he used to say:

He is the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, to all of creation, known to everyone who knew his news, may God bless him and grant him peace, whether he believed him or not. His lie, and the knowledge that he was saying that he was the Messenger of God to all people was possible before it was known that he was a prophet or not a prophet, just as Knowledge of his prophecy and his truthfulness is possible before the generality of his message is known, so knowledge of one is not dependent on the other, and for this reason there is much Whoever disbelieves him knows that he was saying that he was the Messenger of God to all of creation, and a group of those who acknowledge his prophethood and truthfulness do not acknowledge that he A messenger to all creation.

What is meant here: to speak to these people that knowledge in the generality of His call to all creation, the People of the Book and others, is frequent and known. By being forced, like knowledge by its very origin and calling people to believe in it and obey it, and like knowledge by its migration from Mecca to Mecca. Medina, and his coming with this Qur’an, and the five daily prayers, and fasting during the month of Ramadan, and the Hajj to the Ancient House, and the obligation of honesty and justice, And the prohibition of injustice and immoral acts, and other than that which Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought.

And if it is said: Rather, there is something in the Qur’an that necessitates that its message is specific, and there is something in it that necessitates that its message is general, and this is a contradiction.

It was said: This is false, and its falsehood was known before knowledge of his prophecy. It is known to everyone who believes in him, or disbelieves in him, that he was one of the greatest people in intelligence, politics, and experience, and his intention was to call creation to obey him and follow him, and he used to recite the Qur’an to all people, and commanded that it be conveyed to all nations, and he was the one who asked him to To make him believe that the Qur’an is recited to him from the disbelievers, he must answer him even if he were a polytheist, so what if he was of the Book? As God Almighty said:

{And if any of the polytheists seek your protection, grant him protection until he hears the word of God, then inform him of his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.} [Al-Tawbah: 6]

He had shown that he was sent to the People of the Book and all of creation, and that he was a messenger to the two great creatures: the jinn and mankind, so he was abstained from this. If something appears that indicates that he was not sent to them, then this would not be done by someone who has the slightest intellect to contradict his will, so how? This is done by someone whom the wisest nations agreed is the wisest of creation and the best in policy and law?

Also, his companions and fighters with him after that used to flee from him, and it was their habit to pretend to be something other than this. This was not questioned by anyone, then after this, if it were assumed that there is something in the Qur’an that indicates that he was not sent except to the Arabs, and in it there is something that indicates That he was sent to the rest of creation, this was evidence that he was sent to others after he had not been sent except to them, and that God is all-encompassing. With his call after it was specific, there is no contradiction between this and that, so how come when there is not a single verse in the Qur’an that indicates the specificity of his message In Arabs?

It only confirms his message to them, just as it confirms his message to Quraysh, and this is not contradictory to this, and it contains proof His message to the People of the Book is as the Almighty says: {O you who have been given the Scripture, believe in what We have sent down} [An-Nisa: 47].
It also confirms his message to the Children of Israel, as he said: O Children of Israel.

This specification of the Jews does not contradict that generalization, and his message is an address to the Jews at times and to the Christians at times, and his address is not to anyone. The two sects and his call to them contradict his speech to the other and his call to them, and in his book is an address to those of his nation who believed in his call to them. to the laws of his religion, and there is no contradiction in that for him to address the People of the Book and call upon them, and in his Book he commanded fighting the People of the Book Christians, until they pay the tribute out of hand while they are helpless.

God Almighty said: {Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day, and do not forbid what God and His Messenger have forbidden, and do not follow the religion of truth from among those They were given the Scripture until they were given the tribute out of hand, but they were submissive.} [At-Tawbah: 29].

Then this did not prevent him from ordering the killing of other Jews and Magians. Until they pay the tribute out of hand while they are small. Rather, this ruling is proven among the Magi according to its Sunnah and the agreement of his nation.

And if it is said: They are not among the People of the Book, then all of this is what is known by necessity from his religion before knowledge of his prophecy, so how about we? Are we talking about appreciating his prophecy, and the Prophet’s words are not contradictory? If knowledge of the generality of his call and message was necessarily known before knowledge of his prophecy, and after knowledge of his prophecy, Necessary and certain knowledge is not opposed to anything, but this is the case of those in whose hearts there is deviation from the people of innovation:

Christians and others follow the similar and call the arbitrator, and because of the Christians’ debate with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, with the similar, And their turning away from the decisive verse, God, Blessed and Most High, revealed concerning them: Similar things, but as for those in whose hearts there is deviation, they follow that which is similar, seeking temptation and seeking its interpretation, but its interpretation is not known. Except Allah and those who are firmly rooted in knowledge. They say, “We believe in it. It is all from our Lord.” And none remember except those of understanding.} [Al Imran: 7].

Interpretation: What is meant by it is the interpretation of the Qur’an and knowledge of its meanings, and this is known to the well-established, and what is meant by it is what the Lord, Glory be to Him and Most High, has chosen. With His knowledge, such as knowing its true nature, the true nature of what He promised, the time of the Hour, and other such things that no one knows except God.

chapters.title: The response to the Christians’ claim is that the Messenger’s words are contradictory
paragraphs: And the misguided people mention verses whose meanings they doubt, so they follow their interpretation, seeking temptation and seeking to interpret it. They are not among those well-established in knowledge who know their interpretation, even though these verses are among the clearest verses.

This is what they followed in the Qur’an, and this is similar to what they followed in the previous books and the words of the prophets from the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and others. It contains many explicit texts about the oneness of God and the servitude of Christ, which cannot be counted except at a cost, and there are few words in it. There was a suspicion, so they stuck to the few that were similar, hidden, and distorted from the previous books, and left much that was precise, clear, and clear, so they followed In the Qur’an, they did not follow it in the previous books, but those books acknowledge the prophecy of their authors, and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is in it. They are troubled and contradictory. Any statement they said about it became apparent as being false and false, if they did not believe in everything that was revealed to them.
[The response to the Christians in their claim that the words of the Messenger are contradictory]
And if they say: His words are contradictory, we will use as evidence what agrees with our statement, since our intention is to explain its contradiction.

They were told about this. Answers were given to them: One of them: That in the previous books, what is thought to be contradictory is twice as much as what is in the Qur’an and is closer to Contradiction. If these books are in agreement, there is no contradiction in them. Rather, their contradiction is thought by those who are ignorant of their meanings and the intent of the messengers, so it is As it was said: How many defective people speak a true word... and suffer from poor understanding. So how about the Qur’an, which is the best of books?
Second: They adhere to what is similar in those books, and differ from the decisive ones, as they did with the Qur’an and it was conveyed.

Third: If what he brought was contradictory, he was not the Messenger of God, then what he brought from God would not be different or contradictory. Rather, what came from other than God contradicts it. The Almighty said: {Do they not consider the Qur’an? And if it had been from other than God, they would have found in it a discrepancy. A lot} [An-Nisa: 82].

Every book that is not from God must contain a contradiction, and what is from God does not contradict itself, and then if it is contradictory it is not It is permissible for them to use any of it as evidence. For it is not from God, and even if it is not contradictory, it is proven that what is in it is part of the generality of his message, and that he is a messenger to them, so there is nothing in it. It contradicts it, for what came from God does not contradict it.

Fourth: We clarify that what is in it regarding the generality of his message does not contradict what is in it that it was sent to the Arabs, just as what is in it of a warning to his tribe Relatives, and the matter of Quraysh does not contradict the call of all Arabs; So, singling out some general meaning for mention, if it has a reason that requires the specification, does not indicate that anything other than what is mentioned is a violation, and this is what It is called the concept of dissent and the evidence of discourse.

The people are all agreed that the specification of mentioning whenever there is a reason that necessitates mentioning other than being specific to the ruling, the name does not have a title. Understandable, and even not for the description, as the Almighty says: {And do not kill your children for fear of poverty} [Al-Isra: 31].

He forbade them from doing so. Because that is what they used to do, and it was forbidden in another place to kill someone unjustly, whether it was a child or someone else, and it was not This contradicts designating the child as a male.

Fifth: This is an example of Christ, peace be upon him, for Christ was first singled out for the call, then generalized, as it was said in the Gospel: I was not sent And I was sent only to the Children of Israel. He also said in the Gospel: I was not sent except for this evil people.
