Then he generalized and said to his disciples when he sent them, as in the Gospel: Just as my father sent me, so I send you, and whoever receives you has accepted me. And he said: My Father has sent me, and I am sending you. And he said:

As I do to you, so do you to servants of God. Go about the country, baptizing people in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and do not One of you will have two coats, and he will not carry with him any silver or gold or a staff or a spear or any other such things that are in the Gospels that are in their hands. From singling out the call and then generalizing it, and he is truthful in all of that, so how can they be justified in denying what is in the Gospel about Christ, his counterpart? Then it is said in an explanation of the situation: Indeed, God Almighty sent Muhammad

May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, just as Christ and others were sent, even though his message was more complete and comprehensive as we mention in his place, then he commanded him to convey He sent his message as much as possible to one group after another, and he was commanded to convey the message to the one closest to him in place and lineage, then to convey the message to one group after another. sect; Until the warning is conveyed to all the people of the earth, as God Almighty said: {And this Qur’an was revealed to me that I might warn you thereby and whomever it reaches} [Al-An’am: 19].
That is, whoever the Qur’an reaches, everyone to whom the Qur’an reaches, Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, has warned him.

We clarify here that the warning is not limited to those to whom he received the speech, but rather he warns them with it and warns those to whom the Qur’an has reached him, so he commanded God, Blessed and Most High, first warned his closest clan, which is the Quraysh, and God Almighty said: {And warn your closest clan} [Al-Shu’ara’: 214].

When God revealed this verse to him, he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, set out for a high place and camped on it, then he started calling: “O Banu Abd Manaf! A warner to you at the hands of a severe torment. My example and yours is that of a man who saw the enemy and set off to go after his family, and he feared that they would outrun him, so he made He chants, “Good morning, good morning.”
This story was narrated by Ibn Abbas, Abu Hurairah, Aisha and others in the two Sahihs and other books of Sunan and Musnads. And the interpretation.

Ibn Abbas said: When “this verse was revealed: {And warn your closest kindred} [Al-Shu’ara’: 214]. And your group of sincere ones, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out until he ascended Safa, and began calling: O Banu Fihr, O Banu Adi Labun. Quraysh until they gathered together, so if the man was unable to get out, he sent a messenger to see what it was? So they gathered around him, and he said: If I told you that horses wanted to attack you, would you believe me? They said: Yes, we have never experienced anything from you except the truth, we have never experienced anything against you except a lie. He said:
For I am a warner to you before me of a severe torment.

Abu Hurairah said: When this verse was revealed: {And warn your closest kindred} [Al-Shu’ara’: 214]. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, called the Quraysh, and they gathered together. He spoke in general and in detail, and said: O Banu Ka’b bin Luay, save yourselves from the Fire. Banu Murrah bin Ka'b, save yourselves from the Fire. O Banu Abd Shams, save yourselves from the Fire. O Banu Abd Manaf, save Yourselves from the Fire, O Banu Hashim, save yourselves from the Fire, O Banu Abdul Muttalib, save yourselves from the Fire, O Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, save yourself from hell.
For I do not possess anything for you from God except that you have a womb, which I will wet with my wetness.”

Aisha, may God be pleased with her, said when this verse was revealed: “And warn your closest family” [Al-Shu’ara: 214]. “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, stood up on Safa and said: O Fatima, daughter of Muhammad, O Safiyya, the paternal aunt of the Messenger of God, O Abbas, uncle of the Messenger of God, do not “I will give you something from God.”

Ibn Ishaq said: “When this verse was revealed, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, began to call out: O Banu Abdul Muttalib, O Banu Abd Manaf, O Banu Abd Manaf. Bani Zuhra until he counted the number of Quraysh members, then he said: God has commanded me to warn my closest clan, and I have no authority over you from God. “Nothing except that you say, ‘There is no god but Allah.’” Then Abu Lahab said: “Is this why you have brought us together?”

May God curse you for the rest of the day, so God revealed: {May Abu Lahab’s hands abide and repent - his wealth and what he has earned will not avail him of it - he will pray in a flaming fire - And his wife is a carrier of firewood - there is a rope of oil on her neck.} [Al-Masad: 1-5].

He called the Quraysh to God, and commanded them to worship God alone, with no partner, and God Almighty revealed: {For the familiarity of the Quraysh - their familiarity with the winter journey. And the summer - let them worship the Lord of this House - who has fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear} [Quraysh: 1-4].

And God has sent down to him in more than one place the command for all creation to worship him, as God Almighty says: {O people, worship your Lord who created you. And those before you that you may become righteous} [Al-Baqarah: 21].
And His saying: “And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me” [Al-Dhariyat: 56].
And Quraysh are his people who were rejected by their people at first, as God Almighty said: {And your people denied him, but he was the truth} [Al-An’am: 66].
Just as the majority of the children of Israel, who were the people of Christ, denied him at first.

Then God Almighty commanded him to call all the Arabs, so he himself and his friend Abu Bakr with him would go out to the Arab tribes, one tribe tribe, and the Arabs had still been performing Hajj to the House since the time of Ibrahim al-Khalil, peace be upon him, so he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, would come to them in Their homes were in Mina, Ukaz, Majnah, and Dhul-Majaz, and he did not find anyone except that he called him to God, and he said:

“O people, I am the Messenger of God, commanding you to worship God and not associating anything with Him, and to renounce My equals, and that you believe in me and believe me and prevent me; Until I explain on the authority of God what He has sent me with, O people, the Quraysh have prevented me from conveying the word of my Lord, so who can prevent me from conveying the word of my Lord except A man

He carries me to his people, for the Quraysh have prevented me from conveying the words of my Lord. O people, say, “There is no god but God,” and you will succeed and rule by it. Arabs, and the non-Arabs will be humiliated to you thereby. They say: O Muhammad, do you want to make the gods one god? This thing of yours is amazing.

The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, continued to announce his call, reveal his message, and call people to it, but they insulted him and argued with him. They speak to him and respond to him with the ugliest response, but he is patient with their harm and says: “O God, praise be to You. If You wish, they would not be like this.”

When the Quraysh situation became difficult for him, he went out to Taif, which is a well-known city east of Mecca, about two nights apart, and with him was Zaid bin Haritha. He stayed there for ten days, not leaving any of their nobles except to come to his house and speak to him and call him to monotheism, but no one responded to him. Of them, and they feared him for their children, and they enticed their foolish people by him, so they started throwing stones at him when he walked, until his feet To Damian, and Zaid, his master, protected him with his own life, until they took refuge in the shade of a vine in the wall of Utbah and Shaybah, the sons of Rabi’ah, and he recovered from what One of their fools followed him, so he called and said:

“O God, to You I complain of the weakness of my strength, my lack of resourcefulness, and my disdain for people, O Most Merciful of the merciful, You are the Lord of the oppressed, and You are my Lord, to whom Do you trust me, to someone far away who frowns upon me, or to an enemy over whom my command is dominion? If you are not angry with me, I do not care, but your well-being is more ample for me. I seek refuge in the light of your face, to which the darkness has shone, and the affairs of this world and the hereafter have been made right for it, from your wrath descending upon me, or descending upon me. Your anger is yours to blame until you are satisfied, and there is no power or strength except with you.”

When Ibn Rabi’ah saw what was done to him, they sympathized with him and said to a boy of theirs called Addas - who was a Christian -: Take a bunch of grapes, then... Put it on a plate, then go to that man and he will eat it. Addas did so and went with it until he placed it in the hands of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon him. When the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, put his hand down, he said: In the name of God. Then he ate. Addas looked at his face and said to him: By God. These are what the people of this town say. So the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: Which country are you from? What is your religion?

Addas said: I am a Christian, and I am a man from the people of Nineveh. Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: From the village of the righteous man Yunus. Matthew's son? Addas said to him: How do you know what Yunus bin Matthew is? By God, I left Nineveh, and there were not ten people in it who knew Matthew. How did you know Matthew, since you are an illiterate and in an illiterate nation? Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He is my brother, he was a prophet and I am a prophet, so Addas attacked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace.

He, peace and blessings be upon him, kissed his head, his hands, and his feet. When Addas returned, they said: Woe to you, Addas. Why do you kiss this man’s head and hands? And his feet, and he said: O my master, there is nothing on earth better than this man. He has told me something that only a prophet knows.

Then the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, departed from Taif, returning to Mecca, and he was saddened, as not a single man responded to him. A woman, and Zaid bin Haritha said to him: How can you enter upon them, O Messenger of God, when they did it and did it? So he said: O Zaid, God Almighty will bring about what You see relief and a way out, and God is the supporter of His religion and the manifestation of His Prophet.

Then Ibn Ishaq mentioned his entry into Mecca, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was present when he met the people of Mecca and Taif. He prayed with the previous supplication, and Gabriel descended upon him, and with him the Angel of the Mountains - as in Sahih Al-Bukhari - that Aisha, may God be pleased with her, said to the Prophet: May God’s prayers and peace be upon him: “Has there ever come upon you a day more severe than the Day of Uhud?” He said:

I encountered some of your people, and the worst I encountered from them was on the Day of Aqaba, when I presented myself to Ibn Abd Yalil bin Abd Kulal, but he did not... He answered me to what I wanted, so I set off with worry on my face, and I did not wake up until I was by the fox’s horn, so I raised my head and behold, A cloud had covered me, and I looked, and behold, it was in it.

Gabriel called to me: God has heard what your people said and what they responded to you, and He has sent to you the Angel of the Mountains so that you may command him whatever you wish regarding them. He said: Then the King of the Mountains called me and greeted me, then he said: O Muhammad, God has heard what your people said to you, and I am the King of the Mountains. Your Lord has sent me Come to me so that you may order me to do your bidding, if you wish, so that I may close upon them the two woods. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Rather, I hope that God will bring them out of “Their descendants are those who worship God alone, He has no partner.”

Muslim narrated in his Sahih on the authority of Abu Hurairah: It was said to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace: “Call upon God against the polytheists,” and he said: “I have not been sent.” Cursing, but I was sent as a mercy.”

And in the two Sahih books: On the authority of Khabab bin Al-Art, he said: “When the calamity became severe for us from the polytheists, we came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and we said: Don't you pray to God for us? Will you not ask God to help us? He said:

Indeed, before you, a man would be taken and dug for him in the ground, then a saw would be brought and cut over his head until it was made into two parts. This will distract him from his religion, and he will comb with iron combs what is beneath his flesh of bone and sinew. This will not distract him from his religion, and may God complete it. “This matter is such that the passenger will travel from Sana’a to Hadhramaut, fearing no one but God, but you are in a hurry.”

He mentioned what the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, faced from his people of harm, mockery, and temptation, while he was patient, seeking reward, and presenting a matter. May God convey His message. Do not take in God the blame of a scoundrel who confronts his people with the faults they hate about their religion and their gods. Misleading their fathers, belittling their dreams, showing his hostility, and fighting them to the point of cutting off.
Ikrimah said, on the authority of Ibn Abbas:

“And when the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, returned to Mecca, and when the season arrived, a group of Ansar performed Hajj, so the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, ended up going to A group of them. He recited the Qur’an to them, called them to God, and informed them of what God had given them, so they became certain and their hearts were at ease regarding His call. And they knew what they were hearing from the People of the Book in terms of their mention of Him in His character, and what they were calling them to, so they believed him and believed in him, and he was one of The reasons for the goodness that God brought to the Ansar to the news they were hearing about him. When they returned to their people, they began to call upon them. secretly, and they told them the sayings of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and with which God had sent him of light, guidance, and the Qur’an, so they became Muslim until “It is rare for there to be a house like theirs without some people inevitably embracing Islam in it.”

God mentioned this in the Qur’an, and told that the People of the Book used to tell the Arabs about it and used it against them. The Book acknowledges his prophecy, announcing it and giving good tidings of it before he is sent. God Almighty said regarding what He addresses the People of the Book with:

{And We gave Moses the Scripture, and followed him with messengers, and We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs, and supported him with the Holy Spirit. So, whenever he comes to you, A Messenger with what your souls do not desire. You were arrogant, so a group you denied and a group you killed - and they said, “Our hearts are uncircumcised.” Nay, God has cursed them for their disbelief. But little do they believe - and when there came to them a book from God, confirming what is with them. And previously they were seeking victory against those who disbelieved; so when it came to them What they recognized, they disbelieved therein. So the curse of God is upon the disbelievers - evil is that for which they have sold their souls, that they should disbelieve in what God has sent down, out of envy that God should send down His bounty is upon whomsoever He will of His servants, and they repel one another with wrath upon wrath, and for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment - and when it is said to them, “Believe in what God has revealed.” They said: We believe in what was revealed to us, but they disbelieve in what is behind it, but it is the truth, confirming what is with them. Say, “Then why did you kill the prophets of God before? You are believers} [Al-Baqarah:

God Almighty has told that the People of the Book used to seek victory against the Arabs through Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, before he was sent - that is, they sought victory. With it - and they and the Arabs would fight, and the Arabs would defeat them, and they would say: The illiterate Prophet will be sent from among the descendants of Ishmael, and we will follow him. And We will kill you with him in the worst way possible, and they used to treat him with the same cruelty.

Their narrations of that are many and frequently repeated, and as God Almighty said: {But when there came to them what they recognized, they disbelieved in it, so the curse of God is upon the disbelievers} [Al-Baqarah: 89] .

And he reported what the Jews were upon, that whenever the Messenger of God came to them with something their souls did not desire, they denied each other and killed each other. Some of them, and he reported that they met with anger upon anger; They continue to do things that make God angry with them, so either the duality is intended to confirm God’s wrath upon them, or it is meant Twice, the first anger: their denial of Christ and the Gospel, and the second anger: against Muhammad and the Qur’an.

chapters.title: Chapter on the miracles of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: The miracles of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace]

He used to bring them signs indicating his prophecy, may God bless him and grant him peace, and his miracles exceeded a thousand miracles, such as the splitting of the moon. And other verses, such as the miraculous Qur’an, and such as the narrations of the People of the Book before it and the good news of it to the prophets, and such as The news of the soothsayers and the telephones about him, and the example of the story of the elephant, which God made a sign in the year of his birth, and what happened in the year of his birth are among the wonders. Evidence of his prophecy, such as the sky being filled with meteors, with which the devils are stoned, contrary to what was the custom before him. His sending and after His sending, and such as informing him of the unseen that no one knows except through the teaching of God Almighty without him teaching him. She is human.
So he told them about the past, such as the story of Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Christ, Hud, Shuaib, Saleh, and others, and about the future.

His people knew that he did not learn from the People of the Book, nor from anyone else, and that there was not in Mecca any of the scholars of the People of the Book who He himself learned from him, and he did not meet any of them who knew the Arabic language, nor did he master a language other than Arabic, nor did he write. A book, and he does not read a written book.

He did not travel before his prophethood except two trips: a trip when he was young, with his uncle Abu Talib. He did not leave him, nor did he meet any of the people of the Prophet. The Book and no one else, and another journey while he was old with a group of Quraysh. He did not separate from them, nor did he meet with any of the People of the Book.

He informed those who were with him of the news of his prophecy from the People of the Book, just as Bahira told the monk of his prophecy, and what emerged from it. He showed them his prophecy, and that is why Khadija married him before his prophecy, when she was informed of his conditions.

These matters will be explained in detail elsewhere, but what is meant here is to point out that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, performed many miracles. Like a spring of water from between his fingers more than once, and like the abundance of a little food until the great creation eats of it, and the abundance of a little water. Until he drank a lot of it.

This is what happened more than once to him and his nation, and there are signs that are too long to describe. Some of his followers used to have God revive the dead people for him. And the beast, and some of his followers, lead the large army across the sea until they crossed to the other side.
Some of them were thrown into the fire, and it became coolness and peace for him, and there are many things like that.

But what is meant here is to mention some of what is in the Qur’an, such that it was informing them of past matters in detailed information that no one knew except the He will be a prophet, or someone who was informed by a prophet and his people know that no human being informed him of that, and this is what the argument is based on. against them, and despite the strength of their hostility towards Him and their confinement to what they used to attack Him, they were not able to make a challenge that would be accepted from them. And the rest of the nations knew that his people, who were hostile to him and who were diligent in attacking him, were not able to say:

These unseen things were taught to him by human beings, so it is obligatory for all of creation that this was not taught to him by human beings. For this reason the Almighty said: {These are of the news of the unseen which We have revealed to you. Neither you nor your people knew them before this} [Hud: 49].

So he reported that neither he nor his people knew that, and his people acknowledged that, and he did not learn from anyone other than his people. That is why some of them claimed that he learned from a human being whose lies became apparent to everyone, as God Almighty said:

{So when you read the Qur’an, seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan - for he has no authority over those who believe, and in their Lord they rely - only His authority is over those who follow Him and those who associate with Him - And when We exchange a verse for another verse, and God knows best what He is sending down, they say, “It is only you.” He is a slanderer. Nay, most of them do not know - Say, “It was sent down by the Holy Spirit from your Lord with the truth to confirm those who believe and as a guidance and good tidings for the Muslims - and verily, We know that they say, “Only a human being teaches it. The language of those to whom they refer is foreign, and this is a clear Arabic language.” [An-Nahl: 98-103].

There was a foreign man in Mecca who belonged to some Quraysh, and some people claimed that Muhammad was learning from that foreigner, so God made it clear that This is an obvious lie, for that is a foreign man who cannot speak a word of this Arabic Qur’an, and Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him. He greeted an Arab who does not know any of the non-Arab tongues, so whoever speaks to him in a language other than Arabic will not understand his words, so that man does not speak well. In Arabic, and Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, does not understand words other than Arabic, and for this reason the Almighty said:

{The tongue of those to whom they atheist} [An-Nahl: 103]. That is, they lean toward it and add to it that he taught Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: {A foreigner, and this is a clear Arabic language} [An-Nahl: 103].
Likewise, some people said about the Qur’an: “This is nothing but a lie that he invented, and other people helped him in it” [Al-Furqan: 4].

God Almighty said: {Indeed, they came with injustice and falsehood, and said, “He wrote down the legends of the ancients.” They were dictated to him morning and evening. Say, “It was revealed by Him who knows.” The secret in the heavens and the earth is that He is Forgiving, Merciful} [Al-Furqan: 4-6].
So, Glory be to Him, made it clear that saying this is an obvious lie known to his enemies, not to mention his friends, for they know that it is not He has someone to help him with that.

And there is no one among his people, nor in his country, who does this well to help him in it. For this reason, God Almighty said: “Indeed, they have committed injustice and falsehood” [Al-Furqan: 4].

All the people of his country and his people who are hostile to him know that this is an injustice to him and falsehood, and that is why none of their wise people said this. Well-known people, and likewise their saying: The legends of the ancients he wrote down, and they are dictated to him morning and evening, for it is his people who deny him. They know that he has no one to dictate a book to, and he has made clear their lie by saying, “Say, ‘It was sent down by Him who knows the secret in the heavens. And the earth} [Al-Furqan: 6].

For there are secrets in the Qur’an that no human being knows except by God’s knowledge of them. God knows the secrets in the heavens and the earth. Then why The falsehood of their saying has become clear. He mentioned what they discredited in his prophecy. God Almighty said: And they said: “Why does this Messenger eat food and walk in Markets, except that an angel had been sent down to him, and there had been with him a warner - or treasure had been given to him, or there had been for him a garden from which he might eat. And the wrongdoers said: You follow none other than a man bewitched.} [Al-Furqan: 7-8].

These are the words of those who opposed it, who denied its eating and its walking in the markets where what is eaten and what is worn are sold, and they said: Hala Has an angel been sent down to him, and he will be with him as a warner, or can he do without that with a treasure from which he can spend, or a garden from which he can eat? And the wrongdoers said, “You only follow a man bewitched.”
God Almighty said: {See how they have presented for you examples; they have gone astray, and are not able to find a way} [Al-Isra: 48].

Your people call you a liar, an enchanted person, and someone who narrates from someone else, and each of these statements is clearly false to everyone who knows you. For this reason, God Almighty said, “They have gone astray, and are not able to find a way.” [Al-Isra: 48] And the one who goes astray: the ignorant one who strays from the path, and cannot find the path that leads to it. What is intended is, rather, their inability and interruption in the debate became evident.
And the Almighty said: {And they said, “Why should he not bring to us a sign from his Lord? Has there not come to them a clear proof of what is in the earlier pages?” [Ta-ha: 133].

For he brought to them clearly what was in the earlier pages, such as the Torah and the Gospel, even though they knew that he did not take anything from the People of the Book. So if he tells them about the unseen that only a prophet or someone to whom a prophet told them about, and they know that he did not know that, By the news of one of the prophets, it became clear to them that he was a prophet, and that became clear to all the nations. If his people, who were hostile to him and those who were not hostile to him, admitted that he had not met with anyone who would teach him that, then this would have been transmitted. Consistently, it was something that those who disagreed with it acknowledged, although they were keen to challenge it if possible.

This news of the previously unseen established the proof against his people and against all who reached him the news of that, and he informed In the future unseen, and this is the proof against whoever knows the truth of that report, as God Almighty said: {The Romans were defeated in the lowest The earth} [Al-Rum: 2].

Then he said: {The Romans were defeated - in the lowest part of the earth, and after they were defeated they will be defeated - in a few years. To Allah belongs the matter before and after. And on that day the believers will rejoice - with the help of God. He helps whom He wills.} [Al-Rum: 1-5].

And God Almighty said: {And if you are in doubt concerning what We have sent down to Our servant, then produce a surah like it, and call your witnesses besides Allah, if you are. Truthful - if you do not do it, and you will not do it} [Al-Baqarah: 23-24].
So he was informed that they would not do that in the future, and it was as he was informed.

And God Almighty said: {Say, “If mankind and the jinn gathered together to produce the like of this Qur’an, they would not produce the like of it, even if some of them were.” to some by afternoon} [Al-Isra: 88].

So he was informed that neither man nor jinn will be able to produce the like of this Qur’an until the Day of Resurrection, and this news has passed on to him. More than seven hundred years, and not one of mankind or jinn was able to produce the like of this Qur’an, and he said about the disbelievers, and it is In Mecca: {The crowd will be defeated and they will turn back} [Al-Qamar: 45].
The confirmation of this became apparent on the day of Badr and elsewhere, and many years after that.

And the Almighty said: {Allah has promised those who believe among you and do righteous deeds that He will certainly appoint them as successors in the land, just as He succeeded those before them, and will establish them as successors. They will have their own religion which He has chosen for them, and He will surely replace them after their fear with security. They will worship Me, not associating anything with Me.} [An-Nur: 55].

The matter was as he promised him, and the truth of that became apparent after many years, and likewise his saying: “It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and religion.” The truth, that He may make it prevail over all religion, and Allah is sufficient as a witness.} [Al-Fath: 28].
So God revealed what He had sent him with, with signs, proof, hand, and traditions.
And the Almighty said: {Say to those who disbelieve: “You will be defeated and gathered into Hell. Evil is the resting place” [Al Imran: 12].

So it was, as he told them, that they were defeated in this world, as the people witnessed, and this confirms the latest news, which is that they will be gathered into Hell. And wretched is the cradle.

He supported him in a way that only the prophets can be supported with. Indeed, none of the prophets were supported as he was supported with him. He was also sent With the best books to the best nations, with the best laws, and made him the master of the children of Adam, may God bless him and grant him peace, so no one has ever been known to have claimed prophethood. And he is a liar, except that God will cut off his traces, humiliate him, and expose his lies and immorality.

And everyone whom God supported of those who claimed to be prophets was nothing but truthful, just as He supported Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, David, and Solomon, and even supported Shuaib, Hud, and Salih, for it is the custom of God to grant victory to His messengers and those who believe in the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will arise, and this is The reality is, whoever does not know what God does except by habit, then this is God’s habit and sunnah by which he knows what He does, and whoever knows This is due to his wisdom, for he knows that he does not support the one who claimed prophethood and lied to him in a way that no one can oppose. And thus the prophets before him had informed that the liar will not be fulfilled by God, nor will He help him, nor support him, so this became known from these directions; For this reason, Glory be to Him, He commanded that we take into account what He did in past nations, in assigning the outcome to the prophets and their followers, and taking revenge on those who He lied to them and disobeyed them.
God Almighty said: {Indeed, We will certainly help Our messengers and those who believe in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will be raised} [Ghafir: 51].

And God Almighty said: {And indeed We have preceded Our word to Our messenged servants - indeed, they will be helped - and indeed, We have recruited against them those who are victorious} [Al-Saffat: 171 - 173].

And God Almighty said: {The people of Noah denied before them, and the parties after them, and every nation sought their Messenger to seize him, and they disputed with falsehood. So that they would refute the truth therewith, so I seized them, so what was the punishment?} [Ghafir: 5].
And the Almighty said:

{And God will surely help whoever helps Him. Indeed, God is Powerful, Mighty. - Those who, if We establish them in the land, will establish prayer, pay zakat, and enjoin what is right. And they forbade evil, and to God is the outcome of all matters - and if they deny you, then before them you denied the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot and the companions of Midian, and Moses lied. So I granted hope to the disbelievers, then I took them. So how was Nakir? - How about a town that We destroyed while it was Unjust, for it is void of its thrones, and a broken well, and a built palace. - Have they not walked in the land and had hearts with which to reason? Ears with which they hear, for it is not the eyes that are blinded, but the hearts within the breasts that are blinded.} [Al-Hajj:

And God Almighty said: {Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were stronger than them in strength and had divided the earth. And they inhabited it longer than they inhabited it, and their messengers came to them with clear proofs. It was not Allah who wronged them, but it was they who wronged themselves. 9] Then {the end of those who did evil was misfortune, that they denied the signs of God and mocked them} [Al-Rum: 10].

And God Almighty said: {No one disputes about the verses of God except those who disbelieve, so do not be deceived by their wandering around in the land - before them the people of Noah and the parties denied. After them, every nation wanted their Messenger to seize him, and they disputed with falsehood in order to refute with it the truth. So I captured them. So what was the punishment?} [Ghafir: 4 - 5].

And God Almighty said: {Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those who were before them? They were stronger than them in strength and influence in land, so God seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from God - that is because their messengers used to bring clear proofs to them. So they disbelieved, so God seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful, severe in punishment.} [Ghafir: 21-22].

And God Almighty said: {Have they not traveled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them who were greater than them and stronger in power and influence in the earth, but what they were earning availed them - but when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, and it overtook them. They did not ridicule it, but when they saw our misfortune, they said, “We believe in God alone,” and we disbelieved in what we had associated with. But it was of no benefit to them. Their faith when they saw in Our misery the Sunnah of God which had passed among His servants, and there the disbelievers lost.} [Ghafir: 82-85].

And God Almighty said: {Before them, the people of Noah and Ad, and Pharaoh with the stakes, and Thamud, and the people of Lot, and the people of the thicket, denied them. Those are parties. “Everyone denies the messengers, and the punishment is due” [p. 12].

And God Almighty said: {And no remembrance from the Most Gracious comes to them as an origin, but they turn away from it. Indeed, they have denied, but there will come to them news of what they were. They mock Him.} [Al-Shu’ara’: 5].

So he informed that those who disbelieve in him will receive in the future the news of the Qur’an, which they mocked, and he explained that what he told them It is true that the news occurred in accordance with the news, and the matter was like that and likewise His saying: {We will show them Our signs on the horizons and within themselves until It will become clear to them that it is the truth. Is it not sufficient for your Lord that He is a witness over all things? [Fussilat: 53].

He informed that He would show them within themselves and on the horizons that which would make clear that the Qur’an is true, so long as they see what He informed of as He revealed it, then He said: {Is it not sufficient that your Lord is a witness over all things?} [Fussilat: 53].

For the Qur’an may be attested to be the truth through clear verses and proofs indicating its truthfulness that are made clear by the testimony of the Almighty Lord. Because it is true, there is no need, along with the present testimony, to wait for future signs.

And God Almighty said: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split open - and if they see a sign, they will turn away and say, “Continuing magic” - but they deny and follow their desires, and all A settled matter - and indeed there has come to them of news which contains contradictions - profound wisdom, but it is of no avail to vows} [Al-Qamar: 1-5].

He was informed of the approaching Hour and the splitting of the moon, and the splitting of the moon had been witnessed and witnessed by people and news of it had been reported repeatedly, and the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, was This Surah, peace and blessings be upon him, is recited in major gatherings such as Friday prayers and holidays. So that people may hear what is in it of the signs of prophecy and its evidence and consideration, and everyone acknowledges that and does not deny it, so it is known that the splitting of the moon was Known to people in general. Then he mentioned the condition of the prophets and their liars, and said:

{The people of Noah were denied before them, so they denied Our servant and said, “He is crazy,” and he was rebuked. Then he called on his Lord, “I am defeated,” and he was defeated. Then We opened the gates of The sky with flowing water - And We caused springs to gush out on the earth, so the waters met in a matter that had been ordained - And We carried it on boards and treads - they flow with Our eyes as a recompense. For whoever disbelieves - And indeed We have left it as a sign, so is there anyone who will remember?} [Al-Qamar: 9-15].

So he told that he had left the ships as a sign of the Lord’s power and of what happened to Noah with his people. Then he said: So how was my punishment for those who lied and my vow? He also mentioned the story of Ad, Thamud, Lot, and others. He said after each story: So how was my torment and my vow? And his vow and warning, which is what the messengers conveyed about him regarding the warning, and what his punishment was for those who were warned.

Warning: is the notification of a fear, thus making clear the truth of what the Messengers were informed of regarding the warning and the severity of His punishment for whoever lies. His messengers, and he mentioned the story of Pharaoh and said: {And indeed a warning has come to Pharaoh’s family - they denied all of Our signs, so We seized them with the help of the Mighty, the Powerful - Are your infidels better than those? Or do you have an innocence in the punishment - or do they say: We are all victorious? - The crowd will be defeated and they will turn their backs.} [Al-Qamar: 41-45].

He mentioned some types of that in the story of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, with the people, and said: “There has been a sign for you regarding two groups that met, a group fighting in The way of God, and another is an infidel. They see them as the same as they see with the eye. And God supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed, in that is a lesson for those who have Sights} [Al Imran: 13].

And God Almighty said: {It is He who brought out those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think that they would go out and they thought Because their strongholds protected them from God, so God came to them from where they had not expected and cast terror into their hearts. They destroyed their homes with their own hands. And the hands of the believers, so take heed, O you who have sight - and had God not decreed for them expulsion, He would have punished them in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is a punishment. Hell. That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in punishment.} [Al-Hashr: 2-3].

There are many things like this in the Qur’an, in terms of mentioning evidence of prophecy and signs of the message. This is not the place to explain it, but rather what is meant here. Pointing out the gender of this.

What some of the People of the Book or others mention is that it was a victory for Pharaoh, Nimrod, Sennacherib, Chingxan, and other kings. His answer is clear to the unbelievers, for none of them claimed to be prophets, and God commanded him to call to the worship of God and obedience to Him. And whoever obeys him will enter Paradise, and whoever disobeys him will enter Hell, unlike those who claim that God sent him to do that; For he can only be a truthful messenger whom God will help and support and support his followers, and make the outcome for them, or he will be a liar. Then God will take revenge on him and cut off his traces, and it will become clear that what He brought him is not among the signs and proofs that do not accept opposition, but rather It is of the same type as the miracles of magicians, soothsayers, and liars that accept opposition. The miracles of the prophets are among their characteristics that they do not Someone can oppose it and bring something like it, unlike any other, since it is possible to oppose it, thus invalidating its significance.

The Antichrist: He claims divinity, and brings supernatural miracles, but his very claim to divinity is an impossible claim in itself, and God will send The Messiah, the son of Mary, is against him, so he kills him and reveals his lie, along with other aspects that indicate his lie: among them: that it is written before his eyes that he is an infidel.
Among them: He is one-eyed, and God is not one-eyed.
Among them: that no one will see his Lord until he dies, and he wants to kill the one who killed him first, but he is unable to kill him.

He has some evidence that he is lying, which shows that what he has is not a sign of his truthfulness, unlike the miracles of the prophets, for it is not possible No one, whether man or jinn, can produce something equivalent to it and not nullify it, such as turning a staff into a serpent for Moses and removing a righteous she-camel from the land. And the resurrection of the dead is for the Messiah, and the splitting of the moon and the revelation of the Qur’an and other things are for Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, for the polytheists when They asked the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, a sign and suggested to him the splitting of the moon, so he showed them that.

God Almighty has told about that in the Qur’an, and God Almighty said: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split open - and if they see a sign, they will turn away and say, “Sorcery.” Continuing - and they lied and followed their desires, and every matter is settled - and indeed there has come to them of news that contains something reprehensible - profound wisdom, so what Vows are of no use - so turn away from them on the Day when the one calling to something reprehensible calls - with their eyes humbled. They will emerge from the events as if they were spreading locusts.} [The Moon: 1 - 7].

Then God Almighty mentioned what happened before him to the deniers, so He mentioned the story of the people of Noah, Hud, Salih, Lot, then Pharaoh, and this Surah was the Prophet. May God’s prayers and peace be upon him, he recites it in the greatest gatherings of his people, which are the holidays, and all the people hear what he mentions of dissent. The moon, and the deniers say that it is magic, and all the people - the believer in it, the hypocrite and the unbeliever - agree on this. None of them said that The moon was not split, nor did anyone deny it.

In Sahih Muslim, Omar bin Al-Khattab, may God be pleased with him, asked Abu Waqid Al-Laythi what the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, recites in Al-Adha and Al-Fitr, and he said: He used to recite in them “Q and the Glorious Qur’an” [Q: 1] and “The Hour has approached and the moon has been split open” [Al-Qamar: 1].

It is known of necessity and custom that if he had not defected, the people who believe in him would have hastened to deny that. His enemies are infidels and hypocrites, especially as he reads this to them in their greatest assemblies.

Also, it is known that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was one of the people most keen on people believing him and following him, even though he was the most knowledgeable people with the policy of creation, for if the moon had not split, he would not have announced this, and he would have read it to all of creation and used it as evidence, and made it A sign for him, because he who is one of the people with the least experience in politics does not deliberately do what everyone knows is false and make him one of the greatest. His verses indicate his truthfulness, and he recites it to people in the largest groups.

And he said: {The Hour has drawn near and the moon has been split open} [Al-Qamar: 1] in the past tense, and he did not say: The Hour has come, nor will it rise. Rather, he said: {It has drawn near} [The Moon: 1] That is, it approached and drew near, and {And the moon was split asunder} [Al-Qamar: 1] which is evidence of the prophecy of Muhammad and of the possibility of the burning of the ark which is its standing. Resurrection, and He, Glory be to Him, linked His news of the approaching Hour with His news of the splitting of the moon, for the Messenger of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, is It is one of the signs of the Hour and is evidence of its approach, as he, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said in the authentic hadith:

The hour and I were sent like these, and he brought his index and middle fingers together. And God Almighty said: {So do they wait except for the Hour that it should come to them suddenly? Its signs have already come} [Muhammad: 18].

And the knowledge of the Hour, God hid it from all of His creation, as is mentioned about Christ in the Gospel, when he was asked about it and said: It does not No one knows it, neither the angels, nor the Son, but the Father alone knows it. This is what indicates that he is not the Lord of the World, and likewise Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, told of this when he was asked about it. God Almighty said: {They ask you about the Hour, when it will anchor - Say, “The knowledge of it is only with my Lord. None will bring it to light at its appointed time. Only He. It is heavy in the heavens.” And the earth} [Al-A’raf: 187].

That is: it is hidden from the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth: {It will not come to you except suddenly. They will ask you as if you were unaware of it. Say, “The knowledge of it is only with Allah.” But most people do not know} [Al-A’raf: 187].

In the authentic hadith, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “You ask me about the Hour, but knowledge of it is with God,” so the splitting of the moon was a sign. On two things:

On the truthfulness of the Messenger, and on the coming of the Hour and the possibility of the splitting of the orbit; For those who deny the coming of the Great Resurrection, the rising of people from their graves to the Lord of the Worlds, and the splitting and breaking of the heavens, whether they acknowledge By the minor resurrection, and that after death the souls will be blessed or tortured, as is the saying of the non-theistic philosophers, or they denied the Day of Resurrection. Absolutely, as was denied by the Arab polytheists and natural philosophers who denied it, and others who deny the splitting of the heavens.

These secularists claim that the spheres are not permitted to split, as Aristotle and his followers mentioned, and they claimed that Splitting requires a straight movement, which is impossible, according to their claim, in the defined orbit, since there is no void beyond it for them. If this indicates, it is only This is indicated in the Atlas astronomy and not in what is below it, so how can it be false? The straight movement there is like making the spheres begin in these places in which they are - whether it is called empty or not. It is called - as it is mentioned elsewhere.

What is meant here is that God Almighty informed of the splitting of the moon as the Hour approaches. Because it is evidence of the possibility of the spheres splitting and breaking up, which is the coming of the Great Hour, and it is a sign of the prophecy of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace be upon him, which is one of the signs of the Hour, and God Almighty in His Book combines the mention of the Great and Minor Resurrection, as in Surah The event was mentioned at the beginning of the Great Resurrection, and at the end of it the Lesser Resurrection. This is many in the Surahs of the Qur’an, such as Surah Q and Surah Resurrection, Surah Al-Takathar, Surat Al-Fajr, and so on.

The hadiths have been extensively discussed about the splitting of the moon. In the two Sahih books, on the authority of Ibn Masoud, he said: The moon was split during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. There were two groups, one above the mountain, and one below it. Then the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said: Bear witness, and in the word “we are with him.” At Mina, the infidels of Quraysh said, “Ibn Abi Kabsha has performed your magic.” A man among them said: If Muhammad performed the magic of the moon, then his magic did not amount to it. That he will enchant the entire earth, so ask those who come to you from another country, have they seen this?
So they came and asked them, and they told them that they had seen something like that.

On the authority of Anas bin Malik that he said: The people of Mecca asked the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to show them a sign, and he showed them the moon splitting into two parts until... They saw Hira’ between them, and it was revealed: “The Hour has approached and the moon has been split open, and if they see a sign, they will turn away and say, ‘It is continuing magic.’” [Al-Qamar: 1].

This is an authentic and extensive hadith, narrated by Ibn Masoud, Anas bin Malik and Ibn Abbas, and it is also known on the authority of Hudhayfah. Abu Al-Faraj said: Ibn al-Jawzi and the narrations in Sahih about the splitting of the moon from Ibn Omar, Ibn Masoud, Ibn Abbas, and Anas, may God be pleased with them.

And when they claimed that this Qur’an was composed by him, God Almighty said: {Or do they say that you say it? Nay, they do not believe. So let them produce a hadith like it. They were truthful} [At-Tur: 33].

Then he challenged them with ten surahs, and God Almighty said: {Or do they say, “He has fabricated it?” Say, “Then produce ten forged surahs like it, and call upon whomever you can without By God, if you are truthful - but if they do not respond to you, then know that it was revealed with the knowledge of God and that there is no god but Him. So are you? Muslims} [Hud: 13-14].

Then he challenged them with one surah and said: {And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down to Our servant, then produce a surah like it and call upon your witnesses. Instead of God, if you are truthful, then if you do not do it, and you will not do it” [Al-Baqarah: 23].
The Almighty also said: “Or do they say, ‘He has fabricated it?’ Say, ‘Then produce a surah like it, and call upon whomever you are able besides Allah.’” [Yunus: 38].

So all of creation was unable to oppose what He brought. Then He recorded the inability of all of creation until the Day of Resurrection by saying: {Say, “If you gather Mankind and the jinn, provided that they produce the like of this Qur’an, will not produce the like of it, even if they were [supporters] of one another.” [Al-Isra: 88].

So it was reported from that time that when humans and jinn come together, they are not able to oppose the Qur’an with something like it, so its wording and meaning became impossible. His knowledge and knowledge are the most complete miracle and the greatest in status, and this is the case, for no one of the Arabs or others has been able to do so with his power. Their hostility, their eagerness to nullify his command in every way, and their ability to produce speech similar to it, and God revealed at that time Verses in which he made clear that he was a messenger to them, but in which he did not mention that he had not been sent to anyone else. Then God Almighty said in Surah Al-Qasas:

{And We gave Moses the Scripture after We had destroyed the first generations, as insights for the people and guidance and mercy so that they might remember - and you were not Next to the western one, when We decreed to Moses the matter, and you were not of the witnesses - but We created generations, and their lives were prolonged, and you were not present in it. The people of Medina, to whom Our verses were recited, but we were messengers - and you were not by the mountain when we called, but it was a mercy from your Lord that you might warn a certain people. A warner came to them from before you, so that they might remember - and had it not been that some calamity should strike them, they would not have sent their hands forward. They would say, “Our Lord, had you not sent to us as a messenger, so we will follow your verses and be of the believers} [Al-Qasas:

And he said in Surah Al-Sajdah: {Or do they say, “He has fabricated it?” Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, that you may warn a people. No warner has come to them before you, so that they may They will be guided} [Al-Sajdah: 3].

And he said in Surat Yasin: {Yasin - by the Wise Qur’an - indeed, you are among the messengers - on a straight path - a revelation of the Mighty, the Most Merciful - that you may warn a people who were not warned Their fathers were heedless} [Yasin: 1-6].

In these three verses, God Almighty mentioned His blessing upon these people, His proof against them by sending Him, and He mentioned some of His wisdom in sending Him. It does not mean that he was not sent except for this purpose, but rather many such things are known in the language of the Arabs and others.
God Almighty said: {And horses and mules and donkeys that you may ride as an adornment. And He creates what you do not know} [An-Nahl: 8].

It is known that there are benefits to these animals other than riding, and God Almighty said: {He casts the Spirit at His command upon whomever He wills of His servants, to warn of the Day of meeting. On the Day when they will emerge.} [Ghafir: 15].

It has been reported that He sends down revelation to the angels to the prophets. To warn of the Day of Resurrection, and that does not prevent them from being sent down with good news to the believers and commands and prohibitions according to the laws.

And God Almighty said: {It is God who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them. The matter descends between them so that you may know that God has power over all things and that God encompasses all things with knowledge” [At-Talaq: 12].

So God Almighty told that He created the upper and lower worlds. So that the servants may know His power and knowledge, and in addition to this, in creating that, He has wisdom in other matters other than the knowledge of the servants, and such as this. God Almighty says: {Allah has made the Kaaba, the Sacred House, an establishment for the people, and the Sacred Month, and the guidance, and the chains. This is so that you may know that God knows. Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and that God is All-Knowing of all things” [Al-Maeda: 97].
It is known that making the Kaaba a standing place for the people, as well as gifts and necklaces, brings wisdom and other benefits.

And the Almighty said: {And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil according to what they have done, and to reward those who do good with goodness} [Al-Najm: 31].

It is known that in the kingdom of God there is another ruling other than the recompense of the doer of good and the wrongdoer, and likewise His saying: {And God created the heavens and the earth with truth. And every soul will be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.} [Al-Jathiya: 22].

And God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah} [An-Nisa: 163]. To his saying: {Messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people may have no argument against God after the Messengers} [An-Nisa: 165].

It is known that sending messengers brings happiness to those who believe in them, and there is another reason for it other than refuting the argument of creation against God. Likewise, the Almighty says: {Thus He has subjected it to you so that you may magnify God for having guided you} [Al-Hajj: 37].
It is known that there is wisdom and benefit in harnessing it other than takbeer. And he said: {And that you should complete the number and glorify God for having guided you} [Al-Baqarah: 185].

And God Almighty said: {And He has subjected to you the ships so that you may sail in the sea by His command, and He has subjected to you the rivers, and He has subjected to you the sun and the moon moving about, and He has subjected to you Night and day, and He has given you everything you asked for. And if you count the blessings of God, you will not number them. Indeed, man is an oppressor, an unbeliever.} [Ibrahim: 32].

It is known that God has a ruling in the creation of the sun and the moon, and the night and the day, other than the benefit of the children of Adam, and likewise His saying: {It is He who has appointed for you The night that you may rest therein} [Yunus: 67].
And His saying: {And it is He who made the night and the day a succession for whoever desires to be reminded or desires to be grateful} [Al-Furqan: 62].
And there are other rulings in it.
And he said: {And He sent down with them the Book with the truth to judge between the people concerning that wherein they differed} [Al-Baqarah: 213].
And in sending down the Book to guide and seek advice from those who are guided by it, and other than that, there are purposes other than ruling between people regarding what they differed about.

And God Almighty said: {And they swore by God the best of their oaths: God will not resurrect anyone who dies. Indeed, it is a promise upon him in fulfillment, but most people do not know - That He may make clear to them that concerning which they differ, and that those who disbelieve may know that they are liars} [An-Nahl: 38-39].

It is known that there are purposes in the Creation of creation on the Day of Resurrection other than explaining the difference in the knowledge of these people, and what makes this clear is that He said in The verse they used as evidence: “To warn a people whose fathers were not warned” [Yasin: 6].

It is known that he was not sent merely as a warning, but rather to give good news to those who believed in him, and to command them to do what is right, and to forbid evil. And permitting the good things, and prohibiting the bad things, and other than that are among the purposes of the messengers, as God Almighty said: {Messengers bringing good news and warnings} [An-Nisa: 165].

And His saying: {And We do not send messengers except as bringers of good news and warners} [Al-An’am: 48]. It does not contradict the fact that he did not describe them in another place except as a warning, and he said: {Praise be to God who sent down to His servant the Book and did not He makes it crooked - straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good news to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward - They will abide therein forever - and those who said, “God has taken a son” will be warned - they have no knowledge of it, nor did their fathers. A word that comes out of their mouths is vengeful. They say nothing but a lie.} [Al-Kahf: 1-5].

Once, the Muslims prayed the Eid prayer in the presence of a Christian siege, then their preacher stood up and delivered a sermon with this verse, and when he read his statement: {And gives good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds} [Al-Isra: 9] He referred to the host of faith.
When he read his statement: “And warns those who say, ‘God has taken a son.’” [Al-Kahf: 4] he pointed to the army of crosses.
And God Almighty said: {And We sent down with them the Book and the Balance so that the people might maintain justice} [Al-Hadid: 25].

And in the sending down of the Book and the Balance there is another ruling of good tidings and warning and other than that, and likewise His saying: {Then We sent them that We might know. Which of the two parties is more accurately recorded when they remained for a while” [Al-Kahf: 12].

There is another ruling regarding their resurrection, as evidenced by His saying: {And thus We caused them to know that the promise of God is true and that the Hour is of which there is no doubt} [Al-Kahf: 21].
And God Almighty said: {For he walks before him and behind him as a watchful eye - that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord} [Al-Jinn: 27-28].

It is known that there are other purposes in that, such as guiding the people, establishing proof against those who reach them, and other than that, and His saying: {A Book We have sent it down to you, blessed, so that they may contemplate its signs and that those of understanding may remember.} [p. 29].

And there is another ruling in it regarding the establishment of evidence against creation and the misguidance of those who go astray by it, and the like of it is His saying: {This is a conveyance to the people, so that they may be warned by it and so that they may know. Indeed, He is One God, and that those of understanding may remember” [Ibrahim: 52].

It is known that there are other purposes in that, such as good news, commands, prohibitions, and other things, and likewise His saying: {O you who have believed! Fear God and believe in His Messenger. He will give you two sides of His mercy and give you a light by which you walk, and He will forgive you. And God is Forgiving and Merciful. So that the People of the Book do not know that they are not able to do anything of God’s grace, and that grace is in the hand of God} [Al-Hadid: 28-29].

It is known that there are purposes other than the knowledge of the People of the Book and what is with it, and God Almighty says: {And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed. He confirms what is before him, and that you may warn Umm al-Qura and those around her.} [Al-An’am: 92].
It is known that it contains other rulings, such as giving good news to those who believe in it, commands and prohibitions, and warning other than these Arabs.
And the Almighty said: {It is nothing but a Reminder and a clear Qur’an - that He may warn whoever is alive and confirm the Word against the disbelievers} [Yasin: 69-70].
It is known that there is another wisdom in it other than warning.

And God Almighty said: {And before him was the Book of Moses as a guide and a mercy, and this is a Book confirming an Arabic tongue, to warn those who do wrong and to bring good news to those who do good.} [Al-Ahqaf: 12].

It is known that there is another wisdom in it, such as warning all of creation, enjoining them to do what is right, forbidding them of what is wrong, and giving good tidings to the believers. Then God Almighty said: {And when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from you, and from Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus, son of Mary, and We took from them a covenant Tough - to question the truthful about their truthfulness} [Al-Ahzab: 7-8].
It is known that there are other rulings regarding taking the covenant.

And God Almighty said: {Indeed, We have given you a clear conquest - that God may forgive you your previous sins and those that will follow, and complete His blessings upon you, and guide you. A straight path} [Al-Fath: 1-2].
And His saying: {Glory be to Him who took His servant by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Aqsa Mosque} [Al-Isra: 1].
And His saying: {That We may show him of Our signs} [Al-Isra: 1].

And likewise His saying: {And We made the night and the day as signs} [Al-Isra: 12] to His saying: {That you may seek bounty from your Lord and that you may know the number of years. And the reckoning} [Al-Isra: 12].
Likewise, His saying: {It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light and ordained it as stations so that you may know the number of years and the reckoning} [Yunus: 5].
There is another ruling in all of that, as well as his saying: {So the people of Pharaoh captured him to be an enemy and a source of sorrow to them} [Al-Qasas: 8].

And if this is the blame for the consequence, then the consequence is not limited to that, but rather in that of being kind to Moses, raising him, etc. That is another ruling, and such as his saying: {And thus the killing of their own children by their partners has become pleasing to many of the polytheists, in order to destroy them and to ensnare them. “On them is their religion” [Al-An’am: 137].
And the Almighty said: {It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it prevail over all religions} [At-Tawbah: 33].

There is another ruling in His sending, and likewise His saying: {Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book with the truth that you may judge between the people according to what God has shown you} [An-Nisa: 105].

And in His revelation there is good news, a warning, a command, a prohibition, a promise, and a threat. And so is His saying about Jesus, son of Mary: {It is easy for me. And We will make him a sign for the people and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter decreed.} [Maryam: 21].
Likewise, His saying: “It is Allah who has subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail therein by His command and that you may seek of His bounty” [Al-Jathiya: 12].

And there is another ruling in it, as He said in the other verse: {And it is He who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh meat from it and extract from it ornaments. You may wear it.} [An-Nahl: 14].

And he said: {And not two seas are equal: this is sweet, fresh water, sweet to drink, and this is salt and brackish, and from each of them you eat fresh meat and extract An ornament that you wear, and you see the ark, in which are places of departure, that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may be grateful.” [Fatir: 12].

And God Almighty said: {And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy, the devils of mankind and the jinn, some of whom reveal to one another false speech out of deceit, even if your Lord had willed.} [Al-An'am: 112] To His saying: {And that the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter may listen to it, and that they may be pleased with it, and that they may recompense what they have committed} [Al-An'am: 113].
And likewise His saying: {And thus We have made you a moderate nation that you may be witnesses over the people and that the Messenger may be a witness over you} [Al-Baqarah: 143].
And because they are in the middle there is another ruling.
And His saying: {He who created death and life that He may test you as to which of you is best in deeds} [Al-Mulk: 2].
And there is another ruling in them, and likewise His saying: {Blessed is He who has sent down the Criterion upon His servant, that he may be a warner to the worlds} [Al-Furqan: 1].
And in that there are other rulings of good news, commands, and prohibitions.
And God Almighty said: {And that God may know those who believe and take from among you witnesses} [Al Imran: 140].

There is another ruling in that, and there are many similar matters in the word of God Almighty and other than the word of God. If he mentions a reason for the action, it is not necessary that it should not. He may have another wisdom, but it is necessary to specify that wisdom by mentioning it in that appropriate place, and this is like the occasion in His saying: “To warn a people whose fathers were not warned” [Yasin: 6].

For these were the first to be warned, and the most deserving of the warning, so there was benefit in singling them out for the remembrance, not that he singled them out for the absence of Warning others.
And the Almighty said: {The Faithful Spirit has sent down therewith - upon your heart that you may be among the warners - in a clear Arabic language} [Al-Shu’ara’: 193-195].

It is known that it was sent down to be good tidings, to enjoin what is right, and forbid what is wrong, and to make lawful the good things, and to prohibit the evil, and to put The chains and shackles, may God bless him and grant him peace.

chapters.title: A chapter responding to their protest with some verses on the specificity of the message
paragraphs: [Chapter: Responding to their argument with some verses regarding the specificity of the message]
As for their argument in the Almighty’s words: “Just as We have sent among you a messenger from among you who recites to you Our verses” [Al-Baqarah: 151].
And God Almighty says: “Indeed, God has favored the believers when He sent among them a messenger from among themselves, reciting to them His verses” [Al Imran: 164].

This is like the Almighty’s saying: {Indeed there has come to you a messenger from among yourselves; dear to him is what you have troubled. He is anxious for you towards the believers, Compassionate and Merciful} [Repentance: 128].

This is a dispute in general, for it is either a speech to all people, and what is meant is: We have sent to you a messenger from among mankind, since You were not able to take anything from one of the angels, so God has graciously sent you a human messenger.

God Almighty said: {And they say, “If only a king had been sent down to him. And if We had sent down a king, the matter would have been decided. Then they would not be reconsidered. - And if We had made him a king, We would have made him a man.” And We clothed them with what they clothed} [Al-An'am: 8-9].

Either the speech was to the Arabs, and according to both estimates, it included a mention of His blessings to those being addressed by sending a messenger of their kind, and not This is what prevents it from being sent to others, for if it is an address to all of mankind, then it is also sent to the jinn, and not by Their race, so how could it be forbidden if he was addressing the Arabs with what he expressed gratitude to them? That he should have been more grateful to others for that, as the non-Arabs are closer to the Arabs than the jinn are to humans, and it has been told in the Mighty Book that When the jinn heard the Qur’an, they believed in it.

God Almighty said: {And when We turned to you a group of the jinn listening to the Qur’an. Then when they attended it, they said, “Be silent.” So when it had been decided, they turned to their people. Warners - They said, “O our people, indeed we have heard a book sent down after Moses, confirming what was before it, guiding to the truth and to a straight path” - O our people Answer the caller of God and believe in Him. He will forgive you of your sins and save you from a painful punishment - and whoever does not respond to the caller of God is not miraculous in The earth} [Al-Ahqaf: 29-32].
And he said:

{Say: It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, “Indeed, we have heard a wondrous Qur’an - it guides to right path.” So we believed in it, and we will not associate with our Lord anyone. And that God Almighty is the forefather of our Lord who did not take a companion or a child - and that our fool used to speak ill of God about God - and we thought that man would not say And the jinn lied to God - and that there were men from mankind seeking refuge with men from the jinn, but they increased their burden - and that they thought as you thought. That God will not send anyone - and we touched the sky and found it filled with strong guards and meteors - and we were sitting there in seats to listen. Whoever listens now will find a shooting star waiting for him - and we do not know whether evil was intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intended for them guidance - and we are of us. The righteous, and among us other than that, we were on our way - and we thought that we would never defeat God on earth, nor would we defeat Him by fleeing - and indeed, when we heard Guidance: We believe in it, so whoever believes in his Lord will not fear misery or oppression - and among us are the submitters, and among us are the just. They sought righteousness - and as for the dividers, they are firewood for Hell - and if they had remained steadfast in the path, We would certainly have given them abundant water to drink - that We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will be subjected to a severe torment - and that the mosques are for God, so do not call upon anyone with God - and that when Abdullah rose They call upon Him, almost as if they were over it - Say, “I only call upon my Lord, and I do not associate with Him anyone” - Say, “I have no power over you to harm you nor to guide you” - Say, “Indeed, He will not protect me.” There is no one from God, and I will not find anyone who is devout besides Him - except a message from God and His messages. And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger - for him will be the fire of Hell to abide forever. Therein forever - until when they see what they are promised, they will know who is the weakest helper and fewer in number - Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near or will be appointed for it.” My Lord, for a long time - He knows the unseen, and He does not reveal His unseen to anyone - except from whom He is pleased with a messenger, for He walks before Him and behind Him as a watcher - that He may know. Indeed, they conveyed the messages of their Lord, and He encompassed what they had and counted everything in number.} [The Jinn:
The equivalent of this is his saying: {And indeed, it is a reminder for you and for your people, and you will be asked} [Al-Zukhruf: 44].
His people are Quraysh, and this does not prevent him from being mentioned to all Arabs, but to all people.

As God Almighty said: {And those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they heard the Remembrance and say, “Indeed, he is crazy.” And he is nothing but. A reminder to the worlds} [Al-Qalam: 51-52].
And God Almighty said: {Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion to His servant, that he might be a warner to the worlds} [Al-Furqan: 1].

And God Almighty said: {Say: I do not ask you for it any reward, and I am not of those who heed. - Indeed, it is only a reminder to the worlds - and you will surely know the news of it after. A while} [p. 86 - 88] And the Almighty said: {Indeed, it is the word of a noble Messenger - Possessed of power, with the Owner of the Throne, established - obedient, then trustworthy - and what is your companion? An insane person - and He has seen it on the clear horizon - and it is not with sadness over the unseen - and it is not the word of an accursed Satan - so where will you go - if it is Except a reminder to the worlds - for whoever among you wills to be upright - and you do not will except that Allah, Lord of the worlds, wills.} [Al-Takwir: 19-29].
And God Almighty said: {And We sent you to the people as a Messenger, and God is sufficient as a witness} [An-Nisa: 79].

This is according to the more correct of the two opinions, and what is meant by his saying {And indeed it is a reminder for you and your people} [Al-Zukhruf: 44] is that it is a reminder for them that they will remember Him. They will be guided by it.

It was said: What is meant is that it is an honor for them and not anything, because the Qur’an is an honor for those of his people and others who believe in it and it is not an honor for everyone. His people, but whoever among them denies him is more deserving of blame, as God Almighty said: {The hands of Abu Lahab became repentant} [Al-Masad: 1].
And God Almighty said: {And your people denied it while it was the truth} [Al-An’am: 66].

Other than it being a remembrance and remembrance; For it is a reminder to them and to others, as the Almighty said: {Say, I do not ask you for any reward for it. It is only a reminder to the worlds} [Al-An’am: 90].
So He encompassed all the worlds, and said: {And you ask them of no reward for it. It is only a reminder to the worlds} [Yusuf: 104].

chapters.title: Detailing the statement of those who say that he did not say that he was sent except to the Arabs
paragraphs: [Chapter: The statement of those who say that he did not say that he was sent except to the Arabs] [If they acknowledge his message to the Arabs]
These words are, in the first sense, the statement of someone who says that he did not say that he was sent except to the Arabs.

As for the second aspect: which is that we say: He mentioned that he is a messenger to all people, as the Qur’an has said in more than one place, such as: God Almighty: {And We have not sent you except as a bringer of good tidings to mankind} [Saba: 28].
And his saying: {O people, I am the Messenger of God to all of you, to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth} [Al-A’raf: 158].

In it he declared the call of the People of the Book and the call of the jinn in other places. If they accepted that he mentioned that, but they denied him about it, Either they acknowledge his message to the Arabs, or they do not.

If they acknowledge that he is a messenger sent by God, however, it is not possible to deny him as mentioned above. Rather, his message to all people must be acknowledged. The creation as he informed about that, as previously mentioned, that whoever states that he is the Messenger of God can only be one of the best and most truthful of creation, or one of the worst. creation and the most lying of them, for if he is truthful then he is one of the best of them, and if he is

chapters.title: If they acknowledge his message to the Arabs
