paragraphs: If he is a liar, then he is one of the worst of them, and if God had sent him - even to a village just as He sent Yunus ibn Matthew to the people of Nineveh - he would have been one of the best. creation, and he was truthful and did not lie about God, and did not speak about him except the truth, and if he had lied about God, even in a single word, he would have been one of the liars. He was not one of the truthful messengers of God, for a liar does not lie about everything, but rather about some. So whoever lies about God in one word, has He invents a lie against God, and he is one of the liars in the claim of the Message, not of the truthful ones.
Also, the purpose of the message is to convey the messages of God in their true form, so if lying is mixed with truthfulness, the purpose of the message will not be achieved.

Also, if it is known that he lied about some of them, he will not be able to distinguish what he told the truth about from what he lied about except by evidence other than his message, so it does not happen. What is meant by his message.

For this reason, the entire religion has unanimously agreed that the messengers are infallible in what they convey about God, Blessed and Most High. No one has ever said that God sent him to tell lies about him, and God Almighty has said something that makes it clear that He does not approve of a liar about him. God Almighty said: {And if he uttered some words against us - We would certainly have taken from him with the right - then We would have cut off from him both sides - but there is not one of you who will be able to detain him from it.} [Al-Haqqah: 44-47].
And the Almighty said: {Or do they say, “He has invented a lie against God?” Then if God wills, He will seal your heart.} [Al-Shura: 24].
Then God Almighty said: {And God erases falsehood and establishes the truth with His words} [Al-Shura: 24].

The Almighty’s saying: {And Allah erases falsehood and establishes truth} [Al-Shura: 24] is a general statement, not included in the answer to the condition, for if it were connected to The response to the condition, he said, and the right is established by the kasra to meet the two residents, as in his saying {Stand up the night} [Al-Muzzammil: 2].

When he said, “And the truth is established” [Al-Shura: 24] with the dammah, he indicated that it was a resuming sentence in which he informed that God Almighty erases falsehood as falsehood. And the truth is as valid as the truth of those who tell the truth, so erasing falsehood in exchange for establishing the truth is not something that is conditional upon the will, but rather it is necessary. Unlike the seal on his heart, it is attached to the will, and it is not permissible to attach the erasure of falsehood to the will like attaching a seal, rather he slanders With truth over falsehood, it destroys it.

And God Almighty said in His protection and decrees regarding what His messengers convey to Him: {And We have not sent before you any messenger or prophet unless he wished. Satan in his wish, so God cancels what Satan throws, then God confirms His signs, and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise - to make what Satan throws into a trial. For those in whose hearts is disease and whose hearts are hardened, and indeed, the wrongdoers are in far-off discord - and that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord. Then they believe in Him, and their hearts are humbled before Him. Indeed, Allah is the Guide of those who believe to a straight path.} [Al-Hajj: 52-54].

Also, if he was not sent except to the Arabs, and he called the Jews and Christians to believe in him, and declared them unbelievers if they did not believe in him, He fought against them, killed their fighter, and took their offspring captive. This was an injustice that could only be done by one of the most unjust of people, and he who was a prophet had God sent him, so he is above this and that.

Acknowledging his message to the Arabs and not others - despite what appears to be the generality of his call to all of creation - is a contradictory statement that clearly shows corruption, and all Whatever indicates that he is a messenger, it requires his message to all of creation, and everyone who acknowledges that he is a messenger must acknowledge that he A messenger to all of creation. Otherwise, it would be necessary for God to have sent a messenger to invent a lie against them, and to say to the people:

God has commanded you to follow me, and He has commanded me to strive with you if you do not do so, and he is lying about that, and it is known that everything that indicates that God He sent him because it indicates that he is truthful in the message, otherwise he is not. A false messenger does not achieve the purpose of the message, but rather it is part of Those who invent lies about God, and these are not among the messengers of God, and it is not permissible to believe them when they say: God sent them.
